title: Sr Specialist Analyst (Technology Research, Quantitative research)
description:
**Senior Specialist Analyst — Forecast and Market Share (F&MS)**
**What makes Gartner Business and Technology Insights a**
***great***
**fit for you?**
When you join Gartner Business and Technology Insights, you’ll be part of a leading-edge team that values expert insights, bold ideas, and intellectual courage. You’ll deliver must-have research and contribute to our growth by providing our clients the unbiased insight they need to make the right decisions on their key initiatives. Through constant learning, discovery, and collaboration you’ll not only help clients act on their mission critical priorities, but you’ll also advance your career and the scope of your impact across markets and industries. Our culture demands hard work — and rewards it with exceptional opportunity.
  
  
If you are intellectually curious and self-motivated, Gartner is looking for you.
  
  
**About this role:**
This is a unique opportunity for a convergent thinker with strong numeracy skills to make a significant impact on Gartner’s clients as part of the Services team within the Forecast and Market Share (F&MS) group in the High Tech (HT) practice.
  
  
As a Senior Specialist Analyst, you will focus on analysing vendor trends and creating actionable vendor insights. Through quantitative research, you’ll help high-tech clients identify growth opportunities, understand technology trends, and navigate evolving market dynamics.
  
  
**What will you do:**

* Contribute to Gartner’s Market Share data and analysis by delivering vendor revenue positions through:
* Vendor Insights: Assess trends related to revenue performance, growth rates, and key strategic developments such as mergers and acquisitions, geographic expansion, and other critical business moves.
* Market Insights: Analyze supply and demand dynamics, macroeconomic indicators, and regulatory factors influencing technology markets.
* Apply Gartner estimation methodology and modeling of individual vendor revenue.
* Contribute to Gartner Forecast data and analysis by assisting in forecast assumptions and storylines, including conducting research on influencing factors that impact end-user buying behavior and on IT vendors’ evolving business models, competitive environment, etc.
* Contribute to key deliverables outside market share and forecast, including Competitive Landscape, Opportunity Forecast, Emerging Brief, First Take content, etc.
* Develop insights in the AI space by analyzing competitive dynamics among vendors, with a focus on evolving products, business models, and strategic advancements in the AI race.
* Build knowledge on all internal and external data assets and enable the team to leverage these assets for innovative data-driven deliverables.
* Leverage and enable continuous evolution of AI tools usage in research deliverables to increase efficiency and strengthen the quality of output.
* Actively support and drive process improvement initiatives within the team by streamlining workflows and contributing to the implementation of best practices.
* Communicate and collaborate with extended stakeholders on publications and initiatives.

**What will you need:**
**Professional Qualifications And Experience**

* BE/B.Tech + MBA with 2-5 years of work experience, or
* Graduate + MBA from leading Tier I & II - B-schools, or
* Post-graduates/graduates with IT, Maths, Statistics, Finance and Economics background (B.Sc./BBA/ B.A. Economics/B.Com)
* Experience in technology research a plus, while a keen interest in IT markets is a must

***Key attributes***

* Highly numerate with excellent critical thinking skills. Must be able to quickly grasp and articulate the fundamentals of a market and demand & growth drivers
* Understanding of key technology and macroeconomic trends
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Working knowledge of databases such as Factiva, Capital IQ, Crunchbase, and data visualization tools (Power BI, advanced excel etc.) is a plus
* Knowledge of conducting structured research leveraging AI tools is a plus
* Strong sense of ownership and a “can do” attitude.

**How will you develop your insight:**
As a Senior Specialist Analyst, you will contribute to the development of a vision for market assigned to you, at the local, regional, and global levels.
  
  

* You will have an individualized development plan geared toward acquiring the knowledge and skills you need for long-term career success at Gartner.
* You will work with thought leaders who will help you develop subject matter expertise and data analysis and visualization skills. You will also have access to an extensive peer network and best-in-class research resources.

**What will you get:**
In addition to an outstanding work environment with advancement potential, the Gartner Business and Technology Insights team enjoys exceptional benefits, including:
  
  

* Competitive base salary and a generous paid time off policy
* Group Medical Insurance, Parental Leave, Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces diversity
* High emphasis on learning, professional development, and growth

**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
  
  
**What do we offer?**
Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
  
  
In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
  
  
Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: Senior Analyst-Data Science (Machine Learning, LLM, GenAI)
description:
**Job Description**
The Global Servicing Decision Science (GSDS) team is the Decision Science engine for Global Servicing, bringing together advanced analytics, data science, AI/GenAI, and decisioning to transform servicing experiences, empower colleagues, and enable intelligent operations. GSDS serves as a centralized Decision Science Center of Excellence, partnering across Product/Capabilities, Control Management, Strategy, Operations, Technology, and enterprise analytics and data science teams.
  
  
GSDS builds and scales servicing intelligence across Global Servicing—from predictive and proactive servicing, personalization, next-best-action and journey orchestration to conversational AI, agent assist, AI-powered coaching, conduct and quality monitoring, and complaint and dispute intelligence. Our mandate is to build durable, production-ready capabilities that continuously improve decisions through prediction, recommendation, optimization, experimentation, and learning.
  
  
**Role Description**
As a Senior Analyst, you will develop and implement Decision Science solutions that help power the next generation of servicing intelligence at American Express. You will use data, machine learning, experimentation, and emerging AI/GenAI techniques to solve customer, colleague, and operational problems and translate analytical work into measurable business impact.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone with strong quantitative and coding skills who is excited to work hands-on with modern AI—including Agentic AI, transformer-based recommendation approaches, and Conversational AI—and to grow their technical depth while building production-oriented Decision Science capabilities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Decision Science & Modeling**

* Develop analytical solutions, predictive models, recommendation and decisioning approaches that improve servicing experiences, personalization, colleague effectiveness, and operational outcomes.
* Explore and analyse large customer, behavioural, interaction, and operational datasets to identify opportunities, engineer features, test hypotheses, and translate findings into actionable solutions.

**AI / GenAI & Experimentation**

* Build and evaluate machine learning and GenAI solutions using appropriate modeling, experimentation, and validation techniques.
* Contribute to emerging capabilities such as Agentic AI and agentic workflows, transformer-based recommendation systems, Conversational AI/LLM applications, and advanced personalization or next-best-action solutions.
* Design and analyze experiments and performance measurements to assess model/AI quality and business impact and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

**Implementation & Partnership**

* Write high-quality analytical code and work with data, Technology, and platform partners to support productionization, monitoring, and ongoing enhancement of Decision Science solutions.
* Develop strong cross-functional relationships, communicate analytical findings clearly, and help translate technical results into recommendations that drive action.

**Innovation & Technical Growth**

* Stay current on advances in machine learning, GenAI, recommendation systems, and decision intelligence; test relevant methods and contribute reusable approaches and best practices across GSDS.

**Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance).
* 2+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Advanced Analytics, or a related quantitative field.
* Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, or similar analytical tools, with experience building machine learning models such as tree-based models, regression/classification models, clustering, or related techniques.
* Exposure to LLMs, GenAI, or modern deep-learning approaches and a strong interest in developing expertise in emerging AI capabilities.
* Strong analytical and conceptual thinking with the ability to solve unstructured and complex business problems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on exposure to Agentic AI/agentic frameworks, transformer architectures, transformer-based recommendation systems, Conversational AI, LLM applications, embeddings, or semantic modeling.
* Experience with personalization, recommendation systems, next-best-action, optimization, experimentation, or customer decisioning problems.
* Experience processing and analyzing large-scale structured or unstructured datasets and translating models into scalable analytical solutions.
* Familiarity with model/AI evaluation, productionization, monitoring, or MLOps/LLMOps concepts.
* Curiosity about customer servicing and the ability to connect technical work to measurable customer and business outcomes.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
  
  
**About The Team**
We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
  
  

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

title: Growth Specialist
description:
**Growth Marketer — Masrah Films Pvt. Ltd.**

**📍 Rohini Sector-7, Delhi (Onsite) | 🕐 Full-Time**

**About Masrah Films**

Masrah Films is a multi-disciplinary creative agency working across branding, advertising, content, social media, production, influencer marketing, and digital solutions. We're looking for a Growth Marketer who can understand audiences, identify growth opportunities, and turn research into measurable results.

**The Role**

As a Growth Marketer, you'll work across market research, audience and community targeting, paid advertising, competitor analysis, and growth strategy.You should be someone who doesn't just ask “What should we post?” but “Who are we targeting, why will they care, and how do we turn that attention into growth?”

**What You'll Do**

• Research target audiences, communities, markets, and customer behaviour.

• Identify and analyse relevant online communities and potential customer segments.

• Conduct competitor and market research to identify opportunities.

• Assist in planning, running, and optimising Meta Ads and other paid campaigns.

• Track campaign performance and identify what's working and what's not.

• Develop audience-targeting and lead-generation strategies.

• Work with the creative team to develop performance-driven content and ad creatives.

• Monitor trends, platforms, and emerging growth opportunities.

• Analyse data and turn insights into actionable growth strategies.

• Track key metrics such as CPL, CTR, conversion rates, engagement, and ROI.

• SEO knowledge is a strong advantage.

**What We're Looking For**

• 1–4 years of experience in growth marketing, digital marketing, performance marketing, research, or a related field.

• Strong understanding of audience research and community targeting.

• Hands-on knowledge of Meta Ads / paid advertising.

• Strong research and analytical thinking.

• Ability to understand data and make decisions from it.

• Good understanding of marketing funnels and customer journeys.

• Strong curiosity about consumer behaviour, brands, and digital trends.

• SEO knowledge/experience is a plus.

• Good communication and presentation skills.

• Proactive, experimental, and comfortable testing new ideas.

• Ability to work closely with creative, sales, and strategy teams.

**The Ideal Person**

We're looking for someone who is curious, analytical, experimental, and commercially minded. Someone who can research an audience, find a growth opportunity, test an idea through ads, and analyse the results instead of relying on assumptions.

**If you love figuring out why people click, engage, convert, and buy — you'll fit right in at Masrah.**

title: Apparel Senior Analyst – Merchandising & Product
description:
**About the job**

**Senior Analyst – Merchandising & Product**

**Industry: Merchandising & Product Analytics – Apparel**

**Function: Analytics & Business Intelligence | Shared Services (4 apparel brands)**

**Employment Type: Contract**

**Experience: 4–7 years**

**Reporting To: Head of Analytics**

**Work Mode : Remote**

**We are seeking a Senior Analyst – Merchandising & Product to support merchandising and planning decisions across four U.S. apparel brands. The role combines hands-on merchandise analysis with the development of repeatable reporting and business intelligence solutions.**

**What you will do**

**·        Analyze sales and product performance by style, color and size, including sell-through, size curves and assortment productivity.**

**·        Support open-to-buy (OTB) planning, receipt flow, on-order tracking and plan-versus-actual analysis.**

**·        Monitor inventory productivity, weeks of supply, stock turn, aging inventory and markdown exposure.**

**·        Analyze gross-to-net margin, including landed costs, promotions, markdowns and returns; reconcile reporting with Finance.**

**·        Evaluate return rates and reasons to support product development and size-curve decisions.**

title: Principal Analyst (Equity or Investment research, Technology research)
description:
**What makes Gartner Research a GREAT fit for you?**
When you join Gartner Research, you’ll be part of a leading-edge team that values expert insights, bold ideas and intellectual courage. You’ll deliver must-have research and contribute to our double-digit growth by providing our clients worldwide the unbiased insight they need to make the right decisions on their key initiatives. Our culture demands hard work — and rewards it with exceptional opportunity. If you are intellectually curious and principally motivated by ideas, Gartner is looking for you.
  
  
**About this role:**
Gartner is searching for an India-based Principal Analyst to join our global Invest Practice, serving our Venture Capital, Private Equity, Public Equity, and Investment Banking clients withing our Emerging Technology research group. Operating as a critical engine in Gartner’s 24/7 "follow-the-sun" model (NY–London–India), you will track daily investment activities, decode early-stage tech innovations, and rapidly synthesize Gartner's proprietary research into tailored, high-impact deliverables for Invest Analysts and sales-led initiatives. This individual will work on a wide range of written deliverables. The specialist must be interested in all types of technology innovation and combine strong business and financial acumen with an agile mindset: immersing yourself in one technology trend today, and seamlessly pivoting to the next to match the market's relentless pace. This role is a key feeder to careers reaching the highest levels of Gartner.
  
  
**What you will do:**
▪
**Track Daily Invest Activity & Enable Follow-the-Sun Suppor**
t: Monitor global financial and market developments daily across Venture Capital, Private Equity, Public Equity, and Investment Banking to support Gartner’s 24/7 global delivery model (NY–London–India).
  
  
▪
**Curate & Customize Content for Invest Analysts**
: Translate and tailor Gartner’s technology research, market data, and insights into high-impact, actionable deliverables as well as lead author publications tailored specifically for Invest Analysts and clients.
  
  
▪
**Fuel Sales-Led & Timely Content Creation**
: Leverage business and economic acumen to rapidly identify relevant and timely published research for Invest clients that support sales initiatives.
  
  
▪
**Partner Across Global Stakeholder Teams**
: Collaborate seamlessly with core Invest analyst team and leadership to ensure timely delivery.
  
  
**Who you are:**
We are looking for creative, analytically sharp, articulate, and self-motivated individuals who want to build a career tracking emerging technology signals and translating them into actionable intelligence for the investment community. You possess a strong passion for tech innovation, early-stage startups, and financial markets, with a keen interest in how emerging trends impact Venture Capital, Private Equity, Public Equity, and Investment Banking.
  
  
Unlike traditional buy-side/sell-side finance, investment banking, or management consulting, our strategic research positions do not depend on deal sourcing or business development targets. Our search for talent centers on your ability to track daily market activity, analyze emerging tech innovations, and deliver rigorous, customized insights that power our 24/7 global delivery model.
  
  
Key characteristics of successful hires include:
  
  

* Strong Business & Tech Acumen: A deep appetite to track investment activities daily and explore early-stage tech trends to extract high-value market insights.
* Analytical & Customization Capabilities: Ability to gather, analyze, and restructure complex qualitative and quantitative data to tailor Gartner content specifically for Invest Analysts and sales-led initiatives.
* Precision Communication: Exceptional written and oral communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex market and technology concepts clearly, logically, and persuasively.
* Agility Under Fast-Paced Conditions: Proven competence in meeting tight daily deadlines, multi-tasking across dynamic market trends, and delivering high-quality work in a "follow-the-sun" global workflow.
* Continuous Curiosity & Ownership: A drive to constantly learn, adapt to shifting market signals, and take self-motivated ownership of research deliverables.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Education: Master’s degree (Business, Economics, Finance, MBA, or Technology-related field) or PhD preferred.
* Experience: 5-8 years of experience in market research, equity/investment research (highly preferred), corporate strategy, or management consulting within the technology or financial services sectors.
* Methodology: Proven expertise in qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, data synthesis, and insight generation.
* Domain Knowledge: General understanding of financial markets, investment lifecycles, and emerging technology ecosystems.

**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
  
  
**What do we offer?**
Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
  
  
In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
  
  
Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: Sr Game Mathematician I
description:
At Aristocrat, we believe in bringing happiness to life through the power of play! As a world leader in gaming content and technology, our mission is to build outstanding gaming experiences that captivate and entertain millions around the globe. We are looking for an ambitious and hardworking Sr Game Mathematician I to join our versatile team. This role is pivotal to our success, ensuring our games are not only fun but also mathematically sound and engaging. If you are passionate about gaming, mathematics, and innovation, this is an outstanding and exciting chance to create a significant impact!
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Develop and construct mathematical models for slot games and other gaming products.
* Build, develop, and document mathematical models for slot and instant-win games.
* Build pay tables, probability models, and simulations to define return to player, volatility, and hit frequency.
* Analyze game performance and player behavior to refine game mechanics.
* Continuously optimize game performance using data-driven insights.
* Collaborate closely with game designers, engineers, and artists to implement mathematical concepts.
* Ensure smooth and accurate integration of mathematical models into game engines.
* Conduct detailed testing and debugging to maintain high-quality standards.
* Support QA teams in validating game outcomes against encouraged mathematical results.
* Communicate complex mathematical concepts clearly to non-technical team members.
* Participate in brainstorming sessions to contribute to new game ideas.
* Stay updated with industry trends and improve existing approaches.
* Document all mathematical models and processes clearly for future reference.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior team members.

What We're Looking For
  
  

* proven experience in game mathematics or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of probability theory, statistics, and combinatorics.
* Experience with simulation tools such as Python, C++, Excel, or similar.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Good communication skills to explain complex concepts in simple terms.
* Attention to detail and ability to work within timelines.
* Understanding of gaming regulations and compliance standards.

**Preferred**

* Experience working on Class II games is an added advantage.
* Advanced degree or equivalent experience in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or related field.
* Proven track record of delivering successful game projects.

Цялото окончателно съдържание, изискванията за длъжността и решенията за наемане остават предмет на преглед и одобрение от Aristocrat.*
**Философия на възнаграждението**
Предлагаме цялостен пакет от възнаграждения и придобивки, създаден да остане конкурентен на пазара, да подкрепя вашето благосъстояние и да признава приноса ви към нашия успех. Нашият подход се основава на принципа за възнаграждение според представянето, като насърчава и възнаграждава индивидуалния принос. title: Delivery AI Product Analyst
description:

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As an Analyst in BCG X Product Delivery, you will support the delivery of projects and digital solutions for clients across the oil & gas, refining, chemicals, and broader energy value chain. You will work at the intersection of business strategy, operations, and technology, helping teams translate operational challenges into practical, high-impact solutions.
  
  
You will support the analysis of client problems, identification of value opportunities, and design of use cases across areas such as refining performance, planning and scheduling, margin optimization, emissions reduction, turnaround management, maintenance, reliability, and operational excellence.
  
  
You will work closely with BCG case teams, BCG X product and technical teams, and client stakeholders. Your responsibilities may include supporting client interviews and workshops, conducting diagnostics and analyses, sizing value opportunities, developing business cases, and contributing to roadmaps and change management activities.
  
  
You will also help translate strategic and operational priorities into clear solution requirements and support the development of reusable assets, industry perspectives, commercial materials, and delivery playbooks.

* Analyzing complex business and operational problems and breaking them into structured components.
* Conducting quantitative and qualitative analyses to identify performance improvement and value opportunities.
* Supporting problem solving across oil & gas, refining, chemicals, energy, and other asset-intensive industries.
* Working effectively with consulting, product, technical, and client teams to gather inputs and develop solutions.
* Translating operational challenges and analytical findings into clear insights and digital solution requirements.
* Supporting value sizing across areas such as margin optimization, planning and scheduling, maintenance, reliability, emissions, and operational excellence.
* Synthesizing data, interviews, workshops, and technical inputs into clear analyses, presentations, and recommendations.

#BCGXjob

title: Senior Lead Engineer - Data Science
description:
**Role Overview:**

We are seeking for Senior Lead Engineer - Data Science for building end-to-end AI systems, spanning traditional machine learning, Generative AI (LLMs, Diffusion Models), and Agentic AI architectures (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) along with good experience with fine tuning, computer vision frameworks such as OpenCV. * Building framework for reducing Agent hallucinations, low latency and reliable output
* RAG pipelines with semantic chunking, hybrid retrieval, and context injection.
* Implement vector indexing (FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate) with hybrid search.
* Own LLMOps stack: prompt versioning, evaluation, monitoring, and drift detection.
* Develop and optimize deep learning models for computer vision tasks such as Image classification/Face Authentication

Technical Delivery & Innovation

* Build GenAI applications serving organisational use cases and reduce human dependencies
* Model serving with vLLM, Triton; use of async inference and caching.

Team Leadership & Execution

* Ensure CI/CD, modular ML design, containerization.
* Collaborate with Product and Research to align business outcomes.

Python, TypeScript, SQL, optionally Go/Rust

PyTorch, HuggingFace, LangChain/LangGraph, OpenAI APIs, llama.cpp, OpenCV

: MLflow, LangSmith, BentoML, Weights & Biases

: Docker, Kubernetes, Ray, AWS/GCP

: FAISS, Qdrant, Weaviate, Elasticsearch

* 7+ years in ML/AI; 2+ years in leadership.
* Production experience with GenAI and agent-based systems.
* Deep understanding of LLMs, embeddings, attention, prompt engineering.
* Experience with scalable AI infra and high-throughput serving.
* Strong experience in building CV pipelines for classification, detection and face recognition
* Building end-to-end AI systems, spanning traditional machine learning, Generative AI (LLMs,Diffusion Models), and Agentic AI architectures (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen)
* Strong fundamentals in Machine Learning, Deep Learning and Generative AI

title: Director-Data Science
description:
**Job Description**
**Director – Data Science, Global Servicing Decision Science**
**About The Team**
The Global Servicing Decision Science (GSDS) team is the Decision Science engine for Global Servicing, bringing together advanced analytics, data science, AI/GenAI, and decisioning to transform servicing experiences, empower colleagues, and enable intelligent operations. GSDS serves as a centralized Decision Science Center of Excellence, partnering across Product/Capabilities, Control Management, Strategy, Operations, Technology, and enterprise analytics and data science teams.
  
  
GSDS builds and scales servicing intelligence across Global Servicing—from predictive and proactive servicing, personalization, next-best-action and journey orchestration to conversational AI, agent assist, AI-powered coaching, conduct and quality monitoring, and complaint and dispute intelligence. Our mandate is to build durable, production-ready capabilities that continuously improve decisions through prediction, recommendation, optimization, experimentation, and learning.
  
  
**How will you make an impact in this role?**
As Director, you will define and lead the vision, strategy, and execution of Decision Science across Global Servicing, translating complex customer and business challenges into scalable intelligence capabilities that improve customer experience, colleague effectiveness, operational efficiency, membership value, and controls.
  
  
This is a highly visible leadership role requiring deep analytical rigor, strong technical and AI expertise, strategic problem-solving, commercial acumen, and enterprise leadership. You will lead a high-performing team of data science professionals and partner across Global Servicing and the enterprise to embed intelligent decisioning into servicing experiences and processes.
  
  
You will also help shape the next generation of servicing Decision Science—advancing capabilities such as Agentic AI, transformer-based recommendation systems, and Conversational AI while ensuring solutions are production-ready, measurable, governed, and continuously improving.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**GSDS Strategy & Business Impact**

* Define and lead the Decision Science roadmap across Global Servicing, identifying and prioritizing high-impact opportunities across servicing experiences, membership value and engagement, colleague efficiency, and operational excellence.
* Translate business strategy into clear Decision Science priorities, success measures, and investment choices, connecting technical opportunities to measurable customer and business outcomes.

**AI / GenAI & Decision Science Leadership**

* Provide technical leadership across AI/ML, GenAI, prediction, recommendation, optimization, experimentation, and learning, setting a high bar for solution design, evaluation, and analytical rigor.
* Drive the evolution of GSDS toward emerging AI paradigms, including Agentic AI and multi-agent workflows, transformer-based recommenders and representation learning, and Conversational AI/LLM-based systems that can reason over context and support increasingly intelligent servicing decisions.
* Maintain sufficient technical depth to challenge architectures, modeling choices, evaluation frameworks, and trade-offs, and to guide teams from experimentation through scalable production deployment.

**Scalable Decisioning Products & Production AI**

* Oversee development of reusable, production-ready data science products and decisioning systems that leverage customer, behavioral, contextual, and operational data to enable timely and personalized decisions.
* Partner with Technology, platform, and governance teams to deploy and evolve AI solutions with appropriate architecture, observability, controls, model/AI quality, and lifecycle discipline.

**Leadership, Talent & Enterprise Influence**

* Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of data science professionals, fostering technical excellence, first-principles problem solving, innovation, ownership, and strong commercial judgment.
* Build organizational capability across Applied GenAI, AI engineering and architecture, advanced recommendation and decisioning methods, strategic problem solving, and commercial storytelling.
* Influence senior stakeholders and build strong cross-functional accountability, using clear and compelling narratives to drive prioritization, investment decisions, adoption, and execution of major Decision Science initiatives.

**Innovation & Future-Focused Capability Building**

* Continuously evaluate advances in AI and Decision Science and translate the most relevant methods into practical, scalable capabilities and reusable best practices for Global Servicing.
* Shape a forward-looking technical roadmap that strengthens GSDS capabilities in Agentic AI, Conversational AI, modern recommendation systems, experimentation, AI engineering, architecture, governance, and continuous optimization.

**Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelors degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics).
* Exceptional analytical and conceptual problem-solving ability, with experience structuring and solving complex, ambiguous business challenges using first-principles thinking.
* Proven leadership experience managing and developing high-performing analytics or data science teams in a complex, cross-functional environment.
* Strong technical foundation in modern data science and AI, with the ability to guide solution design, challenge technical approaches, and connect analytical choices to business outcomes.
* Strong ability to influence senior stakeholders through clear, structured, and compelling communication and executive storytelling.
* Experience driving large-scale analytics, Decision Science, or AI initiatives from concept through production, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
* Strong commercial acumen and storytelling, with the ability to connect technical strategy, architecture and investment choices to measurable business value.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics).
* Technical exposure to or experience driving modern AI capabilities such as Agentic AI/agentic workflows, transformer architectures and transformer-based recommendation systems, Conversational AI, LLMs, and advanced personalization or next-best-action systems.
* Strong understanding of the end-to-end Decision Science and AI lifecycle, including experimentation, model/AI evaluation, decision logic and orchestration, productionization, monitoring, governance, and continuous optimization.
* Track record of building scalable data products, recommendation/decisioning systems, or AI-driven capabilities with measurable customer, revenue, productivity, cost, or control outcomes.
* Experience driving transformation from traditional analytics toward AI-powered, productized Decision Science capabilities and reusable enterprise solutions.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
**Who You’ll Work With**
This position works as a member of software development team focused exclusively on building and supporting Bain’s most strategic internal data. Team members work collaboratively to design, build and implement new features and functionality in their systems aimed at delivering the most value to Bain’s global users and supporting key business initiatives.
  
  
**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM**
This position works as a member of Bain’s internal Software Development group directly supervising and supporting the Data engineers on a team. Individuals in this role would also be responsible for defining the on-going technical roadmap for the team and influencing the choice of technologies and frameworks implemented by the engineers.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Technical Delivery (50%)**

* Lead a scrum team developing and updating applications
* Lead the planning, testing and implementation of all production releases. Coordinate production releases between scrum teams across the product. Work with System Architect, Data Architect and engineering team members for the configuration and implementation of DevOps and Continues Integration.
* Encourage DevOps mindset within the engineering team and facilitates lean production, continuous integration and continuous deployment while working with the System Architect and engineering team members.
* Support the team in the evaluation and selection process of the 3rd part components/libraries/ tools together with the Systems Architect and Data Architect.
* Provide ongoing support for applications already in use. This includes problem diagnosis and resolution, ad hoc reporting support and database administration.
* Provide frequent updates regarding development issues to the TSG leadership and other groups as appropriate.
* Participate in product level Steering Committee meetings as appropriate.
* Provide technical leadership and facilitate cross-team communication across multiple product scrum teams.
* Ensure the proposed technical approaches meet the functional requirements and are in coordination with similar activities across the other product scrum teams. Provide guidance to the scrum team determining the need for new technologies based on the product backlog.

**Team management (25%)**

* Manage and supervise between 3-6 direct reports within the development team. These individuals are typically working on the team they directly support. Responsible for the individuals’ PD and career development.

title: Analyst, Lead Exposure
description:
WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across India’s national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments — supporting the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.
  
  
As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of India’s health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCF’s effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors.
  
  
Our work is built around four complementary roles as a Trusted Government Partner, co-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on-the-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale.
  
  
WJCF’s programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases), syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri - Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance, and climate and health.
  
  
We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub-district levels.
  
  
Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.
  
  
WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.
  
  
Programme Overview
  
  
Lead poisoning is one of India's most significant and most solvable public health challenges. India bears the world's highest burden of childhood lead poisoning, with over 275 million children carry blood lead levels above 5 µg/dL; the national average is 6.2 µg/dL and 23 States exceed the threshold (NITI Aayog and CSIR review, 2022). Lead exposure causes irreversible neurological damage in children, contributes to an estimated one million cardiovascular deaths annually in adults (Larsen et al., 2023), and generates compounding intergenerational risks.
  
  
National Center for Disease Control, as the designated national focal agency under MoHFW, is establishing the National Biomonitoring Programme for Chemical Toxicants (NBPCT). WJCF is embedding a Technical Support Unit (TSU) to serve as the coordination backbone for India's lead mitigation response. This embedded model builds directly on WJCF's track record of high-impact TSU engagements across TB, vector-borne diseases, oxygen, surveillance, and health insurance.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
We are seeking a motivated and analytically rigorous individual to serve as a core member of WJCF's embedded TSU. The incumbent will provide day-to-day technical, coordination, and secretariat support to government counterparts translating high-level intent into structured operational workplans, facilitating inter-ministerial coordination, and helping anchor governance architecture that outlasts individual donor cycles.
  
  
The role demands both policy acumen to navigate a complex multi-stakeholder environment and operational discipline to ensure consistent follow-through. The incumbent will report to the TSU Lead and will function under the programmatic guidance of NCDC for TSU activities.
  
  
**Location**
New Delhi (embedded at NCDC / MoHFW)
  
  
**Travel**
Domestic travel to programme states as required
  
  
TSU Secretariat and Programme Operations
  
  

* Provide day-to-day secretariat support to NCDC for the NBPCT, including preparation of meeting agendas, data-backed workplans, activity plans, and meeting charters across surveillance, capacity building, and enforcement priorities.
* Support NCDC's National Lead Technical Working Group through data synthesis, expert inputs, documentation, and follow-up mechanisms that convert deliberations into actionable outcomes.
* Support integration of state and laboratory surveillance data into the Integrated Health Information Platform (IHIP) and contribute to dashboard and visualisation design for NCDC decision-making.
* Strengthen NCDC's capacity for data-backed decision-making in hotspot identification, laboratory and referral infrastructure mapping, and partner coordination.
* Consolidate and disseminate learnings from state-level engagement through regional and national workshops.
* Support the Programme in convening and facilitating inter-ministerial consultations on lead and chemical toxicants across environment, industry, labour, food safety, water, and mines ministries.
* Prepare technical inputs, briefing materials, and correspondence for senior decision-making within the ministry.

Programme Planning and Monitoring
  
  

* Develop and maintain workplan trackers and milestone dashboards to monitor progress against grant commitments and government-agreed deliverables.
* Support development of costed annual workplans and embed these into the programme's operational budgeting cycle.
* Prepare high-quality progress reports, briefing notes, and strategy documents for donors and government counterparts.

State-Level Engagement
  
  

* Lead WJCF's engagement in focal states in coordination with NCDC and state health departments, tailoring activities to each state's readiness and existing ecosystem.
* Support state-level surveillance system strengthening and feed learnings back into the national platform for wider uptake.
* Facilitate alignment between state health and environment departments on lead-related priorities.

Stakeholder and Partner Management
  
  

* Build and maintain relationships with NCDC, MoHFW senior officials, state health departments, CPCB, FSSAI, and development partners including WHO, UNICEF, Pure Earth, Vital Strategies, and others active in the lead ecosystem.
* Support advocacy efforts in collaboration with strategic partners, ensuring technical assistance and policy advocacy are complementary.

**Required**

* Postgraduate degree in public health, public policy, environmental science, health management, development studies, or a related field.
* Minimum 2 years of relevant experience
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and quantitative modeling skills
* Ability to build collaborative relationship with internal and external stakeholders, including more senior-level individuals
* Ability to drive forward assigned workstreams effectively (e.g., through thoughtful work planning, priority setting, stakeholder engagement, etc.)
* Entrepreneurial mindset, ability to work independently in ambiguous, semi-structured environments.
* High level of proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word

**Preferred**

* Experience in environmental health, chemical toxicants, or occupational health programme areas.
* Professional proficiency in Hindi.

To Apply
  
  
Please send your CV and a cover note of not more than one page. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.
  
  
***Last date to Apply 8 November, 2026***

title: Decision Scientist Intern
description:
**1. About The India Prosperity Initiative (TIPI)**

The India Prosperity Initiative (TIPI) is an objective and non-partisan initiative committed to advancing pervasive prosperity across Indian society. TIPI views prosperity as extending beyond material abundance to encompass the resources, opportunities, capabilities, and societal conditions that enable individuals and communities to realise their potential.

TIPI seeks to deepen the understanding of prosperity in India through rigorous, multidisciplinary, and evidence-based research, using data and insights from diverse sources. It emphasises intellectual rigour, audacity of ideas and methods, collaboration, and trust.

The Initiative aims to generate actionable insights, evaluate solutions, and translate evidence into meaningful action on issues shaping India’s long-term prosperity.

**2. About the Role**

You will join The India Prosperity Initiative as a Decision Scientist Intern, supporting research and analytical projects through data analysis, statistical modelling, visualisation, and data management. The role will involve working across the data lifecycle, from identifying and preparing relevant datasets to analysing data and translating findings into clear, actionable insights. You will work closely with project teams to support evidence-based research and contribute to high-quality analytical outputs across initiatives.

**● Data Analysis, Statistical Modelling, and Predictive Analytics:**

You will work with structured and unstructured datasets to identify patterns, trends, relationships, and insights using statistical and machine learning techniques. You will support the development of analytical models, performance metrics, benchmarks, and predictive frameworks, while exploring emerging approaches in data science and statistical analysis.

●
**Data Preparation, Cleaning, and Validation:**

You will support the preparation of raw datasets into analysis-ready formats through systematic data cleaning, transformation, harmonisation, and organisation. You will conduct data quality checks to identify inconsistencies, missing values, errors, and anomalies and ensure the reliability of analytical outputs.

**● Data Visualisation and Dashboards:**

You will develop charts, visualisations, and dashboards to communicate complex analytical findings clearly and effectively. You will work with tools such as Python, R, Excel, Tableau, and Power BI to present data and analytical results in an accessible manner.

**● Economic and Socio-Economic Data Analysis:**

You will work with economic, demographic, social, and other datasets to support research on issues relevant to India’s development and prosperity. This will involve understanding key indicators, identifying credible data sources, analysing multi-year and cross-regional datasets, and interpreting findings in their broader context.

**● Data Tools and Database Management:**

You will use tools such as Python, R, MS Excel / Google Sheets, and SQL for data analysis and management. You will support the retrieval, organisation, updating, and analysis of datasets from multiple sources. Familiarity with databases and structured data systems will be an advantage.

**● Research Support and Documentation:**

You will support project teams in developing analytical frameworks, conducting quantitative analysis, and preparing research outputs. You will maintain clear documentation of datasets, methodologies, analytical approaches, and sources to support transparency and reproducibility.

**● Collaboration and Learning:**

You will work closely with researchers and project teams to understand analytical requirements, communicate findings, and contribute to project deliverables. The role will provide an opportunity to apply data science skills to real-world challenges affecting India’s development while building an understanding of how quantitative evidence can inform better decisions.

This role is well-suited for a student or early-career candidate with a strong interest in data science, statistics, and applied research. It is ideal for individuals who enjoy working with data and are motivated to apply analytical skills to real-world challenges that contribute to India’s long-term prosperity and development.

**3. Role Benefits**

● Reimbursements in line with organisational travel policies and applicable norms, where relevant. ● Hands-on experience working with real-world datasets and applied data science projects.

● Exposure to researchers, experts, policymakers, and institutional stakeholders.

● Opportunity to apply statistical and analytical methods to projects relevant to India’s development and prosperity.

● Mentorship and practical experience in data analysis, modelling, visualisation, and research.

● Opportunity to contribute to high-impact projects with potential for real-world application.

**4. Eligibility Criteria**

● Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree, preferably in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Econometrics, Computer Science, or another quantitative discipline.

● Strong academic exposure to statistics, quantitative methods, or data analysis.

● Familiarity with analysing and working with structured datasets using statistical or data science methods.

● Working knowledge of Python or R; familiarity with SQL will be an advantage.

● Familiarity with data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Python/R visualisation libraries will be an advantage.

● Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to approach complex problems systematically.

● Strong attention to detail and ability to communicate analytical findings clearly.

● Interest in India’s development, socio-economic issues, research, and data-driven decision-making. Exposure to public policy or socio-economic research through academic or project work will be an advantage.

**5. Role location**

This is a full-time, in-office internship based in Gurugram, Haryana. The role may involve travel for project activities, institutional engagements, meetings, and other initiatives as required.

January,2027- June,2027.

• 1-3 years of experience in Growth Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Business Analytics, Product Analytics or a similar data-driven role.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into business recommendations.

• Comfortable working with data from multiple sources and collaborating across Marketing and Sales teams.

• Strong communication, stakeholder management and attention to detail.

• High ownership, curiosity and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**Good to have**

**Why Join Us?**

•

Work on growth problems that directly influence how thousands of learners discover and access better education.

•
**High-Growth Learning Environment -**

**Build the Future of Education -**
Be part of a mission-driven team transforming business education for the digital and AI-first world.

**About Company**

Digiaccel Learning is reimagining management education for a digital and AI-first world. The institute is committed to developing future-ready business leaders by combining academic rigor with practical, industry-focused learning experiences. With a learner-centric philosophy, industry driven curriculum, experiential learning opportunities, and deep engagement with corporate leaders, Altera equips learners with the skills, capabilities, and mindset required to thrive in today's rapidly evolving business landscape.

With a learner-centric philosophy, industry-driven curriculum, experiential learning opportunities, and deep engagement with corporate leaders, Altera equips learners with the skills, capabilities, and mindset required to thrive in today's rapidly evolving business landscape.

title: Senior Specialist, Strategy Pricing & Interchange
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
Senior Specialist, Strategy Pricing & Interchange
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
Mastercard is seeking a highly analytical and commercially minded professional to join the RAISE Value Quantification team within Strategy Pricing & Interchange. This role will help shape how Mastercard translates product, service, and customer value into scalable pricing strategies, business cases, and decision-ready analytics.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in predictive modeling, machine learning, pricing analytics, and data science, combined with the ability to influence commercial decisions. The role partners closely with Product, Pricing, Commercialization, Data Science, and regional teams to build value-based pricing models, quantify customer impact, and support growth-oriented pricing decisions across Mastercard.
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Predictive Modeling and Explainability
* Design and build predictive models that quantify the economic, operational, and customer value of Mastercard products and services.
* Measure revenue, cost savings, efficiency, risk reduction, and customer impact to inform pricing and commercialization decisions.
* Translate model outputs into clear value stories, commercial insights, and business cases.
* Pricing Analytics & Modeling
* Develop value-based B2B pricing models, commercial frameworks, and analytical tools that support product pricing and go-to-market strategy.
* Estimate adoption, revenue impact, customer economics, churn elasticity, and outcome-based scenarios.
* Run pricing scenarios and sensitivity analyses to guide strategic trade-offs and executive decision-making.
* Machine Learning & Advanced Analytics
* Apply machine learning, statistical techniques, and advanced analytics to identify pricing opportunities, customer value drivers, and performance trends.
* Analyze large datasets and prepare structured inputs for predictive modeling.
* Build forecasts and analytical outputs that support pricing strategy, product planning, and performance management.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Education
  
  

* Master's degree in quantitative fields such as Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Finance, Mathematics, Computer Science, or Operations Research.

* 6-8 years of experience in data science and pricing analytics with demonstrated experience building predictive models, pricing models, business case frameworks, or value quantification methodologies.
* Proven ability to analyze large, complex datasets and convert analytical findings into business recommendations.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to commercial and senior stakeholder audiences.

Must-Have Technical Skills
  
  

* Strong working knowledge of predictive modeling, machine learning, forecasting, statistics, and model explainability.
* Proficiency in Python, including Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, and Statsmodels.
* Advanced SQL skills for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.

Must-Have Business & Pricing Skills
  
  

* Experience with pricing elasticity, revenue optimization, customer economics, financial modeling, or commercial strategy.
* Understanding of value-based pricing principles and how analytical insights inform commercial decision-making.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to link data, insights, and business impact.

Must-Have Professional Skills
  
  

* Excellent communication, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior leaders.
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Curiosity, learning agility, and innovation mindset.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced Excel skills, including financial modeling, Power Query, and analytical modeling.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

This is an opportunity to join Mastercard's Strategy Pricing & Interchange team in a high-impact role that combines advanced analytics, pricing strategy, and commercial influence.
  
  
Strategic Impact
  
  
Shape value-based pricing strategies that influence product decisions, customer economics, and commercialization outcomes across Mastercard. You will use data science, machine learning, and predictive modeling to solve complex commercial challenges using rich payments data.
  
  
Collaborative Culture
  
  
Work across Pricing, Product, Commercialization, Data Science, and regional teams in a culture that values curiosity, collaboration, analytical rigor, and continuous learning.

Gain exposure to global stakeholders, senior leaders, and high-visibility initiatives while building deep expertise in pricing strategy, value quantification, and advanced analytics.

title: Capital Modelling Analyst
description:
Gurgaon, Haryana, India
  
  
AXA XL is the Property & Casualty risk division of AXA, created from the acquisition of XL Catlin in 2018. We partner with mid-sized to multinational clients to take their business further, with more than 30 lines of business to offer solutions for existing and emerging risks. With 9,000+ colleagues based in approximately 30 countries we can serve clients in more than 200 countries. The key purpose of the role is to support the Capital Modelling team in its coding, data transformation and modelling needs.
  
  
**What You’ll Be DOING**
What will your essential responsibilities include?
  
  
**Capital Modelling**

* Support the calibration, running, maintenance, development and validation of the Internal Model across AXA UK (Health, Personal Lines & Commercial lines). The principal tool used is ReMetrica.
* Support the production of insurance risk assumptions calibrations for AXA UK
* Support the development and maintenance of the Internal model to ensure compliance with the risk measurement requirements evolving within local regulatory rules
* Develop and maintain loss forecasting risk models
* Working in advance R/Python in in development of risk models and to visualise and understand risk distributions and interpret / translate to impact on the business
* Manage the processing of detailed financial accounting data into a suitable format for entry into the capital models
* Participate and contribute to group working parties and develop appropriate model evolution plans for implementation
* Assist in meeting regulatory and other requirements to secure ongoing approval for the AXA UK components of the internal model used for capital assessment
* Other ad-hoc tasks requiring coding expertise

**Risk Management**

* Ensure an effective insurance risk management system which complies with Group and Local policy requirements and those of the regulator.
* Supporting the capital assessment process – see above.
* Assisting in the development and embedding of capital-related Insurance and Health risk appetites within AXA UK.
* Ensure compliance with relevant policies
* Incorporating profitability measures within the business in line with solvency and other business requirements

**Reinsurance Arrangements**

* Assist Capital leads in the review of the annual reinsurance process by performing analysis to determine whether risk transfer arrangements are efficient and optimal.

**Actuarial Research and Development**

* Deliver appropriate actuarial analysis and research to support business goals and drive strategy as may be requested from time to time
* Collaborate with other colleagues in the wider Capital Team & Actuarial Function on latest developments.

**Internal Financial Control (IFC), Internal Model Review (IMR) and External Validation**

* Ensure processes and controls are undertaken and evidenced appropriately in a timely manner.

You will report to Vice President, Group Services.
  
  
**What You Will BRING**
We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:
  
  
**Required Skills And Abilities**

* Progress in actuarial exams is desirable but not mandatory
* Highly numerate and analytical with good academic record (preferably IIT/IIIT),
* Some Python, R and SQL coding and algorithms skills
* Excellent mathematics skills with a good understanding of probability distributions. Basic understanding of copulas would be a plus.
* Understanding of modelling techniques such as regression, classification and basic frequency severity loss forecasting techniques
* Ability to design, undertake and communicate analyses under supervision from more experienced technical specialists
* Excellent data management and transformation skills
* Ability to work across functional teams

**Desired Skills And Abilities**

* Knowledge of ReMetrica beneficial but not essential
* Some basic accounting concepts for GAAP/IFRS would be a plus
* Curious, inquisitive, innovative and open to new ideas.
* Excellent attention to detail
* Good verbal and written communication skills
* A self-supported with effective organizational skills
* Experience of working for a general insurer or health insurer
* Knowledge of reserving and / or pricing, which is beneficial to capital modelling decisions

**Who WE Are**
AXA XL, the P&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.
  
  
How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty.
  
  
With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.
  
  
Learn more at axaxl.com
  
  
**What we OFFER**
**Inclusion**
AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential.
*It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed.*

* Five Business Resource Groups focused on gender, LGBTQ+, ethnicity and origins, disability and inclusion with 20 Chapters around the globe.
* Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements
* Enhanced family-friendly leave benefits
* Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index
* Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter

Learn more at axaxl.com/about-us/inclusion-and-diversity. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
  
  
**Total Rewards**
AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do.
  
  
We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.
  
  
**Sustainability**
At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.
  
  
**Our Pillars**

* Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems - the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans.
* Addressing climate change: The effects of a changing climate are far-reaching and significant. Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal-led solutions.
* Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting.
* AXA Hearts in Action: We have established volunteering and charitable giving programs to help colleagues support causes that matter most to them, known as AXA XL’s “Hearts in Action” programs. These include our Matching Gifts program, Volunteering Leave, and our annual volunteering day – the Global Day of Giving.

For more information, please see axaxl.com/sustainability.
