title: Senior Capital Specialist
description:
Gurgaon, Haryana, India
  
  
AXA XL is the Property & Casualty risk division of AXA, created from the acquisition of XL Catlin in 2018. We partner with mid-sized to multinational clients to take their business further, with more than 30 lines of business to offer solutions for existing and emerging risks. With 9,000+ colleagues based in approximately 30 countries; we can serve clients in more than 200 countries. The key purpose of this role is to support the SDL Actuarial Risk in ensuring that the risk profile of AXA XL Division is adequately modelled and communicated via an internal capital model that reflects the SII and BMA standards.
  
  
**What You’ll Be DOING**
What will your essential responsibilities include?
  
  
**Capital Modelling**

* Lead elements of the calibration, running, maintenance, development and validation of the Internal Model across AXA UK (Health, Personal Lines & Commercial lines). The principal tool used is ReMetrica.
* Review model code and make amendments as necessary.
* Manage receipt of actual, forecast and planning data for capital modelling and communicate with stakeholders to ensure consistency of use.
* Review and justify appropriateness of model inputs and outputs.
* Run analysis of change, investigating and justifying results.
* Contribute materially to Solvency Data Quality reporting, ensuring standards are met, and be a role model for embedding a control framework.
* Drive development and maintenance of the Internal model to ensure compliance with the risk measurement requirements evolving within local regulatory rules.
* Lead elements of model use, facing into the business.
* Ownership and execution of critical processes including Standard Formulae/STEC Projections/Risk Margin calculations.
* Participate and contribute to group working parties and develop appropriate model evolution plans for implementation.
* Assist in meeting regulatory and other requirements to secure ongoing approval for the AXA UK components of the internal model used for capital assessment.
* Respond to queries or ad hoc investigations regarding the capital or underlying risk position of AXA UK.
* Provide information and field questions relating to all parts of the model on a tactical basis.

**Risk Management**
**Requirements**
Contribute to the effective implementation of the risk-management system, focusing on the risk modelling that underpins the calculation of the capital requirements and to the Own Risk and Solvency Assessment (ORSA). Specifically, this involves:
  
  

* Ensure an effective insurance risk management system which complies with Group and Local policy requirements and those of the regulator.
* Leading parts of the capital assessment process – see above.
* Provision of capital modelling output to support actuarial analyses and risk second opinions.
* Driving development and embedding of capital related Insurance and Health risk appetites within AXA UK.
* Ensure compliance with relevant policies.

**Reinsurance Arrangements**

* Contribute to the annual reinsurance review process by assessing the impact of reinsurance on capital, supporting the Actuarial Function team (Deputy Chief Actuary and Senior Catastrophe Risk and Reinsurance Manager) to perform analysis determining whether risk transfer arrangements are efficient and optimal.

**Actuarial Research and Development**

* Drive delivery of appropriate actuarial analysis and research to support business goals and drive strategy as may be requested from time to time.
* Collaborate with other colleagues in the wider UK Capital Team & Actuarial Function on latest developments.

**Internal Financial Control (IFC), Internal Model Review (IMR) and External Validation**

* Internal Financial Control (IFC), Internal Model Review (IMR) and External Validation , ensure processes and controls are undertaken and evidenced appropriately in a timely manner.

You will report to Vice President, Group Services.
  
  
**What You Will BRING**
We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:
  
  
**Required Skills And Abilities**

* Qualified or nearly qualified Actuary.
* Track record in capital modelling is desirable otherwise experience in Reserving or Pricing roles in P&C business.
* Curious, inquisitive, innovative and open to new ideas.
* A self-starter with outstanding organizational skills, and ability to work in multi-geography team.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Highly numerate and analytical with robust academic record and ability to solve complex problems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Python and R coding skills beneficial.
* Ability to work self supportedly on key areas of responsibility, with only peer review required.
* Ability to use expert judgment to check and validate technical results.
* Ability to work across functional teams.

**Desired Skills And Abilities**

* Strategic mindset, balancing excellent attention to detail with the big picture.
* Knowledge of ReMetrica beneficial but not essential.
* Willingness to learn and take on tasks outside areas of prior experience.
* Knowledge of accounting concepts for GAAP/IFRS is beneficial.
* Knowledge of solvency balance sheet is beneficial.
* Experience of working for a general insurer or health insurer.
* Knowledge of reserving and / or pricing, which is beneficial to capital modelling decisions.

**Who WE are**
AXA XL, the P&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.
  
  
How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty.
  
  
With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.
  
  
Learn more at axaxl.com
  
  
**What we OFFER**
**Inclusion**
AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential.
*It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed.*

* Five Business Resource Groups focused on gender, LGBTQ+, ethnicity and origins, disability and inclusion with 20 Chapters around the globe.
* Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements
* Enhanced family-friendly leave benefits
* Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index
* Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter

Learn more at axaxl.com/about-us/inclusion-and-diversity. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
  
  
**Total Rewards**
AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do.
  
  
We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.
  
  
**Sustainability**
At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.
  
  
**Our Pillars**

* Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems - the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans.
* Addressing climate change: The effects of a changing climate are far-reaching and significant. Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal-led solutions.
* Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting.
* AXA Hearts in Action: We have established volunteering and charitable giving programs to help colleagues support causes that matter most to them, known as AXA XL’s “Hearts in Action” programs. These include our Matching Gifts program, Volunteering Leave, and our annual volunteering day – the Global Day of Giving.

For more information, please see axaxl.com/sustainability.

description:
**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently #1 ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor’s list since its founding in 2009. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. 

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

Coro is Bain’s persistent product development and engineering organization serving the firm’s digital solutions across Commercial Excellence (B2B) and the newly established Demand Generation Suite (B2C). Coro brings together technology, data, and services to build and operate proprietary solutions that create differentiated value for Bain’s clients and case teams.

This role sits within the newly established B2C pillar of Coro, building the technical foundation for Artemis – Bain’s AI-driven marketing and commercial investment allocation platform, and one of three products in the Demand Generation Suite.

**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM**

The Senior Data Engineer owns the data ingestion, transformation, and quality infrastructure that forms the foundation of Artemis. The data layer is the first unlock for everything else on the product roadmap — nothing downstream in analytics, synthesis, or AI automation works without clean, well-structured client data. Senior Data Engineers build and maintain pipelines that take raw commercial datasets - media spend, impressions, sell-out point-of-sale data, household panel data (e.g., Kantar, Numerator), retailer electronic point-of-sale feeds, and campaign performance data and transform them into structured, reliable inputs for Artemis's Bayesian marketing mix models and channel allocation analytics.

This role requires both the engineering discipline to build production-grade pipelines and enough domain understanding to design data models that accurately represent the commercial and marketing data Artemis works with.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

Data Ingestion and Transformation

* Build and maintain pipelines that ingest, validate, and transform Artemis client datasets - including media platform feeds (spend, impressions), sell-out volumes, household panel data, and macro indicators — handling the full wrangling workflow from initial data diagnosis through mapping, transformation, and imputation to produce clean, model-ready outputs.
* Design and implement ETL pipelines that are reliable, testable, and adaptable to the variety of data formats and naming conventions encountered across different client engagements.

Data Quality

* Build the data quality assessment logic that validates completeness, consistency, format, and referential integrity across client datasets. Produce programmati
  c data quality reports that the consulting team and clients can act on.
* Ensure all data assets produced by Artemis pipelines conform to the shared Demand Generation Suite data model: structured, documented, and available via API to enable benchmarking and cross-engagement analytics.

Data Modeling and External Integrations

* Design and maintain adaptable data models that keep data structured, consistent, and accessible as business needs and the technology continue to evolve.
* Manage integrations with third-party and Bain-proprietary data sources used for enriching Artemis client datasets, including Nielsen, Circana, or GfK sell-out data, Kantar or Numerator panel data, media platform APIs, macro data feeds (weather, holidays, inflation), and digital shelf data.
* Work closely with AI Engineers to ensure the data layer produces outputs that are reliably structured for large language model-powered workflows.

Innovation & Emerging Technologies

* Drive innovation through out-of-the-box thinking to solve critical business challenges and demands.
* Participate in technical discovery, POCs, and innovation workstreams to validate new tools, technologies, and designs.
* Investigate and keep up-to-date on emerging data, AI, and agentic technologies and trends; lead knowledge sharing.
* Entrepreneurial spirit, willing to try new approaches.

**ABOUT YOU**

Technical

* Strong Python skills for data processing (pandas, polars, or equivalent), with experience in schema validation libraries (Pydantic, Great Expectations, or equivalent).
* Solid relational database experience: data modeling for analytical and transactional load, and query optimization.
* Experience ingesting and normalizing messy, unpredictable real-world datasets from heterogeneous sources such as ranging incomplete client data or unreliable 3
  rd
  party data sources in media, attribution etc.
* Data pipeline automation, including ingestion, transformation, load, valid. Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, and Spark-based pipeline development. Familiarity with Medallion Architecture and cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) is a strong advantage
* Working knowledge of cloud storage and data services (Azure preferred).
* Experience contributing to time and cost estimates of product enhancements, advise on trade-offs of features.
* Familiarity with AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) to support and accelerate development workflows.
* Results-driven, with an analytical and collaborative mindset. Eager to learn and grow in a fast-paced Agile environment.

Education

* Associate/Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.

Experience

* 3-5+ years of data engineering experience building ETL or data pipeline systems.
* Track record of delivering in an Agile environment.
* Experience with troubleshooting and issue resolution skills.

title: SC Digitalization Analyst
description:
At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.
  
  
Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25-year-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.
  
  
While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Supply Chain Digitalization Analyst supports the execution of the Supply Chain Digitalization strategy by maintaining high-quality Supply Chain data and delivering advanced analytics, insights, and Power BI solutions. Working under the direction of the SC Digitalization Manager, the role helps ensure data is structured, consistent, governed, and usable across systems to support operational performance, planning, service, inventory, working capital, and cost optimization. The Analyst also supports the lifecycle management of dashboards and analytical tools aligned with global Supply Chain priorities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Supply Chain Data Maintenance, Quality & Governance: Maintain, cleanse, harmonize, and improve Supply Chain data across operational, planning, inventory, service, cost, working capital, and performance domains. Resolve data inconsistencies through root cause analysis and sustainable fixes, while supporting Data Governance standards, definitions, documentation, and issue escalation.
* Analytics Solution Development, Data Modeling & Digital Tools: Translate Supply Chain requirements into data models, semantic models, Power BI dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions aligned with data strategy and architecture. Partner with stakeholders to support Power BI builds and scalable analytics solutions using tools such as Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and Power Platform / PowerApps, where applicable.
* Reporting Lifecycle, Automation & Standardization: Maintain and improve global and regional Supply Chain scorecards, dashboards, and recurring reports. Manage refresh validation, issue resolution, enhancements, documentation, user support, KPI alignment, and report consolidation, while driving automation and standardization to improve scalability and consistency.
* Advanced Analytics, Data-Driven Insights & Supply Chain Optimization: Develop advanced analytics and network optimization models using complex Supply Chain data to improve operational performance, planning, service, inventory, working capital, cost, and risk management. Partner with internal Supply Chain and cross-functional teams gather data, maintain accurate baseline network models, evaluate customer shipping points, and assess strategic network opportunities, including greenfield locations and point-of-manufacturing options. Identify trends, root causes, risks, and opportunities, then translate insights into actionable recommendations that optimize transportation mileage, facility utilization, total Supply Chain cost, and ways of working.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent, in Supply Chain or related field.
* Minimum of 5+ years in a Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, Customer Service, Data Analytics, or related fields required.
* Experience working with complex, multi-source datasets (SAP, BI tools, external data)
* Strong capability in data cleansing, structuring, and harmonization
* Demonstrated ability to perform advanced data analysis and generate actionable insights
* Experience with Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Power Apps; exposure to data platforms (e.g., Azure, SQL) preferred
* Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional group required. Strong written and oral communication skills are required.
* Fluency in English.
* Ability to analyze complex problems to identify and correct root causes with minimum supervision.
* Ability to self-manage and operate independently in environments that may not be black and white
* Operates as a continuous learner, proactively asking questions, challenges status quo and makes recommendations for improvement. Analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent presentation, verbal, and written communication skills to communicate effectively at all levels.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Working with or in the Supply Chain function
* Previous use of Supply Chain Guru / Llamasoft, or comparable Network Modeling software
* Experience supporting greenfield, brownfield, and existing network optimization analyses.

At McCormick, we have over a 100-year legacy based on our “Power of People” principle. This principle fosters an unusually dedicated workforce requiring a culture of respect, recognition, inclusion and collaboration based on the highest ethical value

* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team

**Logistics**
**Minimum education:**

**Required field of study:**
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
  
  
**Minimum years of experience:**
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
  
  
**Location-based hybrid policy:**
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
  
  
**Visa sponsorship:**
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
  
  
**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.**
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
  
  
**Your safety matters to us.**
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
  
  
**How We're Different**
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
  
  
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
  
  
**Come work with us!**
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.

Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Technical Operations Analyst II
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
  
  
Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
  
  
**Technical Operations Analyst II**
We are seeking a highly analytical Data Analyst II / Senior Data Analyst to turn complex data into clear, actionable product and operational insights. This role is designed for a strong SQL practitioner who can independently investigate ambiguous business questions, build trusted data pipelines and reporting foundations, and partner with stakeholders to improve how decisions are made.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings a product-analyst mindset. They connect user and business needs to measurable outcomes, define meaningful metrics, identify trends and root causes, and communicate recommendations clearly. The role will also contribute to internal tools and workflows built with n8n, Databricks, and Looker. Familiarity with the internal product suite is helpful but not required.
  
  
This individual will operate with a high degree of ownership, influence partners through data, and raise the quality and scalability of analytics practices across the team.
  
  
Success in this role means
  
  

* Stakeholders make faster, better decisions because insights are timely, trusted, and connected to business or product outcomes.
* Critical data pipelines and analytical datasets are reliable, documented, maintainable, and scalable.
* Metric definitions and reporting are consistent across teams, reducing confusion and duplicated effort.
* Product and operational questions are translated into actionable analyses, recommendations, and measurable follow-through.
* Analytics work increasingly supports self-service, automation, and repeatable decision-making.
* Cross-functional partners view the analyst as a thought partner with strong technical depth and product judgment.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own the end-to-end analytics lifecycle for priority questions and initiatives, including problem definition, data discovery, metric design, analysis, and recommendations.
* Design, build, and maintain reliable data pipelines, datasets, and analytical models that support recurring insights and self-service reporting.
* Write advanced and efficient SQL to transform, join, validate, and analyze large and complex datasets.
* Apply product analytics techniques to understand user behavior, adoption, engagement, retention, funnel performance, and operational outcomes.
* Translate ambiguous business and product questions into structured analyses, hypotheses, measurement plans, and clear decisions.
* Partner with product, engineering, operations, and other cross-functional teams to define success metrics and establish trusted sources of truth.
* Develop and improve Looker dashboards and reporting to ensure visualizations are useful, accurate, documented, and actionable.
* Investigate data quality issues, reconcile discrepancies, and establish validation practices that improve confidence in reporting and insights.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive analytics and operational workflows, including providing analytical input to tools built with n8n and Databricks.
* Present findings to technical and non-technical audiences, clearly communicating implications, limitations, trade-offs, and recommended actions.
* Mentor peers, share analytical best practices, and contribute to standards for data modeling, documentation, metric definitions, and reusable analysis.

**Who You Are**

* You have strong SQL skills, including complex joins, common table expressions, window functions, aggregations, query optimization, and data validation.
* You have experience building or maintaining data pipelines, analytical datasets, or transformations used by downstream stakeholders.
* You have experience in product, business, or operational analytics and can turn analysis into clear recommendations.
* You have a strong understanding of analytical concepts such as metric design, cohort analysis, funnel analysis, segmentation, experimentation fundamentals, and root-cause analysis.
* You are comfortable working with incomplete information, asking the right questions, and creating clarity in ambiguous problem spaces.
* You communicate effectively and can explain analytical findings and limitations to non-technical audiences.
* You demonstrate ownership from problem definition through delivery, adoption, and ongoing improvement.
* You hold a bachelor’s degree in analytics, data science, statistics, computer science, business, economics, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may be considered.
* Experience with Databricks or a comparable cloud data platform.
* Experience with Looker or another modern business intelligence and semantic-layer platform.
* Experience with workflow automation tools such as n8n, or a demonstrated interest in improving analytics and operations through automation.
* Familiarity with data modeling practices, dimensional modeling, dbt, version control, or software development lifecycle practices.
* Experience partnering with product managers, designers, engineers, or operations leaders in a product environment.
* Familiarity with the organization’s internal product suite, tools, or workflows.
* Experience improving analytics standards, mentoring analysts, or influencing cross-functional decisions without direct authority.
* You are deeply curious and enjoy getting to the root of a problem.
* You hold a high bar for data quality and are comfortable challenging assumptions respectfully.
* You balance technical rigor with pragmatism and know when a simple solution is the right solution.
* You communicate early, document decisions, and make your work reusable for others.
* You are comfortable operating independently while actively building alignment with partners.

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.

description:

The Analytics, Investments and Marketing Enablement (AIM) team within Global Commercial Services (GCS) is the analytics engine powering data-driven customer acquisition, engagement, and growth. AIM develops insights, data products, advanced analytical solutions, and AI capabilities that enable smarter decisions and more personalized customer experiences across the Commercial business.

The team brings together rich customer data, behavioral signals, advanced machine learning, and emerging AI techniques to better understand customer intent, behavioral sequences, and evolving product needs—and translate them into relevant, timely opportunities to deepen customer relationships.
  
  
**How will you make an impact in this role?**
As a Senior Analyst, you will play a key role in developing analytical and machine learning capabilities that help determine what our customers may need next, and when. You will work with large-scale transactional and behavioral datasets, uncover patterns across customer journeys, and develop models that transform these signals into actionable cross-sell strategies.
  
  
You will have the opportunity to work on challenging problems spanning intent identification, sequence mining, recommendation systems, predictive modeling, and Generative AI, while partnering with business and technical teams to translate analytical innovation into measurable customer and business impact.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous problems with data, has strong hands-on Python and SQLskills, is excited by modern recommendation and sequence-modeling techniques, and wants to help shape how advanced analytics and AI are applied to Commercial customer growth.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build Advanced Cross-Sell & Recommendation Capabilities: Design, develop, and iterate machine learning solutions that identify relevant next-product and cross-sell opportunities using customer, product, transactional, and behavioral signals.
* Understand Customer Intent & Behavioral Sequences: Apply techniques such as intent modeling, sequence mining, recommendation algorithms, and representation learning to uncover patterns in customer journeys and identify signals that indicate emerging customer needs.
* Develop Modern ML Models: Explore and apply advanced modeling approaches, including BERT-based architectures, transformer models, TiSASRec and other sequential recommendation techniques, alongside traditional machine learning methods where appropriate.
* Drive Hands-on Analytics: Use Python and SQL extensively to explore large and complex datasets, engineer meaningful features, test hypotheses, build analytical frameworks, and translate insights into scalable solutions. Develop clean, efficient, reproducible analytical workflows.
* Translate Business Problems into Analytical Solutions: Partner with stakeholders to convert complex and sometimes ambiguous business questions into clearly defined analytical problems, measurable hypotheses, modeling approaches, and success metrics.
* Explore GenAI Applications: Evaluate opportunities to leverage Generative AI and LLM-based capabilities, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt design, LLM evaluation, and approaches for identifying and mitigating hallucinations, where they can meaningfully enhance analytical solutions.
* Collaborate Across Teams: Partner closely with Marketing, Product, Sales, Technology, and other Analytics teams to connect analytical insights with business strategy and operational execution.

**Qualifications**

* 2–3 years of relevant experience in data science, machine learning, advanced analytics, or a related quantitative field.
* Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline such as Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, Data Science, or a related field.
* Strong hands-on Python skills are essential, with experience using Python for data manipulation, exploratory analysis, feature engineering, statistical analysis, and machine learning.
* Strong SQL skills are essential, including the ability to independently work with large and complex datasets, construct sophisticated queries, and perform data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
* Experience with customer intent modeling, sequence mining, recommendation systems, sequential data, NLP, or related techniques.
* Strong understanding of core machine learning concepts, including feature engineering, model evaluation, validation, overfitting, performance measurement, and model interpretability.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the ability to break down ambiguous business problems and translate them into structured analytical approaches.
* Ability to operate effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional environment while demonstrating intellectual curiosity, ownership, and strong attention to detail.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Exposure to modern deep-learning architectures and algorithms such as BERT, Transformers, TiSASRec, SASRec, or similar sequence/recommendation approaches.

title: Monitoring And Evaluation Specialist
description:
**Organization:**

FIND accelerates equitable access to reliable diagnosis around the world. We are working to close critical testing gaps that leave people at risk from preventable and treatable illnesses, enable effective disease surveillance, and build sustainable, resilient health systems. In partnership with countries, WHO and other global health agencies, we are driving progress towards global health security and universal health coverage. We are a WHO Collaborating Centre for Laboratory Strengthening and Diagnostic Technology Evaluation. For more information, please visit www.finddx.org

**Location:**
New Delhi, India

**Work Model: Hybrid**
(3 days in office and 2 days WFH per week)

Project Background

A responsive, accessible, and pandemic-resilient public health system depends on early detection, accurate testing, and timely reporting. Under India's Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme (IDSP), District Public Health Laboratories (DPHLs) are a critical link between clinical care and disease surveillance — supporting early identification of febrile-illness clusters, water-borne disease events, and other public health threats. In partnership with the National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) and TIFA, FIND is supporting a multi-state initiative to strengthen DPHL capacity across Assam, Jharkhand, and Maharashtra.

The project works with State Surveillance Units (SSUs) and DPHLs to: (1) conduct a baseline gap assessment of infrastructure, human resources, equipment, biosafety, and quality processes; (2) strengthen laboratory management, supply chain, and Quality Management Systems (QMS); (3) upskill DPHL and SSU staff on epidemiology, outbreak surveillance, and timely reporting on the Integrated Health Information Platform (IHIP); (4) build capacity for environmental/water testing as part of outbreak preparedness; and (5) support integration of these systems into routine state health functions through a sustainability roadmap. Standardized training content, SOPs, and a robust Quality Management System are central to all of these workstreams.

The Monitoring, Evaluation & Data Analyst will lead the project monitoring and evaluation framework while providing high-quality data management and analytical support. The role will track project indicators and milestones, strengthen data quality, generate actionable insights, and support evidence-based decision-making and reporting. The position will work closely with the Program Manager, Senior Microbiologist, Training and QMS Lead, State Coordinators - Microbiology, NCDC, State Surveillance Units, and other project stakeholders

**Key Responsibilities;**

• Develop and maintain the project monitoring and evaluation framework, including results framework, indicator matrix, definitions, targets, data sources, reporting frequency, and responsibilities.

• Track project outputs, outcomes, milestones, risks, and implementation progress across Assam, Jharkhand, and Maharashtra, and flag variances requiring management attention.

• Design and maintain monitoring tools, databases, KPI trackers, and dashboards covering baseline and endline assessments, mentoring visits, training coverage, QMS indicators, laboratory performance, and IHIP reporting trends.

• Collect, clean, validate, analyse, and interpret quantitative and qualitative data from state and district sources, ensuring completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timely submission.

• Conduct routine data quality assessments and verification checks; identify gaps, errors, and limitations and coordinate corrective actions with project teams.

• Analyse baseline, periodic, and endline data using Excel and appropriate statistical software such as SPSS, Stata, R, or Python.

• Prepare data visualizations, trend analyses, performance summaries, and management dashboards using Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.

• Support periodic project, donor, and stakeholder reporting by consolidating evidence, analysing progress against targets, and presenting clear findings and recommendations.

• Support the design and analysis of surveys, assessments, training evaluations, pre- and post-tests, and feedback mechanisms.

• Document lessons learned, good practices, case studies, and evidence of project contribution to support adaptive management and knowledge sharing.

• Provide training and coaching to State Coordinators and other project staff on monitoring tools, indicator definitions, data collection, cleaning, validation, analysis, and reporting.

• Coordinate with technical and program teams to ensure monitoring findings are used for course correction, planning, and decision-making.

• Support publications, scientific presentations, dissemination materials, and the consolidated project closure dataset and report, including baseline-versus-endline comparisons.

• Regularly update the supervisor and project team on progress, key findings, data-quality issues, and implementation challenges.

• Undertake other related duties assigned from time to time.

**Experience/Skills required**

• Master's degree in Public Health, Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Statistics, Monitoring & Evaluation, Data Science, Health Informatics, Social Sciences, or a related field.

• Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in monitoring and evaluation, data management, or data analytics, preferably in public health, laboratory systems, disease surveillance, or donor-funded programmes.

• Demonstrated experience developing M&E frameworks, results frameworks, indicator matrices, data-collection tools, KPI trackers, and performance dashboards.

• Strong experience handling large datasets, including data collection, cleaning, validation, analysis, interpretation, visualization, and reporting.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with statistical packages such as SPSS, Stata, R, or Python.

• Experience with data-visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau is strongly preferred.

• Knowledge of databases such as MS SQL Server and automation using Python or VBA will be an advantage.

• Experience with public health surveillance systems, including IHIP or IDSP reporting formats, is desirable.

• Ability to translate complex data into clear findings, practical recommendations, and concise reports for technical and non-technical audiences.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, coordination, interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills, with close attention to detail.

• Ability to work effectively with multi-state and multicultural teams and coordinate with government and project stakeholders.

title: Strategy and Growth
description:
**About ZO Play :**

ZO Play is a transmedia platform built by the makers of WinZO, India’s largest interactive entertainment ecosystem, serving 250 million users across India, the US, Brazil, and Germany in 15 languages. It is building a global consumer-tech super-app that integrates social and esports gaming, short-form video and audio content, and community into a single, seamless experience.

As part of this vision, ZO Play is creating India’s first transmedia entertainment ecosystem, where narratives extend across games and digital experiences, while ZO Social enables users to connect with communities and verified experts across domains like astrology.

It is also driving India’s creator economy with a network of 75,000 creators, primarily from Tier II–V towns, helping them reach global audiences and monetize through livestreamed esports. Built on first-principles thinking, the company has scaled from 0 to 1 to category leadership across markets. A Series C-funded venture, ZO Play has raised $100M from marquee global investors including Griffin Gaming Partners, Courtside Ventures, and Makers Fund, and is also advancing ‘Gaming for Good’ through its Play to Prevent Cancer program in partnership with Tata Memorial Hospital.

**ZOPlay Values :**

Integrity, Excellence, Perseverance, Fine Judgement, Agility

**Product, Strategy & Growth**
- it’s a unique all in one opportunity! As a part of the team, you will be responsible for a variety of projects – managing P&L for various features on ZO Play, driving user acquisition and retention, improving user funnels, driving strategic partnerships to help deliver diverse content to our audience. You will be working in a fast paced environment which will require you to take initiatives with complete ownership, manage multiple projects, and drive execution with stakeholders.

**What you will do:**

* Undertake end-to-end ownership and accountability of a vertical to grow it to 100x revenue
* Ideate and conceptualize new features and improve existing ones to scale the product (mixture of Product Management and Category Management)
* Perform data analysis to optimize the existing product for an improved PnL statement with a better margin. We believe in having a profitable business, so need to think accordingly for scaling verticals
* Conduct market analysis and identify potential partners who can offer diverse gaming content on ZO Play
* Develop market expertise through a continuous focus on building knowledge of the competitive segment and market environment

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong quantitative and analytical aptitude (MBA or Engineering background from Tier 1 institute)
* Comfort with Excel/Sheets at an advanced level; SQL or basic data tool experience is a plus
* Curiosity about performance marketing, growth metrics, and a structured problem-solving approach
* Ownership mindset — comfortable working with ambiguity and driving metrics independently

**What we offer you:**

* A flat and transparent culture with an incredibly high learning curve
* A swanky informal workspace which defines our open and vibrant work culture
* Opportunity to solve new and challenging problems with a high scope of innovation
* Complete ownership of the product and chance to conceptualize and implement your solutions
* Opportunity to work with incredible peers across departments and be a part of the Tech revolution
* Most importantly, a chance to be associated with big impact early in your career

title: Digital lending expert - payday loans

description:
**Company Description**
Manikaran Credit & Leasing Co. Pvt. Ltd., based in Naraina, Delhi, is a long-established financial services company with over 25 years of experience in lending. Since its founding in 1994, the company has disbursed more than 20,000 loans to over 15,000 clients, earning a strong reputation for prompt, hassle-free customer service. Manikaran Credit & Leasing operates across more than 13 locations in North India, including a head office in Delhi and branch offices in Mohali and other cities. The organization focuses on meeting diverse credit needs while maintaining trust, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role based in Delhi, India for a Digital Lending Expert specializing in payday loans. The role involves designing and managing digital lending workflows, optimizing online application processes, and monitoring loan performance metrics for short-term credit products. The Digital Lending Expert will collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and implement digital strategies, coordinate with operations and underwriting to streamline decision-making, and ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements. * Relevant experience in digital lending, consumer finance, or fintech, especially in short-term or payday loans, is highly beneficial.
* Knowledge of lending regulations, KYC norms, and risk assessment practices in India is preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Technology, or a related field; advanced certifications in digital finance or fintech are a plus.
* Proficiency with lending or CRM platforms, data analysis tools, and basic MS Office applications is advantageous.

description:

India-New Delhi

Full-time
**IMPORTANT NOTICE:**
Please note that the deadline for receipt of applications indicated above reflects your personal device's system settings.
  
  
**Objective Of The WHO Programme/Department**
The overall objective of the Digital Health & AI Technical Unit in Department of HSD is to support the Member States to improve health for everyone, everywhere by accelerating the development and adoption of appropriate, accessible, affordable, scalable and sustainable person-centric digital health & AI solutions to prevent, detect and respond to epidemics and pandemics, developing infrastructure and applications that enable countries to use health data to promote health and well-being, and to achieve the health-related Sustainable Development Goals. WHO-SEARO is harnessing the power of digital technologies and health innovation to accelerate global attainment of health and the well-being.
  
  
Translating latest data, research, and evidence into action: this means promoting standards for interoperability and data sharing and supporting implementation of digital solutions that contribute to informed decision making. Enhancing knowledge through scientific communities of practice: enabled by new technologies and no longer limited by the need for physical meetings or hard copy peer review journals, WHO brings together top expert voices around topics of clinical and public health significance. Systematically assessing and linking country needs with supply of innovations. WHO-SEARO takes a proactive, systematic approach to identify, promote, co-develop, and scale innovations that are based on country needs of the South East Asia Region. Also, to recognize the successful digital health & AI initiatives and the urgent need to address the major impediments faced by least-developed countries of the region through implementing digital health technologies, to promote the appropriate use of digital technologies for health and to strengthen health systems by introducing digital technologies.
  
  
**Objective Of JPP**
The JPP will support the Digital Health & AI Technical Unit at WHO-SEARO in strengthening the responsible development, evaluation, implementation and scale-up of artificial intelligence for health ecosystem across the South-East Asia Region.
  
  
The JPP will provide specialized technical support to Member States across the AI lifecycle, including identification and prioritization of health-system problems suitable for AI applications; assessment of data readiness and technical requirements; development and review of AI approaches; validation and evaluation of AI-enabled technologies/programs; deployment and integration within health systems; and post-deployment monitoring and scale-up.
  
  
The JPP will also contribute to regional and country-level work on AI governance, safety, ethics, equity, technical standards, technology assessment, capacity building and evidence generation, helping Member States translate advances in AI into safe, effective, equitable and context-appropriate health applications.
  
  
**Supervisor**
First Level: Dr Karthik Adapa, RA-DH
  
  
Second Level : Mr Manoj Jhalani, Director-HSD
  
  
**Terms of reference**
Under The Overall Guidance Of The Director, Department Of Health Systems Development (HSD) And The Direct Supervision Of The Regional Adviser, Digital Health, The JPP Will Provide Support In The Following Areas
  
  

* Provide technical support to WHO-SEARO and Member States on AI enabled solutions, strategies and implementation.
* Support the Strategy for AI in Healthcare for India (SAHI) implementation, operationalization, developing State AI Readiness Index, and AI health work related to SAHI.
* Support the technical assessment, validation, evaluation of AI-enabled health technologies/programs.
* Support Member States in assessing AI readiness, including data availability, quality, representativeness, infrastructure, computational requirements, interoperability, workforce capacity and institutional readiness.
* Support the development and application of AI evaluation frameworks and methodologies
* Contribute to AI governance and responsible AI frameworks
* Support development of conceptual frameworks, technical guidance, strategic plans, policy proposals, technical specifications, reports and knowledge products related to AI in health.
* Undertake evidence reviews, technical analyses and horizon scanning on emerging AI technologies and their potential applications, risks and implications for health systems.
* Support technical implementation and integration of AI applications within existing digital health ecosystems, including consideration of interoperability, APIs, data standards, digital public infrastructure and existing health-information systems.
* Support Member States in developing technical and institutional capacity for AI in health, including technical workshops, training programmes, and practical capacity-building activities.
* Facilitate technical engagement with Ministries of Health, WHO Country Offices, academic and research institutions, technology developers, regulatory institutions, development partners and other stakeholders involved in AI development, evaluation and implementation.
* Support documentation and dissemination of AI implementation experiences, evaluations, lessons and good practices across the South-East Asia Region.
* Undertake other related technical activities assigned by the Regional Adviser, Digital Health, in alignment with WHO-SEARO priorities.

**Education**
**Essential:**
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Engineering, Mathematics, Computational Sciences, or another closely related technical discipline relevant to artificial intelligence, machine learning, or data science.
  
  
**Desirable:**
Masters/PhD strongly recommended in Data Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Mathematics, Public Health, or a related field, with demonstrated interdisciplinary education and/or experience at the intersection of health and technology development/application.
  
  
Additional academic training, certification or demonstrated technical expertise in health law, machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, health informatics, biomedical data science, AI evaluation or responsible AI would be an asset.
  
  
**Experience**
Essential: At least two years of experience working on digital health, artificial intelligence, or machine-learning projects, including direct experience in AI for health involving the development, testing, validation, deployment, evaluation, or scale-up of AI-enabled health technologies.
  
  
**Desirable**

* Experience in AI technology assessment, product development, clinical or public-health AI evaluation, AI safety, health informatics or digital health architecture.
* Demonstrated experience working collaboratively with governments, Ministries of Health, academic and research institutions, technology developers, NGOs, development partners and/or global funders, particularly in low- and middle-income countries or the Global South.
* Relevant experience working with UN agencies, in particular WHO.
* Knowledge of any/multiple SEA Regional languages is an asset.

**Age:**
Below 35 years
  
  
This Vacancy Notice is only applicable to nationals of South-East Asia Region Member States i.e., Bangladesh, Bhutan, DPR Korea, India, Maldives, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Thailand, Timor-Leste
  
  
**Minimum**
**Skills required for the assignment:**

* Proficiency in spoken and written English;
* Strong technical understanding of artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science and statistical modelling.
* Deep understanding on DPIs, DPI-Health, Reference Architecture
* Deep understanding of the AI development lifecycle
* Ability to critically assess and evaluate AI models and products
* Deep understanding of SAHI, National AI health strategies globally
* Understanding of health data, health information systems and the technical considerations involved in integrating AI into digital health environments.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into recommendations for policymakers, health-system leaders and multidisciplinary stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, scientific writing and technical communication skills.
* Ability to think strategically, work collaboratively across multidisciplinary and multicultural teams and deliver results under tight timelines with an ability to develop innovative approaches and solutions.

**WHO Competencies Required For The Assignment**

* Teamwork
* Communication
* Respecting and promoting individual and cultural differences

title: Director, People Data and Reporting
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Metrics & Reporting**

* Own the global people metrics catalogue: definitions, calculation logic, and ownership for headcount, attrition, hiring, mobility, diversity, and related measures.
* Lead the move from custom report requests to self-serve reporting, rationalising legacy reports into a small set of governed master reports with role-based access.
* Own management and executive reporting for People & Culture leadership, the Senior Leadership Team, and Finance, on a consistent monthly and quarterly cadence.
* Define the reporting dimensions that must hold across every layer: organisation structure, job classification, location, supervisory hierarchy, and grade.
* Ensure historical trends survive organisation restructures and employee ID changes.
* Put export guardrails and access controls in place, reducing reliance on uncontrolled data extracts.

**Data Governance & Quality**

* Establish and run the people data governance framework: decision rights, data ownership, stewardship, and a clear RACI across People Analytics, HR process owners, IT, and Finance.
* Own the semantic layer standards and data dictionary for people data.
* Lead monthly headcount reconciliation with Finance and resolve differences between HR and Finance figures at source.
* Build a data quality programme with measurable rules, scorecards, root-cause fixes, and accountable owners in the HR process teams.
* Work with Data Protection and Legal on GDPR and local privacy requirements, including access, retention, and cross-border data use.
* Maintain documentation, lineage, and change control for reports, metrics, and data pipelines.

**Leadership and partnership**

* Lead and develop a distributed team across both functions, setting clear priorities and standards.
* Act as the senior counterpart to HRIS, IT data engineering, and Finance on reporting and data decisions, including HRIS programme milestones.

title: Evidence and Analysis Lead - Strategy, Delivery and Engagement Unit
description:
**Main purpose of job:**

The Evidence and Analysis Lead will play a central role in strengthening the evidence base that underpins delivery of the India Network's strategic priorities and Vision 2035 objectives. Sitting within the Strategy, Delivery and Engagement Unit, the role will ensure senior leaders have access to robust evidence, insight and analysis to inform decision-making and prioritisation.

The postholder will provide expert advice to senior leaders and work through Economic, Political and sector teams across the India Network to drive a coordinated evidence and analysis agenda, ensuring analytical priorities are delivered, evidence gaps are addressed, and insights are translated into action.

They will be the Network's focal point for evidence and analysis, identifying knowledge gaps, commissioning and coordinating analytical work across teams, and bringing together economic, political, policy and operational insights into a coherent evidence base. The role will serve as an intelligent customer and coordinator, ensuring the right evidence is available at the right time to support effective decision-making and delivery.

The role will work closely with colleagues across the India Network, UK-based teams and wider stakeholders to improve the use of evidence and promote a culture of evidence-informed decision making.

*We reserve the right to review, revise or amend the roles and responsibilities from time to time reflecting the changing needs of business.*

**Roles and responsibilities / what will the jobholder be expected to achieve:**

**Lead the India Network's evidence and analysis function (30%)**

* Provide expert advice to senior leaders on the strategic application of evidence and analysis, ensuring that it effectively informs priority-setting, delivery decisions and resource allocation across the India Network.
* Develop and maintain a strategic overview of the evidence base supporting delivery of UK objectives in India.
* Identify critical evidence gaps, emerging issues and analytical requirements across strategic objectives, priority sectors and regions.
* Ensure evidence and insight are effectively embedded within business planning, delivery discussions and governance processes.
* Lead and undertake development of analytical products that support strategic decision-making and delivery across the India Network.

**Commission and coordinate analytical work across the Network (30%)**

* Work with Economic, Political, flagship teams and the Results and Evaluation adviser to commission, coordinate and quality assure analytical products and research.
* Develop clear analytical questions and requirements that support strategic decision-making.
* Act as an intelligent customer for evidence and analysis, ensuring outputs meet business needs and are delivered to high standards.
* Promote collaboration and reduce duplication of analytical effort across teams.

**Strengthen strategic insight and horizon scanning (20%)**

* Provide expert challenge and advice to governance forums and programme leads on the integration of evidence into business planning, strategic decision-making and performance discussions.
* Bring together quantitative and qualitative evidence from multiple sources to identify trends, opportunities and risks affecting UK interests.
* Support senior leaders with concise, actionable analysis and recommendations.
* Ensure political, economic and sectoral insights are integrated into strategic planning and delivery discussions.

**Build strong stakeholder relationships (20%)**

* Establish productive relationships with internal and external stakeholders involved in evidence generation and analysis.
* Work collaboratively across teams, professions and geographical locations to develop a shared understanding of delivery challenges and opportunities.
* Communicate complex evidence and analysis clearly and persuasively to senior audiences.

**Last date to apply for the role is 20 October 2026 by 23:55 hrs.**

title: Customer Retention Manager
description:
**Location:**
Delhi

**Department:**
Consumer Experience

**Reports To:**
Consumer Experience Head

**Step Into the World of Nicobar**

Nicobar is a modern, mindful, design-led brand from India. We are a human-centered digital brand with a growing retail presence across India. Our distinctive clothing, homeware, and jewelry blend global and local influences, designed to be loved and built to last.

Our style is clean, essential, and attainable. We care deeply about how our products are made and what goes into them. Founded in 2016, Nicobar has established itself as a premium brand known for its commitment to quality, simplicity, and design with a purpose.

We aim to inspire our consumer to embrace a modern, minimalist lifestyle—creating a modern Indian way of living, dressing, and looking at the world.

**About the Role**

As a
**Customer Retention Manager**
, you will own the retention engine at Nicobar—from lifecycle strategy and journey architecture to platform execution and performance analysis.

This is a
**hands-on execution role**
. You will build and optimise consumer journeys, configure flows, analyse cohort behaviour, run experiments, and work closely with technology and retail teams to create a connected online and offline consumer experience.

You will be expected to understand what the data is telling you, identify opportunities, and translate those insights into meaningful consumer journeys that drive retention and long-term consumer value.

**What You’ll Do**

**CRM Platform Ownership**

* Own and operate Nicobar’s CRM platform,
  **MoEngage**
  , as the internal CRM expert.
* Architect and maintain the CRM flow library, including journeys, triggers, suppression logic, and frequency caps.
* Own the event taxonomy and user attribute structure, identifying data gaps and working towards fixing them.
* Monitor platform-level performance including deliverability, list hygiene, segment overlap, and send-time distribution.
* Connect CRM platform behaviour with ecommerce data, including Shopify or equivalent platforms.
* Troubleshoot and optimise CRM journeys independently.

**Lifecycle & Journey Architecture**

* Design and execute the full consumer lifecycle across onboarding, conversion, engagement, win-back, and churn suppression.
* Build journeys with clear hypotheses, defined audiences, channel logic, and measurable success metrics.
* Develop and optimise key journeys such as:
* New user onboarding
* Power User frequency journeys
* Light-to-Power User conversion
* Win-back and churn prevention
* Omnichannel nudges connecting online customers with their nearest Nicobar store

**Experimentation & Optimisation**

* Design and run structured A/B tests and holdout-group experiments.
* Develop clear hypotheses, test them rigorously, interpret results, and iterate based on learnings.
* Evaluate whether results are statistically meaningful and use insights to continuously improve retention.

**Calendar Intelligence & Revenue Optimisation**

* Evaluate the CRM calendar by customer cohort—understanding who receives what, how frequently, and with what impact.
* Identify opportunities to improve engagement, retention, and revenue without relying solely on offers and incentives.

**Omnichannel CRM**

* Help build a connected view of the consumer across online orders, in-store purchases, browsing behaviour, and channel history.
* Work closely with technology and retail operations to connect POS and in-store consumer signals with the CRM platform.
* Identify data gaps and proactively drive improvements.
* Build journeys that meaningfully move customers between digital and physical channels.

**Customer Engagement**

* Create post-purchase journeys that connect online buyers with their nearest Nicobar store.
* Build post-store-visit follow-ups that continue the customer relationship digitally.
* Create meaningful WhatsApp and SMS communication that feels personal and brand-led rather than like an automated broadcast.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* Have strong hands-on experience with a CRM platform, particularly
  **MoEngage**
  .
* Have designed and executed omnichannel journeys connecting digital and physical customer experiences.
* Can independently interpret CRM and cohort data and translate insights into action.
* Have experience running lifecycle experiments with holdout groups and can demonstrate what you learned from them.
* Enjoy owning execution in an agile, fast-moving environment.
* Are comfortable working cross-functionally with technology, retail, ecommerce, and consumer experience teams.
* Have a strong consumer-centric and analytical mindset.
* Think beyond short-term conversions and understand the importance of long-term consumer retention and value.

**This Role May Not Be For You If...**

* Your CRM experience has primarily been strategy and briefing, with execution handled by another team.
* You rely heavily on a data or analytics team to interpret CRM performance.
* Your retention strategy is primarily driven by discounts, offers, and incentives.
* Your experience is limited to digital CRM and you haven't worked with offline customer data or physical retail environments.

**The Nicobar Spark**

**Customer First:**
We care about creating relevant, thoughtful experiences that build lasting relationships.

**Analytical & Curious:**
We look beyond surface-level metrics and ask what the data is really telling us.

**Hands-On & Ownership Driven:**
We believe in getting close to the work, solving problems, and owning outcomes.

**Systems Thinker:**
We build processes, journeys, and technology that make the customer experience better and the business stronger.

Why Nicobar?

If you’re excited by the intersection of
**customer behaviour, data, technology, creativity, and retention**
, this is an opportunity to build and shape Nicobar’s CRM and consumer retention engine.

Come help us build consumer relationships that go beyond the next transaction.

**Objective Of The WHO Programme/Department**
The overall objective of the Digital Health Technical Unit in Department of HSD is to support the Member States to improve health for everyone, everywhere by accelerating the development and adoption of appropriate, accessible, affordable, scalable and sustainable person centric digital health solutions to prevent, detect and respond to epidemics and pandemics, developing infrastructure and applications that enable countries to use health data to promote health and well-being, and to achieve the health-related Sustainable Development Goals. WHO-SEARO is harnessing the power of digital technologies and health innovation to accelerate global attainment of health and the well-being. Translating latest data, research, and evidence into action: this means promoting standards for interoperability and data sharing and supporting implementation of digital solutions that contribute to informed decision making. Enhancing knowledge through scientific communities of practice: enabled by new technologies and no longer limited by the need for physical meetings or hard copy peer review journals, WHO brings together top expert voices around topics of clinical and public health significance. Systematically assessing and linking country needs with supply of innovations. WHO-SEARO takes a proactive, systematic approach to identify, promote, co-develop, and scale innovations that are based on country needs of the South East Asia Region. Also, to recognize the successful digital health initiatives and the urgent need to address the major impediments faced by least-developed countries of the region through implementing digital health technologies, to promote the appropriate use of digital technologies for health and to strengthen health systems by introducing digital technologies.
  
  
**Objective Of JPP**
The JPP will support the Digital Health Technical Unit at WHO-SEARO in advancing digital health and the responsible use of artificial intelligence (AI) across the South-East Asia Region. The JPP will provide technical support to Member States in the development, implementation, monitoring and evaluation of national digital health strategies, action plans and priority initiatives, aligned with regional priorities and universal health coverage (UHC).
  
  
The JPP will also contribute to regional digital health strategy and action planning, support the implementation and scale-up of digital health and AI initiatives, facilitate country-level technical assistance and capacity building, and help strengthen sustainable, interoperable and context-appropriate digital health ecosystems across Member States.
  
  
**Supervisor**
First Level: Dr Karthik Adapa, RA-DH
  
  
Second Level : Mr Manoj Jhalani, Director-HSD
  
  
**Terms of reference**
Under The Overall Guidance Of The Director, Department Of Health Systems Development (HSD) And The Direct Supervision Of The Regional Adviser, Digital Health, The JPP Will Provide Support In The Following Areas
  
  

* Support WHO-SEARO and Member States in the development, implementation, monitoring and review of digital health strategies, action plans, roadmaps and priority initiatives
* Provide technical and coordination support for regional and country-level work on digital health architecture, interoperability and standards, digital public infrastructure for health (DPI-H), capacity building.
* Support engagement and consultations with Member States, WHO departments and Regional/Country Offices, development partners, civil society, academia, technology stakeholders, healthcare workers and other relevant partners, including preparation of technical materials, agendas, meeting reports and follow-up actions.
* Engage technical and development partners, academia, civil society and other relevant stakeholders to facilitate strategic partnerships for Member States.
* Contribute to the development, review and strengthening of technical guidance, policy documents, reports, concept notes, knowledge products and other technical materials related to digital health.
* Support capacity-building, workshops, consultations and knowledge-exchange activities for Member States, including identification of country needs, priorities, implementation challenges and opportunities for technical assistance.
* Undertake evidence reviews, research and technical analysis to inform WHO-SEARO’s digital health portfolio and support the translation of global and regional guidance into country-level implementation.
* Support the documentation, monitoring and dissemination of country and regional digital health initiatives, implementation experiences, lessons and good practices to facilitate learning across the South-East Asia Region.
* Undertake other related activities assigned by the Regional Adviser, Digital Health, in alignment with the priorities of HSD and WHO-SEARO.
