title: Senior Specialist, Product Data & AI
description:
**About Amplify Health**

**Who We Are**

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain.

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.

Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies—with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems.

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health’s health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company’s technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards.

As an ISO27001 certified organisation, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security.

**Our Vision and Ambition**

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery.

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals’ lifestyle/ behavioural choices.

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia’s strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools.

**The Position**

**Role Overview**

You are the senior technical authority for one product's Data & AI capability. While product owner defines “What & Why”, you are responsible for “How” of the AI/ML solutions. You decide what enters the product model line and what does not, set the standard those models are built to, and make sure every customer implementation team can deploy them through configuration rather than new code. You are hands-on enough to be credible in review, and senior enough to hold a line under delivery pressure.

**Responsibilities**

**Product Strategy, Architecture and Technical Leadership**

* Work with the Tech/ Clinical Lead and Product Managers to shape what we build, own how it is built for Data & AI: defining the technical strategy, architecture and capability roadmap.
* Act as senior technical authority on high-risk decisions, trading off value, risk, scalability and cost.
* Translate ambiguous business and healthcare problems into structured solutions with clear success metrics.
* Lead due diligence on foundation models, platforms and vendors, including build-versus-buy.
* Be able to engage customers to market test viability of technical product features with collaboration with product managers.

**Reusable Product Capability**

* Design capability where models, retrieval and agents are runtime components of the product, not development aids.
* Enforce a single product code line, differentiated by configuration, never by customer forks.
* Set foundational model strategy: what ships as a foundation capability, what is trained on customer data later.
* Define patterns for configuration, bounded fine-tuning, observability, fallback and human oversight.

**Data Contracts, Pipelines and Analytical Assets**

* Define the product's data contracts, so customer activation becomes verification, not bespoke transformation.
* Own the product's feature assets, including derivation logic and point-in-time correctness, with Data Engineering.
* Own the product's metrics and semantic layer, so a measure means the same thing for every customer.
* Set schema and versioning standards, and shape platform priorities so data dependencies stay reproducible.
* Deliver ad-hoc analysis and insight, define and validate the product's metrics, and lead dashboards that track adoption and realised value across customers

**Scientific Standards, Evaluation and Responsible AI**

* Establish evaluation frameworks covering accuracy, calibration, robustness, groundedness, safety, bias and privacy.
* Set standards for validation, explainability, fairness, model risk and monitoring.
* Define acceptance criteria, sign off every change to product model code, and classify customer requests as configuration, enhancement, bounded extension or out-of-product.
* Independently validate models built by customer implementation teams, never your own squad's.
* Ensure privacy, security and safety controls proportionate to each model's risk tier.

**AI-Assisted Development**

* Champion responsible adoption of AI development tools, with approved patterns, controls and value measures.
* Govern assistants as productivity tools, and separately validate what runs inside the product.

**Stakeholder Influence and Capability Building**

* Influence executive strategy, investment and risk decisions through evidence, uncertainty and trade-offs.
* Author the product's documentation, playbooks and customer implementation explanation packs.
* Build capability through certification content, mentorship and standards, and develop senior technical talent.

**Candidate Profile**

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years building and deploying production machine learning and AI, with a substantial record of measurable impact.
* Depth in several of predictive modelling, causal inference, forecasting, fraud detection or optimisation, plus hands-on NLP, transformer and LLM/RAG experience.
* Proven experience designing reusable, configurable model architectures that deploy across multiple customers or markets without bespoke rebuilds.
* Expert proficiency in Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, MLflow, PyTorch, cloud ML platforms and LLM APIs.
* Strong grounding in model evaluation, validation, monitoring and Responsible AI: fairness, explainability, groundedness, hallucination detection, safety, privacy.
* Ability to set and hold a technical standard across teams, and to influence senior stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
* Experience mentoring senior technical talent; 3+ years leading data science teams is highly desirable.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including explaining technical trade-offs to non-technical audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or master's in computer science, statistics or a related technical field.
* Healthcare or health insurance domain experience: payer or provider analytics, claims, population health, care management, clinical operations or health data platforms.
* Experience with healthcare privacy, security and regulated-environment requirements.
* Strong knowledge of MLOps, LLMOps, CI/CD for ML, feature stores, model registries and monitoring at scale.

**What Good Looks Like**

* Your product's models deploy to a new customer through configuration, not a rebuild.
* Every release ship with the documentation, playbooks and evidence implementation teams need.
* You are the person others seek out for a high-stakes technical judgement, and you are willing to say no to a request that would fork the product.
* The squad's quality holds when you are not in the room.

**Join Us**

title: Lead – Fraud Control Unit
description:

: Head – Fraud Control Unit

**Department**
: Risk

title: Practice Consultant (Sustainability, Digital & AI)
description:
**Practice Consultant (Sustainability, Digital & AI)**

**New Delhi**

  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

You’ll join Bain’s Sustainability Practice, which helps our clients make critical decisions at the core of their business strategy. Our work spans sustainability strategy, the environmental and social impact of operations, stakeholder engagement, and sustainability-related growth and cost opportunities.

We help ensure sustainability efforts are grounded in business fundamentals, demonstrate a clear return on investment, and become firmly embedded within our clients’ strategies and operations.

As part of the Sustainability Practice, you’ll collaborate globally with colleagues across Bain, including client-facing teams and digital and technical specialists, to develop innovative perspectives, products, and solutions that help our clients achieve results.

  

**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM**

As a Practice Consultant focused on Sustainability, Digital & AI, you’ll be a critical member of our Sustainability Practice. From day one, you’ll bring analytical, interpersonal, creative thinking, business management, and leadership skills to help advance the practice’s annual and longer-term goals.

You’ll support case teams in delivering results for clients, help build new intellectual property and solutions, and contribute to global collaboration and our external visibility and differentiation.

A key part of your role will be exploring how AI, digital tools, automation, and emerging technologies can strengthen our sustainability solutions. You’ll work with technical specialists and practice colleagues to translate sustainability hypotheses and business needs into practical tools and prototypes.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

Solution design, development, deployment, and delivery

• Own and maintain the Sustainability Practice’s intellectual property and solution backlog, supporting competitive research, gap identification, and research into ecosystem offerings, partners, and emerging AI and digital tools.

• Conduct analysis and support business case development for solution investments.

• Develop intellectual property, including global reports, research briefs, market overviews, and solution- and topic-specific materials tailored to sectors and industries.

• Identify issues, develop hypotheses, execute analyses, translate data into meaningful insights, and present recommendations to key decision-makers.

• Support the day-to-day implementation of transformation projects, with a focus on delivering and operationalizing strategic initiatives that create meaningful business outcomes and impact.

• Provide hands-on support to clients and case teams in leveraging technology and AI solutions.

• Lead or contribute to the design and prototyping of AI-enabled tools and minimum viable products, working with technical specialists and our Production Engineering team to translate sustainability hypotheses into working prototypes that can be piloted with case teams and clients.

• Develop training materials that help colleagues use the latest intellectual property, AI capabilities, and digital tools.

• Surface new ideas, share learnings from pilots, and champion emerging technologies across the practice.

• Monitor developments in AI and emerging technologies and translate them into practical insights, tools, and training opportunities for colleagues.

• Identify opportunities to embed automation, analytics, and emerging technologies into our work to enhance delivery and impact.

Practice strategy, planning, and reporting

• Support win/loss learning and feedback loops for Sustainability Practice pitches and proposals, incorporating insights into our competitive knowledge base.

• Support planning for the commercialization of intellectual property and solutions, including developing investment business cases, ROI models, impact assessments, and commercialization plans.

• Support the development of sustainability diagnostic tools and frameworks, as applicable.

• Provide direct support for proposals.

• Support the collection, maintenance, and analysis of data relating to experts and commercial materials.

Practice communications and teaming

• Work effectively across practices and functions, proactively sharing and seeking information while focusing on the implications that matter most.

• Serve as a bridge between the Sustainability Practice and digital and technical teams, helping ensure AI-driven solutions align with business and sustainability impact goals.

• Support impact tracking and feedback loops for piloted tools and intellectual property to inform iteration and broader scaling.

• Train and informally coach junior team members, as appropriate.

  

**ABOUT YOU**

You bring:

• 5–8 years of top-tier management consulting experience, or equivalent experience such as product management or strategy roles at a technology firm, plus an undergraduate degree; or 4–5 years of relevant experience with an MBA or master’s degree.

• Experience, expertise, or a strong interest in sustainability, including applying AI and digital technologies to sustainability solutions.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn analysis into clear insights and recommendations.

• The ability to drive a piece of work end-to-end with limited direction and perform complex, accurate analysis.

• A continuous-learning mindset and the ability to translate experience into thoughtful recommendations for improvement.

• Strong communication skills, including the ability to structure impactful presentations and updates and clearly communicate insights and implications.

• The ability to lead effective small meetings and contribute confidently in discussions with senior stakeholders.

• A track record of inspiring, motivating, and developing junior team members.

• A passion for sustainability and for deploying innovative techniques and tools that help clients accelerate growth and reach their full potential.

• Deep familiarity with AI and machine-learning technologies and tools, such as Python, R, and OpenAI APIs, and an applied understanding of how they can create business value.

• Comfort using AI technologies and tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Grok, with an applied understanding of how they can create business value.

• Demonstrated product thinking, with the ability to translate product hypotheses and user needs into focused, testable prototypes; rapidly execute them using AI solutions; inform feature prioritization; and guide digital solution development in partnership with technical and practice teams.

• The ability to communicate technical and digital concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

• The ability to design, build, and deploy AI-enabled minimum viable products, connecting large language model and third-party APIs into working application flows.

• Hands-on experience prototyping with modern data and AI tools, such as Replit, V0, Codex, Claude Code, SQL, retrieval-augmented generation, or large language model-based workflows, without requiring production-engineering depth.

• An interest in the technology industry, including digital transformation and disruptive business models.

• Fluency in English.

Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams—including engineers, product managers, and sustainability experts—is beneficial. Experience in fast-evolving, ambiguous environments such as internal innovation teams or digital incubators, as well as familiarity with machine-learning workflows such as model training, evaluation, or deployment, would also be valuable.

You’ll need flexibility in your working hours to collaborate with our global team and will follow local office and Product, Practice & Knowledge in-office guidelines.

title: Research Innovation Analyst 1
description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
As a Research Innovation Analyst, you will support RSM’s Client & Market Insights team by working with research and business data from multiple sources and turning it into accurate, clear, decision-ready findings. Your work will span primary research, client and customer insights, quality assurance, process improvement, and the responsible use of AI-enabled tools to improve analytical workflows and insight delivery. This role is a strong fit for an analytical, detail-oriented professional who enjoys learning new tools, improving processes, and explaining what the data means to non-technical audiences.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Prepare, combine, clean, validate, and document quantitative and qualitative data from multiple sources, including survey, customer, CRM, financial, operational, and text data.
* Analyze research and business data using descriptive analysis, cross-tabulation, trend analysis, qualitative coding, and support for more advanced analysis when needed.

* Apply quality assurance by checking figures, reconciling sources, documenting assumptions, and validating outputs before findings are shared.

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant analytical, business, research, marketing, economics, statistics, data, or social-science field.
* 2 to 3 years of experience in research, insights, data analysis, business analysis, customer experience, market research, or a related analytical role.
* Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills.
* Experience preparing, analyzing, and validating quantitative or qualitative data from sources such as surveys, customer or CRM systems, financial or operational datasets, and text-based information.
* Strong analytical and communication skills, including the ability to translate data into clear findings, presentations, dashboards, or recommendations for business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated quality-assurance discipline, such as checking figures, reconciling sources, documenting assumptions, proofreading deliverables, or validating outputs.
* Attention to detail, sound judgment, collaboration, learning agility, and comfort responsibly using new analytical and AI-enabled tools.

**Preferred Qualifications**
These qualifications are helpful but not required. RSM-specific tools, methods, and internal practices can be learned after joining.
  
  

* Experience with one or more survey, business-intelligence, statistical, or analytical tools such as Qualtrics, SPSS, Power BI, Tableau, SQL, R, or Python.
* Experience with survey research, customer experience, voice-of-customer, market research, or client-insight programs.
* Experience using generative AI or enterprise AI tools for research, analysis, documentation, or workflow improvement.
* Experience testing dashboards, analytical workflows, AI-enabled tools, knowledge bases, chatbots, or automation for accuracy and usability.
* Experience contributing to executive-ready reports, presentations, dashboards, or recurring insight deliverables.
* Experience documenting data sources, assumptions, methods, and quality checks.

Working Style
  
  

* Organizes work, manages priorities, and follows through on commitments.
* Applies sound judgment when working with confidential, sensitive, or incomplete information.
* Collaborates across teams and communicates analytical work clearly to non-technical audiences.

title: Senior Research Analyst, Power Market
description:
Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.

For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.

Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.

By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.

This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.

Wood Mackenzie

Intelligence Connected

**WoodMac.com**

**Wood Mackenzie Brand Video**

**Wood Mackenzie Values**

* Inclusive – we succeed together
* Trusting – we choose to trust each other
* Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
* Future Focused – we accelerate change
* Curious – we turn knowledge into action

**Role Purpose:**

We are seeking a Senior Research Analyst to lead and support the development of asset-level revenue forecasts for renewable, conventional, and storage assets across global markets. This role is specifically focused on asset revenue forecasting, requiring expertise in asset valuation and financial modelling. The Senior Research Analyst will oversee research analysts, conduct in-depth market research, analyse historical and current energy data, and provide insights to enhance forecasting accuracy. The role also involves constant collaboration with engineering, product, and data teams to integrate research findings and contribute to the development of the overall product. This position reports to the Programme Lead and plays a key role in driving research excellence.

**Main Responsibilities:**

* Lead and oversee research efforts on global power markets, including trends in revenue mechanisms for all generation technologies.
* Manage and mentor Research Analysts, providing guidance, feedback, and technical expertise to enhance research quality.
* Conduct and oversee in-depth market analysis, identifying key trends, risks, and opportunities for asset performance.
* Monitor and interpret regulatory changes, market designs, and policy updates that impact energy assets globally.
* Provide strategic market assumptions and context to support revenue forecasting models.
* Analyse demand, supply, and weather trends to refine market inputs and validate forecast outputs.
* Develop structured methodologies for synthesizing market data and integrating it into revenue models.
* Prepare high-quality reports, memos, and presentations summarizing research insights for internal and external stakeholders.
* Establish and maintain a structured repository of data sources, research findings, and key assumptions.
* Track and synthesize industry publications, reports, and news to inform research direction.
* Work closely with data analysts to align research findings with datasets used in modelling.
* Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and data teams to ensure research insights are effectively incorporated into the overall product development.
* Present research findings to senior leadership, clients, and industry stakeholders, addressing key questions and challenges.

**Expectations:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Economics, Energy Studies, Environmental Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in asset valuation, revenue forecasting, and financial modelling for energy assets.
* Significant experience in power markets with a strong understanding of revenue mechanisms.
* Deep understanding of renewable energy, storage technologies, and conventional energy trends.
* Strong familiarity with electricity and energy markets, including market structures, policy, and regulatory environments.
* Experience leading or mentoring research teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to extract meaningful insights from complex datasets.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for presenting complex concepts clearly to various stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Collaborative mindset, with a demonstrated ability to work across cross-functional teams.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL is a plus.
* Experience with research tools, market reports, and large energy datasets.

title: Analyst
description:
Digiaccel Learning and Altera Institute are on a mission to build the next generation of business leaders equipped for a digital and AI-first world. We bring deep expertise across eCommerce, Growth, Marketing, Brand, Product and AI, and are building technology-enabled learning experiences for higher education and enterprise learning.

As a Analyst, you will work at the intersection of Product, Data, AI and Learning. You will contribute to the training, evaluation and improvement of AI models that power learning and assessment experiences, while using product and learner insights to identify opportunities and drive better product decisions.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who enjoys working with data, solving complex problems, understanding user behaviour and translating insights into impactful product improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Work on the training, evaluation and improvement of AI models that power learning and assessment experiences across higher education and enterprise learning.

• Partner with business, academic and technology teams to identify product opportunities and define clear problem statements.

• Analyse product usage data, learner behaviour and engagement metrics to uncover insights and guide product decisions.

• Work closely with Product Managers to prioritize features, define success metrics and track outcomes for ongoing and new initiatives.

• Conduct structured research, competitive benchmarking and user feedback analysis to identify improvement areas in the learning experience.

• Support end-to-end execution of pilot launches, A/B testing and post-launch analysis for new features or program modules.

• Develop and maintain dashboards and reports that communicate product performance, trends and actionable insights to stakeholders.

• Collaborate with Engineering, Content and Design teams to ensure seamless delivery of high-quality learner experiences.

**What We're Looking For**

• 1-3 years of experience in Product Analytics, Business Analytics, Data Analytics or a similar analytical role.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable product insights.

• Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and SQL.

• Strong understanding of product metrics, data analysis and experimentation.

• Ability to analyse user behaviour and product data to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.

• Strong interest in AI/ML, LLMs and AI-powered products.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.

• High ownership, curiosity and attention to detail.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and cross-functional environment.

**Why Join Us?**

**• Build AI-powered Education -**
Work on AI-powered products shaping the future of higher education and enterprise learning.

**• High-Growth Learning Environment -**
Work in a fast-scaling organization where ownership, innovation and excellence are valued.

**• Cross-Functional Exposure -**
Work closely with Business, Product, AI, Engineering, Content, Design and Academic teams.

**• Accelerated Career Growth -**
Take ownership of high-impact projects and build expertise across Product, AI and Learning.

**• Make a Meaningful Impact -**
Contribute to products designed to improve learning experiences and outcomes for thousands of learners.

**About the Company**

Digiaccel Learning is a Gurgaon headquartered education company that is redefining the gold standard of management education for the digital and AI first world. By doing so, it is building the next generation of business leaders in the country. The mission of the company is to build employability through education.

Education is a hard and important problem to solve for. India needs to double its higher education infrastructure in order to serve its large demographic of youth. Within what exists, quality is a large problem with studies reporting that 50% of Indian graduates are unemployable. Add to this the shift in the skills ecosystem at the workplace with AI and digitization. All of this has led to a higher-education infrastructure that is unable to serve the aspirations of its students. So, you have MBA students from legacy institutes who are unplaced and professionals who are struggling to level up in their careers because they don’t have the skills to progress.

The secret sauce at the company is its instructional design, a learner centric ethos and a bar for quality that runs across touchpoints. This reflects in a 80%+ NPS across all programs since inception.

We are looking for smart passionate folks to join us in this mission of building a better, smarter and more outcome oriented education system. We are a young company and each role has the ability to make a large impact. We can assure of a very talent dense, intellectually honest, action oriented and collaborative environment.

We are sure that you will join for the opportunity and stay for the impact of seeing your work help thousands of others.

**Job Description**
**#KGS**
**Consultant Pricing Strategy**
**About Us**

The Strategy team works with C-level Executives to identify, structure and solve their most critical strategic issues across the economic and transaction cycles. As part of a fast-paced and dynamic group, our consultants offer strategic advice on financial, business and operating models to corporate, public sector and private equity clients.
  
  
KGS Strategy team in India is organized by sectoral and functional capabilities to provide practical and actionable recommendations that can be delivered by the client in a cost-effective manner, both in a deal and non-deal environment. Key member firms with which KGS Strategy team works include KPMG UK and KPMG US.
  
  
**About The Role**
Within the Strategy team we have an established Pricing strategy practice, serving number of sectors including retail, consumer goods, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, transport and industrial manufacturing sectors serving US, and other international clients. We work with C-level executives to identify, structure and solve their most critical strategic issues related to deal strategy, and growth strategy.
  
  
KPMG’s Pricing strategy practice is a specialised team focused on solving pricing and revenue optimisation problems for its clients using data and analytics techniques to deliver a sustainable solution which can deliver both short- and long-term margin improvements. As a team, we are a group of bright committed individuals who are passionate about delivering fantastic client work, solving complex data related problems, investing our time in acquiring new analytical skills, and having fun both inside and outside of work.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
We are recruiting for a consultant with Pricing / Data Analytics experience. The role is currently part of KPMG’s Pricing Strategy team based in India that works closely with KPMG US and includes following core responsibilities:
  
  

* Work collaboratively with senior onshore stakeholders and client teams, in the development and implementation of pricing strategy, solutions/ recommendations
* Support in developing proposals and enhancing sales strategies for potential clients
* Understand client system and data structures and designing and executing data intensive analysis to support development of evidence-based insights
* Managing engagement work-streams and analysis, including defining deliverables, setting timelines, and develop high quality output, taking responsibility for teams when required
* Leverage analytical tools & platforms such as Alteryx, Power BI, Python etc. to manage large data sets and drive insights
* Develop documentation and insights in PowerPoint decks
* Plan and undertake primary and secondary research to develop insightful analysis for clients
* Implementation of solutions/tools in client environment and train client to implement new approach and appropriate tools
* Contributing to thought leadership and knowledge management to support practice development

* Education/professional qualifications: MBAs/ B. tech/ B.E. from a leading Indian/International educational institution
* Extensive professional experience (minimum of 2-3 years) in strategy or analytics roles, acquired from corporate positions, analytic boutique firms, or strategic consulting firms
* Minimum of 2 years of specific experience in pricing strategy and revenue optimization, handling complex pricing problems and developing effective strategies

**Required Key Skills**

* Experience in business research and data analytics with strong understanding of databases and data manipulation (data cleansing, aggregation and summary)
* Experience of complex modelling and analysis by using tools such as Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau, Python, SQL, etc.
* Proven ability to identify complex pricing problems, develop innovative solutions, and implement effective pricing strategies to drive business growth and profitability
* In-depth understanding of pricing methodologies, including value-based pricing, cost-based pricing, competitive pricing, dynamic pricing, and pricing optimization

**Preferred Skills**

* Good to have hands-on experience in developing Python codes (using IDEs like Spyder, Jupyter, etc.) and working with python libraries Pandas, Numpy, Scipy etc.
* Experience in designing/implementing machine learning models for pricing applications including but not limited to price elasticity models, forecasting, customer segmentation, linear regression, logistic regression, random forest etc.
* Possesses strong numerical, analytical, and strategic skills, with sound commercial acumen

**Responsibilities**

* Conduct pricing strategy and revenue optimization analyses using large and complex datasets to identify pricing opportunities, assess market dynamics, and develop data-driven recommendations that enhance profitability and growth.
* Leverage analytics tools such as Python, SQL, Alteryx, and Power BI to perform data cleansing, modeling, forecasting, customer segmentation, and pricing optimization while translating insights into impactful client deliverables and executive presentations.
* Collaborate with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams to develop and implement pricing solutions, manage project workstreams, support business development initiatives, and deliver strategic recommendations for clients across diverse industries.

**Qualifications**
3+ years of experience in pricing, analytics or revenue strategy

description:
**Job Description:**
**About us\***
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Stress Testing & Forecasting Analytics team sits within the CFO Organization and is aligned to support Global Markets Business. Stress Testing & Forecasting Analytics team is responsible for executing the quarterly baseline and stress forecasts across various businesses within Global Markets. The team is also responsible for developing expertise and enhancing the forecasting models.
  
  
The team needs to engage with senior stakeholders across the firm to conduct review and challenge meetings on quarterly basis with respect to the forecast results. The data and infrastructure needed for the forecast process is also owned by the team. There is high regulatory involvement given the key role the team performs in the CCAR process, Recovery and Resolution Planning, Stress loss forecasting etc.
  
  
**Job Description\***
We are seeking a technically strong individual to support the Global Markets (GM) Stress Testing Platform within Global Business Services (GBS). The role is responsible for supporting the QFAP/R forecasting platform, which underpins critical regulatory and internal forecasting processes including CCAR, ICAAP, Recovery & Resolution Planning (RRP), and quarterly stress testing exercises.
  
  
The successful candidate will play a key role in the implementation, maintenance, production support, automation, and enhancement of Global Markets forecasting models and infrastructure. The position requires strong technical expertise in R programming, platform support, data management, analytics, and software development practices, along with an understanding of stress testing and forecasting processes within a Global Markets environment.
  
  
The role will partner closely with Forecast Analysts, Model Developers, and US-based stakeholders to ensure the reliability, scalability, and continuous improvement of the forecasting platform. The individual will also help drive modernization initiatives leveraging emerging technologies including GitHub Copilot, AI-assisted development, workflow automation, and analytics tooling.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Support the day-to-day management of the Global Markets QFAP/R forecasting platform.
* Implement, integrate, and support forecasting models developed by quantitative and business teams.
* Execute and monitor quarterly forecast production cycles supporting CCAR, ICAAP, RRP, and internal stress testing exercises.
* Manage platform readiness activities prior to forecast execution cycles.
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate resolution with technology and business stakeholders.
* Maintain production support procedures, runbooks, and technical documentation.
* Coordinate code promotions, release activities, and environment management.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and reduce operational risk.
* Maintain audit-ready evidence, technical documentation, and change records.
* Adhere to model governance, change management, and software development controls.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise technology standards and risk-management requirements.

**Requirements\***
**Education\***
Qualified Masters in a Quantitative Field from Tier I/II institute with relevant experience in Stress Testing and Forecasting Analytics in Global Markets environment and organization of similar scale
  
  
Certifications If Any
  
  

* MCA / CFA / FRM / Qualified Certification certified candidates would be preferred
* Strong Programming Knowledge (R or Python) preferred

**Experience Range\***
6+ years with at least 2+ years’ experience in Global Markets Stress Testing/Forecasting Analytics role
  
  
**Foundational skills\***

* 6+ years of experience in Banking, Financial Services, Risk Technology, Quantitative Platforms, or Financial Analytics.
* Strong programming experience with R, including development, debugging, code optimization, and production support.
* Experience supporting analytical or quantitative platforms in production environments.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, version control, testing, and deployment processes.
* Experience working with large datasets and data-processing workflows.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose complex technical issues.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, and personal ability to collaborate, operate, and communicate effectively with a culturally diverse group of peers and colleagues.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a global matrix organization and significantly multi-geography, multi-cultural offshore service delivery environment.

**Desired Skills**

* Strong proficiency in R programming (preferred).
* Experience with GitHub, Git workflows, and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience using GitHub Copilot or other AI-assisted development tools.
* Knowledge of Python, SQL, Alteryx, Tableau, or similar analytics tools.
* Must be proactive and be a highly-motivated self-starter
* Takes initiative and challenges existing processes and procedures in a proactive manner
* Ability to analyze issues independently and drive solutions
* Analytical skills

**Work Timings\***
12:00 PM IST to 21:00 PM IST
  
  
**Job Location\***
Mumbai / Gurugram

title: Head of Science (Algorithms)
description:
**About the role:**

Luna builds wearables that turn raw body signals into things people can act on. We are building

LifeOS, the layer that connects what someone does with how their body responds, and

separates real cause and effect from coincidence. We are hiring a senior scientist to own that

layer and to set the scientific and algorithmic standard across every product we ship.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will build, validate and ship, and lead a small team of

scientists and algorithm engineers as it grows.

**What you will do:**

 Own the science of LifeOS: the causal and correlational engine that turns wearable,

behavioural and context data into recommendations that measurably move a health

outcome.

 Design and run causal inference methods for noisy, observational, individual-level (N-of-1)

data, and know where the data cannot support a claim.

 Lead algorithm development across the company: heart rate, HRV, sleep, activity, recovery

and derived scores from PPG and motion signals.

 Set one validation standard: reference-based accuracy testing (ECG, PSG, lab), benchmark

datasets, release gates and regression tracking, so accuracy is measured and tracked, not

argued.

 Design and run validation studies and clinical protocols, including ethics approvals, and

publish where it builds credibility.

 Work with firmware, app, data and product teams so algorithms move from research to

production reliably.

 Define how we test whether an actionable works: experiments, interventions and outcome

measures.

 Track regulatory boundaries (wellness versus medical claims) and shape what we can say

about our features.

 Hire, mentor and raise the bar for the science and algorithms team.

**What we are looking for:**

 PhD in biomedical signal processing, computational health, causal machine learning,

biostatistics, or a closely related field, from a strong research university in India or abroad.

An MS with deep industry track record will be considered.


**5 to 8 years of experience after the PhD, in industry or in an applied lab with real product**

**output.**

 Demonstrated depth in causal inference on observational data: DAGs, instrumental

variables, g-methods, Bayesian and time-series causal models, or equivalent.

 Shipped algorithms on wearable or physiological signals (PPG, ECG, accelerometry, sleep or

activity), including owning accuracy against a reference.

 Strong study design and statistics. Track record of validation work, with publications or

technical reports.

 Fluency in Python and the scientific stack, and comfort reading and reviewing production

code. Experience with ML in production.

 Evidence of leading people or technical direction, with a willingness to stay hands-on.

 Clear communication of uncertainty to engineers, product leaders and non-technical

stakeholders.

**Strong pluses:**

 Behaviour change or personalised intervention research.

 Digital biomarkers or clinical-grade validation experience.

 Experience with regulatory pathways for health software and devices.

 Experience at a wearables, digital health or medical device company.

**Who this is not for:**

This role is not a pure research position and not a pure deep learning role. We need someone

who is equally serious about causal reasoning, signal quality and shipping.

**What success looks like:**

 First 90 days: audit current algorithms and accuracy, agree a single validation framework

and release gates, and publish a science roadmap.

 First 6 months: measurable accuracy improvements on core metrics, and a first causal-

insight capability running in production.

 First 12 months: LifeOS recommendations with evidence of impact on user outcomes, and a

team that runs on shared standards

title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - P and C -AU - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Name And Description**
**Senior, P&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Senior Consultant to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Senior Consultant within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  
**On engagements, you will:**

* Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality and ensuring that work is of high standards
* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Actively look for automation and AI enhancement opportunities

**Within the actuarial practice you will:**

* Actuarial liability estimation for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR models using the data supplied for estimation
* Working knowledge of different loss projection methods and their applications along with the familiarity of different property and casualty lines of business
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Be able to build models from scratch
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Perform ad-hoc research and development requests as required
* Preparations of report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise
* Knowledge of ARIUS, ResQ or similar reserving software is desirable, but not mandatory
* Exposure to data analytics tools such as SQL and Alteryx is an added advantage
* Familiarity with IFRS 17 or Solvency II frameworks is preferred
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 3+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a small team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, Alteryx, etc., will be a plus
* AI proficiency, automation mindset
* Good exam progress

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Overseas exposure (US, UK, AU market experience)
* AI Literacy – Good knowledge on GenAI, Agentic AI would be an added advantage

**What We Look For**
Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognized insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator
  
  
Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
  
  
Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:

**About The Role**
Data at TMB is seeking a skilled, creative, and technically well-rounded Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst to join our team.
  
  
Reporting to the Vice President of Business Intelligence and Revenue Operations, the BI Analyst serves as a strategic bridge between the business and the broader Data organization. The Analyst works with business stakeholders to solve complex problems, clarify objectives, challenge assumptions, and translate ambiguous needs into well-defined analytical problems.
  
  
The BI Analyst is instrumental in helping the business make the right decision. This may mean developing an analytical model, building a scalable reporting solution, partnering with data engineering to improve the underlying data, or working with data science on more advanced analytical approaches. Rather than simply producing dashboards or responding to requests, the analyst sits at the intersection of the data and the business to ensure the organization truly has the best business intelligence.
  
  
**About You**
You are a curious, commercially minded analyst who enjoys turning complex business problems into clear, scalable analytical solutions. You are comfortable working directly with stakeholders to understand their goals, challenge and refine requirements, and determine the right analytical approach, rather than simply responding to requests at face value. You see challenges as an opportunity and thrive in ambiguous environments.
  
  
You combine strong business judgment with analytical and technical fluency, allowing you to move from a complex question to a useful recommendation. You are proficient in Excel, SQL, and general data modeling. You can use technology as a means to best convey your story.
  
  
You are proactive, independent, and comfortable forming a point of view from the data. You communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, collaborate effectively across teams, and are excited about using emerging technologies, including AI, to make analytics more scalable, efficient, and impactful.

**You have:**

* 2–4+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, or related field.

* Strong business judgment and understanding about what is driving performance

* Ability to translate analysis into concise recommendations and executive-level presentations.
* Working knowledge of data modeling and general data architecture principles
* Proficiency with Excel, SQL, and BI tools such as Power BI, Data Studio, Looker, or Tableau
* Extremely strong communication skills and experience working directly with business stakeholders
* An independent and proactive mindset with comfort forming a point of view
* Familiarity with AI tools and their application to analytics is a plus.

**About this team:**
The wider Data team at TMB is an integrated group organized around three core functions: Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, and Data Science. Operating on a collaborative "Hub and Spoke" model, our BI team pairs dedicated analysts directly with specific teams to foster deep operational expertise and trusted cross-functional partnerships. We strive to be the analytical heartbeat of TMB, serving as a unified, pristine source of truth, where we look past face-value data with curiosity and rigor. We are a nimble, forward-thinking squad that actively leverages technology, including AI, to maximize tangible business ROI and guide every strategic decision with an expert, data-backed perspective.
  
  
**Our Benefits**
We value our people and offer a collaborative and engaging culture. As a Trusted Media Brands employee, you will enjoy work/life balance, generous time off and comprehensive benefits and programs.

Trusted Media Brands embraces inclusivity and values our diverse community. We are committed to building a team based on qualifications, merit and business need. title: Head of Quant
description:
I'm hiring someone to run the quant desk at our single family office, and I want to be upfront about what the job actually is.

We're a single-family office in Delhi investing a founder's own capital. No outside investors, no fundraising, nobody redeeming in a drawdown.

What we haven't done is build the thing that turns research into a live book — the backtest and validation layer, execution, the OMS, live risk controls. Those decisions are still open, and whoever takes this seat will make them together with me and our Head of Technology.

So this isn't a research-only job. The person I'm looking for owns the strategies and the execution of them: what we trade, how it gets into the market, and the gap between backtest and live. You'll write code, you'll own models in production, you'll be the one watching the book when it's live. You'll also hire and run a small team.

Who I think this suits: someone with ten or more years in systematic or quantamental investing, at least three of them accountable for live P&L on strategies they also executed; a quantitative degree from IIT, IISc, ISI, CMI or a comparable institution; strong production-grade Python; and a real understanding of how NSE and BSE actually work, including F&O margining and where SEBI is heading.

A PhD is nice but not needed. What matters more is that you've built at least one strategy that worked in Indian markets and can explain honestly why it worked and what nearly killed it.

The role is based in Delhi, full-time, on-site.

If this sounds like you, or someone you know, write to bac@brindco.com with a CV and a short note about a strategy you've actually run here: how you found the signal, how you tested it, and how it behaved once money was on the line.

title: AI Research Apprentice (Technical Apprenticeship Programme)
description:
**Nilesh AI Systems Pvt Ltd | Gurugram, Haryana | In office, 6 days a week | Stipend: INR 5,000 per month | Duration: 6 months**

**A note before the details**

Thank you for taking a moment to read this. Choosing where to begin your journey in AI is a big decision, and we are grateful you are considering beginning it with us.

We are a small, close team in Gurugram building Physical AI and robotics systems for advanced engineering. Our work includes machine vision for automated quality inspection in automotive and aerospace manufacturing, and research toward training our own models. We are also an NVIDIA Inception Program partner.

This year we are opening our doors through a new technical apprenticeship programme, and this is its first cohort. We would be honoured to have you help us shape it.

**Who this programme is for**

This is a learning-first role for students, fresh graduates and self-taught builders who want to see how AI research turns into systems that run on real factory floors. You do not need prior industry experience. You do need curiosity, patience with hard problems, and a sincere wish to learn by doing.

We want to be open with you from the start. The programme runs for 6 months, in person, six days a week, at our Gurugram office, with a fixed stipend of INR 5,000 per month. We share this upfront out of respect for your time, so you can decide with full information whether this is right for you at this stage of your life.

**What you will do**

* Work alongside our researchers on computer vision and machine learning problems drawn from live projects
* Read research papers, reproduce results, and present what you learned to the team
* Prepare and curate datasets, run training and evaluation experiments, and document them carefully
* Build small prototypes and tools that support our inspection and robotics work
* Keep a clear record of your experiments so others can build on them

**What we hope you bring**

* Comfort with Python and the basics of machine learning or deep learning
* Some hands-on exposure to PyTorch or a similar framework, through coursework or personal projects
* A foundation in linear algebra, probability and calculus
* The habit of writing things down clearly
* The ability to be in our Gurugram office six days a week for the full 6 months
* Kindness, honesty about what you do not yet know, and the willingness to ask

**Good to have**

* Projects in computer vision, 3D geometry, robotics or simulation
* A GitHub profile, Kaggle work or a write-up we can read
* Familiarity with Linux and GPU training workflows

**What you can expect from us**

* Daily, direct mentorship from the Principal Scientist and the research team
* Real problems from real production lines, with your work reviewed seriously
* Access to GPU compute for your experiments
* A structured path through reading, replication and original contribution
* A team that will be glad you joined and will say so

**How to apply**

* Please write to careers@sftwtrs.ai with your CV, a link to any project or code you are proud of, and a few lines on a paper or idea in AI that excites you. It does not need to be polished. We read every application ourselves and we will reply.

title: AVP Senior Data Manager - FCE
description:
Embark on a transformative journey as “Senior Data Manager” at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
  
  
Overall purpose of role
  
  
The purpose of the role is to manage various FinCrime Execution related MI, both BAU and new requests. The role will work alongside the EDD Team, Risk Assessment Unit and Coverage to collate, analysis and distribute Key data to help drive enhanced Client reviews or investigations. This role will require creation of BAU reports and adhoc bespoke reports.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  
  

* Oversee Collation, analysis distribution MI to management and stakeholders across the bank.
* Manage one MI Analyst supporting the business.
* Demonstrate a thorough understanding of multiple software systems and a detailed working knowledge of Excel or other data systems to merge and filter large quantities of data for ease of use.
* Create and maintain Databases/Excel for workflow including vba/macro’s and general formula’s. Where possible suggesting better systems for data management / migration.
* Extract data from Barclays source systems (such as Fullserve and Jetbridge) to identify high-risk customers requiring Forum and to enhance data points available for review including SAR’s, Court Orders, payment information where required and anomalies requiring investigation.
* Create and run SQL code to be able to obtain data for the team from our data warehouse. This includes ad hoc work in obtaining data through SQL and creating MI from this for various stakeholders.
* Prepare MI relating to the HR Forums to present at the monthly/annual risk forums (e.g. EDD breaches, Attestation letters, Scorecard, risk trends etc.)
* Contribute to the enhancement of the HR Forum function to enhanced oversight, drive efficiencies and automation of activities where possible.
* The role holder will be required to assess and identify areas of focus from the MI so as to advise peers, Management and others of potential issues which require further focus.
* Prepare MI Reports for Manager to present at Senior Management Meetings
* Team level MI
* Support the wider FCE team with all matters pertaining to MI relating to customer types and activities.
* Provide data analysis of FCE activities to understand team productivity.
* Produce a random sample for the FCE team to QA/QC sample.
* Strong communication skills are required to influence peers and management of the impact to adhere to findings.
* Support work with change programmes to enable improvements such as testing processes and running pilots.
* Support Financial Crime Execution design improvements and process structuring such that the teams operates efficiently. Engage with peers and management to highlight and mitigate any issues as they are identified.

**Stakeholder Management And Leadership**
Key referral point for Stakeholders consuming the data which include, senior representatives from Coverage, Financial Crime, EDD and Risk Assessment Unit. Data will include highly sensitive information, and will require the candidate to be attentive and accurate in portrayal of the meetings through production of minutes.
  
  
You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as in Crime Execution related MI, both BAU and new requests. The role will work alongside the EDD Team, Risk Assessment Unit and Coverage to collate, analysis and distribute Key data to help drive enhanced Client reviews or investigations. This role will require creation of BAU reports and adhoc bespoke reports.
  
  
This role will be based out of Gurugram.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To enable data-driven strategic and operational decision making through extracting actionable insights from large datasets, performing statistical and advanced analytics to uncover trends and patterns, and presenting findings through clear visualisations and reports.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Investigation and analysis of data issues related to quality, lineage, controls, and authoritative source identification, documenting data sources, methodologies, and quality findings with recommendations for improvement.
* Designing and building data pipelines to automate data movement and processing.
* Apply advanced analytical techniques to large datasets to uncover trends and correlations, develop validated logical data models, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations that drive operational and process improvements, leveraging machine learning/AI.
* Through data-driven analysis, translate analytical findings into actionable business recommendations, identifying opportunities for operational and process improvements.
* Design and create interactive dashboards and visual reports using applicable tools and automate reporting processes for regular and ad-hoc stakeholder needs.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. title: Analyst-Operation Risk Management
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Team**
The Operational Risk Management (ORM) team facilitates and monitors the implementation of effective operational risk management programs across the enterprise and oversees risk ownership across business units, products, and processes.
  
  
Within ORM, the
**Issues & Events Analytics**
team transforms operational risk data into actionable insights that support executive decision-making, strengthen governance, and drive continuous improvement. The team is also responsible for building AI-enabled solutions for Issues & Events and acting as a bridge between Issues & Events, broader ORM priorities, and enterprise AI and automation initiatives. Furthermore, team develops enterprise reporting capabilities, performs advanced analytics, identifies systemic risk themes, and partners across the organization to improve how operational risk is measured, understood, and managed.
  
  
**Role Summary**
ORM is looking for an
**Analyst, Issues and Events Analytics**
, to help drive AI and automation enablement for the Issues & Events team. The role will identify, design, and support scalable AI-enabled and automation-driven solutions that strengthen operational risk management, improve reporting efficiency, and enhance insight quality.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who combines analytical judgment, operational risk knowledge, and practical technology adoption to solve business problems, build fit-for-purpose solutions, and apply emerging AI capabilities responsibly in a governed environment.
  
  
Reporting directly to the Director, Issues and Events Analytics, you will partner closely with ORM stakeholders, Business Units, Technology, Compliance, and central AI/automation teams to shape use cases, align with enterprise standards, support solution delivery, and promote best practices across the Issues & Events ecosystem.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The Analyst will:
  
  
**AI, Automation & Innovation Enablement**

* Support the identification, prioritization, and delivery of AI and automation opportunities that simplify Issues & Events processes, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen insight generation.
* Partner with central AI, automation, technology, and governance teams to align solutions with enterprise standards, approved platforms, responsible AI requirements, and control expectations.
* Translate ORM Issues & Events business needs into practical solution concepts, use cases, prototypes, and implementation requirements for AI-enabled analytics, workflow automation, knowledge management, and reporting enhancements.
* Promote responsible AI adoption within the Issues & Events team by supporting reusable patterns, documentation, testing discipline, model/output validation, and effective change management.
* Stay current on enterprise-approved AI capabilities, automation tools, industry developments, and operational risk management use cases, and bring forward relevant opportunities for adoption.

**Stakeholder Partnership**

* Partner with Business Units, ORM teams, Technology, Compliance, central AI/automation teams, and other stakeholders to understand business needs and deliver scalable analytical and automation solutions.
* Act as a key liaison between the Issues & Events team and enterprise enablement groups, helping ensure ORM-specific requirements are clearly articulated, prioritized, and incorporated into solution design.
* Communicate solution benefits, risks, dependencies, and recommendations effectively to both technical and executive audiences.
* Collaborate across teams to support enterprise initiatives and drive continuous improvement in operational risk analytics, process automation, and AI adoption.

**Strategic Analytics & Data Solutions**

* Develop scalable analytical solutions, dashboards, and reporting capabilities that enable effective monitoring and decision-making.
* Perform data validation and analytical reviews to ensure outputs are accurate, reliable, and fit for business use.
* Support regulatory, audit, and enterprise initiatives by providing analytical insights and responding to information requests.
* Continuously improve analytical methodologies, data processes, and documentation to enhance consistency and efficiency.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* 1-3 years of experience in Analytics, Business Intelligence, Operational Risk, Governance, Strategy, Consulting, Automation, AI enablement, or related analytical functions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to derive meaningful business insights from complex datasets.
* Demonstrated ability to convert business problems into structured solution requirements, analytical approaches, or automation use cases.
* Experience developing executive presentations, dashboards, management reporting, or data-driven business narratives.
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts, risks, and solutions into clear recommendations for business stakeholders.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills.
* Experience with one or more analytical, automation, or AI-enabled tools such as SQL, Python, Tableau, Power BI, Alteryx, workflow automation platforms, enterprise-approved generative AI tools, AI-assisted productivity solutions, prompt-based analysis tools, low-code/no-code automation platforms, or similar technologies.
* Comfortable leveraging AI-powered tools responsibly to enhance productivity, accelerate analysis, improve reporting quality, summarize large volumes of information, support knowledge management, generate insights, and assist with solution design while adhering to organizational policies, data handling requirements, and ethical AI practices.
* Ability to apply practical AI techniques, including effective prompt writing, output validation, human-in-the-loop review, AI-assisted research, document summarization, pattern identification, and workflow simplification in a controlled business environment.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree from a reputed Tier 1 institution.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within Operational Risk Management, Issues Management, Governance, Internal Audit, Risk Analytics, or related second-line risk functions.
* Experience supporting AI, automation, process improvement, workflow optimization, knowledge management, or advanced analytics initiatives in a corporate environment.
* Familiarity with responsible AI principles, enterprise governance processes, data privacy considerations, and controls required for governed technology adoption.
* Experience performing root cause analysis, thematic analysis, enterprise reporting, or operational risk data quality reviews.
* Familiarity with data governance, reporting methodologies, and quality management principles.
* Knowledge of American Express governance processes, operational risk frameworks, or enterprise reporting standards.

**Success in this Role**
**The Successful Candidate Will**

* Demonstrate intellectual curiosity and a passion for solving business problems through data, automation, and emerging technology.
* Serve as a trusted AI and automation point of contact for the Issues & Events team, bringing forward practical ideas that are aligned to ORM priorities and enterprise standards.
* Think beyond reporting by connecting data, processes, and technology capabilities to business implications and strategic recommendations.
* Maintain a strong control mindset while balancing innovation, responsible AI adoption, and operational excellence.
* Communicate with clarity and confidence across a diverse stakeholder group, including business, technology, risk, and governance partners.
* Continuously seek opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve analytical processes while embedding best practices for documentation, validation, and sustainable adoption.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

Wood Mackenzie

**WoodMac.com**
