The role offers a chance to join Wood Mackenzie’s highly respected Power and Renewables (P&R) Research team, focusing on South Asia power market analysis and modelling. Our P&R team is known for producing market-leading research, delivering integrated, in-depth power curves and market outlooks. We conduct thorough analysis and collaborate across disciplines, combining extensive data with deep knowledge of conventional fuels and renewable supply chains.
  
  
Our models provide valuable insights into the price impacts of policy, economics, and supply chains, offering clear scenario outlooks that help users align with their business risk criteria. With expertise in market dynamics, renewable power supply chains, cost trends, and investments, we support our clients in making informed commercial and strategic decisions in a rapidly changing energy landscape.
  
  
**The Role**

The successful candidate will support the regional Power & Renewables team through market research, policy and regulatory analysis, power market modelling, insights creation, and client support for India and other South Asian power markets.
  
  
As a Research Analyst, you will build a deep understanding of power market dynamics across India and South Asia and contribute across five core areas: conducting market research to track supply, demand, and investment trends; analyzing the policy and regulatory landscape and its impact on market outcomes; running and maintaining our regional power market models to produce technology and price outlooks; translating model outputs and market intelligence into clear, actionable insights for our research reports; and supporting client engagements by responding to queries and presenting findings to clients and industry stakeholders. This role also offers opportunities to build and maintain relationships with clients and industry experts. **Requirements**
**Intellectual Curiosity & Collaboration:**

Wood Mackenzie
  
  
Intelligence Connected
  
  
**WoodMac.com**
**Wood Mackenzie Brand Video**

**The Role**
We are seeking a
**Principal Analyst**
to lead our South Asia Power & Renewables research practice in Gurugram, India. This is a senior leadership role responsible for shaping the regional research agenda, managing and mentoring a team of analysts, overseeing power market modelling and research outputs, and serving as a trusted advisor to clients across the energy sector.
  
  
The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in South Asian power markets and be responsible for driving high-quality research, market analysis, policy and regulatory insights, and long-term market outlooks. They will play a central role in ensuring our research remains at the forefront of industry developments, helping clients navigate the evolving power sector landscape and supporting strategic decision-making across generation, renewables, storage, transmission, and power markets.
  
  
As a Principal Analyst, you will lead research and analysis across five core areas:
  
  

* Defining and executing the South Asia power market research agenda, identifying key themes, emerging trends, and strategic market developments.
* Leading market research and analysis to track supply, demand, investment, technology, and commercial trends across South Asian power markets.
* Overseeing policy and regulatory analysis, assessing the impact of market reforms, capacity mechanisms, ancillary markets, renewable integration policies, transmission developments, and decarbonization initiatives.
* Guiding the development and application of regional power market models to produce robust price, generation, emissions, storage, and technology outlooks.
* Translating market intelligence and model outputs into compelling insights, thought leadership, and client-facing research that informs strategic investment and commercial decisions.

The role requires significant interaction with clients and industry stakeholders. You will lead client briefings, respond to complex market questions, present research findings, and support commercial activities through thought leadership and relationship management. You will also work closely with our global research, modelling, and consulting teams to ensure consistency and excellence across our analytical offerings.
  
  
This position offers the opportunity to influence industry dialogue, develop junior talent, and establish yourself as a leading voice in South Asia's rapidly evolving power and renewable energy landscape.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Research Leadership & Thought Leadership**

* Lead the South Asia power market research agenda and identify strategic research priorities.
* Develop market views and analytical frameworks covering power, renewables, storage, flexibility, transmission, and decarbonization.
* Produce and oversee high-impact research publications, market outlooks, thematic reports, and thought leadership pieces.
* Ensure research outputs remain relevant, commercially valuable, and aligned with evolving client needs.
* Represent the company externally through industry conferences, webinars, workshops, and media engagements.

**Market Analysis & Modelling**

* Oversee power market modelling activities and ensure analytical robustness across market forecasts and scenarios.
* Guide analysis of power demand, generation, renewable deployment, storage economics, transmission, and market prices.
* Evaluate the implications of regulatory changes, policy developments, and market reforms on future market outcomes.
* Drive continuous improvement in modelling methodologies, assumptions, and analytical processes.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Manage, mentor, and develop a team of analysts and senior analysts.
* Provide technical guidance, quality assurance, and professional development support.
* Foster a collaborative and high-performance team culture.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, training, and capability-building initiatives.

**Client Engagement & Commercial Support**

* Act as a senior point of contact for client questions and market inquiries.
* Lead client briefings, presentations, workshops, and strategic discussions.
* Translate complex market developments into clear and actionable insights for clients.
* Support business development activities, including proposals, client meetings, and commercial discussions.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, industry participants, regulators, and policymakers.

**Quality Assurance & Research Excellence**

* Review and approve research outputs, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and analytical rigor.
* Maintain high editorial standards across regional publications.
* Identify opportunities to enhance research products, modelling capabilities, and client offerings.
* Ensure research processes and methodologies remain industry-leading.

**Requirements**
**Intellectual Curiosity & Leadership**

* Strong intellectual curiosity and passion for energy markets.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex research programs and develop market insights.
* Collaborative leadership style with a track record of mentoring and developing teams.
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Client-focused mindset with a strong commitment to delivering impactful insights and exceptional service.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Economics, Energy Studies, Finance, Public Policy, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of experience within a utility, power developer, consultancy, research provider, market intelligence company, university, think tank, investment firm, or other energy-focused organization.
* Deep expertise in Indian power markets and strong knowledge of broader South Asian electricity markets.
* Proven experience leading research projects, market analysis, forecasting, or consulting engagements.
* Demonstrated experience managing and mentoring analysts or research teams.
* Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities, including power market modelling, commercial analysis, or market forecasting.
* Experience with optimization and dispatch models such as Plexos, Aurora, SDDP, or equivalent tools is highly desirable.
* Strong experience working with large datasets, databases, APIs, and analytical tools including Python, SQL, and Power BI/Power Query.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Deep understanding of power market fundamentals and renewable energy market dynamics.
* Strong knowledge of electricity market design, generation economics, transmission systems, storage technologies, and market reforms.
* Expertise in policy and regulatory frameworks across India and South Asia.
* Strong understanding of capacity markets, ancillary services, power purchase agreements, renewable support mechanisms, grid integration challenges, and energy transition pathways.
* Familiarity with investment decision-making, market risk assessment, and commercial strategy within power markets.
* Ability to connect technical analysis with commercial and strategic implications for clients.

**Communication & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Proven ability to write, review, and edit high-quality research reports and client-facing publications.
* Strong presentation skills and confidence engaging with senior stakeholders and executive audiences.
* Experience leading client briefings, workshops, webinars, and conference presentations.
* Ability to explain complex modelling outputs and market developments clearly and concisely.
* Fluency in additional South Asian languages is an advantage.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A recognized thought leader in South Asian power markets.
* Delivery of industry-leading research and market insights.
* Strong client satisfaction and engagement across the research portfolio.
* A high-performing, motivated, and well-developed analyst team.
* Continued growth and enhancement of the South Asia research offering and market presence.

* Conduct deep-dive analyses of complex customer journeys, segmentation, and program effectiveness to inform strategy and recommendations.
* Lead recurring business reviews for Customer Marketing and partner teams, bringing forward clear insights, trends, risks, and recommendations against goals and benchmarks.
* Establish and enforce data quality standards, tracking taxonomy, and documentation to improve trust, consistency, and usability of metrics.
* Identify and implement process, reporting, and workflow improvements that increase the speed, quality, and efficiency of analytics delivery.
* Oversee and mentor a team of analysts, managing roadmaps, intake, prioritization, and delivery while raising the bar on analytical quality and business impact.
* Influence decisions through strong storytelling, stakeholder management, and the ability to connect analysis to real business action.

**Overall Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in marketing analytics, with strong expertise in customer lifecycle analytics, retention and renewal measurement, and program performance analysis.
* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Demonstrated ability to define KPIs, build measurement frameworks, and connect marketing activity to business outcomes such as renewals, expansion, and program penetration.
* Strong experience translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for non-technical and executive audiences.
* Proficiency with Sigma or comparable business intelligence tools, with strong dashboarding and data visualization skills.
* Experience with data modeling, data quality practices, and analytical approaches that support scalable decision-making.
* Proven success leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders across Marketing, Customer Success, and Revenue teams.
* Experience managing, coaching, and developing analytical talent.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, including with executive-level stakeholders.

**Technical AI Experience**

* Experience integrating AI-powered tools into analytics workflows.
* Demonstrated ability to use AI for tasks such as summarizing insights, accelerating analysis, or generating narrative takeaways from data.
* Hands-on experience building AI-assisted workflows, experimentation frameworks, or practical applications that improve analytical efficiency and decision-making.
* The following would be a strong advantage
* Familiarity with marketing attribution models and marketing mix modeling.
* Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouses.
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce, Marketo, or customer data platforms.

Peepul is an education-focused non-profit working with governments to strengthen India’s public education system at scale. We partner with national, state, and local governments to improve teaching, leadership, and system effectiveness in government schools.

Learn more: http://peepulindia.org

**Where we are on Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL)**

Over the last 2 years, we have built a sophisticated MEL function, that works with large- scale data with Alteryx and PowerBI, partners with programmes to co-design and implement impact measurement tools, has detailed Theories of Change of the organization and programmes, and connects the dots across experiences. In the next 3 years, we plan to leverage our impact track record and learnings, to be a leading thought leader in the sector, and be a role model of impact measurement. We are involved with one of the early Development Impact Bonds in education in India, are working on large-scale programmes, and are staying deeply rooted in our exemplar schools as innovation grounds – all these pioneering initiatives come together to form a strong MEL launchpad for the organization.

**About the role**

The Associate, MEL at Peepul is purpose-driven, understanding the organization's values and the significance of their work. They embrace diverse perspectives, take ownership of deliverables, and work efficiently with minimal guidance. Their entrepreneurial mindset drives them to seek greater responsibility and contribute to organization-building activities. They possess extensive knowledge of the Indian education system, actively shaping best practices and maintaining clear communication. As supportive team players, they foster a positive team climate through active listening and self-motivation. The Project Associate's competence, dedication, and initiative make them a valuable asset to Peepul's mission.

The (Sr.) Associate, MEL will be contributing to the Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning efforts and strengthening our Delhi and Madhya Pradesh programs. Measuring impact is in the DNA of our organisation, especially as we grow and scale our work. This is an exciting opportunity for an individual who wants to learn more about measuring the impact of programs at scale, contribute to our program evaluation, and ensure that we are iterating on program design and course-correcting, using data and evidence.

Responsibilities would include (including but not limited to):

**1.Execute the organisation's MEL design and strategy to become a sector leader in impact measurement.**

* Contribute to the execution of the organization-wide MEL strategy, including identifying and designing mission-critical indicators.
* Collaborate with the MEL team on monitoring and impact evaluation internally, or collaborate with external agencies, analyse findings from such evaluations, and use learnings to inform program design.
* Implement different systems and processes to improve MEL and program cycles.

**2.Drive data-based decision-making within the organization.**

* Support the design of the monitoring and evaluation framework and the tools for different Peepul programs in Delhi and Madhya Pradesh.
* Conduct regular quantitative and qualitative data collection and analysis and use automation/visualization tools to present data to internal and external audiences.
* Ensure timely implementation of monitoring projects with a strong focus on execution and quality assurance, including data validity checks.
* Collaborate with the program design and implementation teams to interpret the data and ensure that the learnings are incorporated into the continuous cycle of program design and implementation.
* Develop and update data dashboards for each project in collaboration with partners and relevant agencies.

**3.Contribute to the thought leadership of Peepul in the sector.**

* Contribute to research projects to collect and analyze data from organizations across India and abroad to build evidence that can be used to inform practitioners, funders, and policymakers within the education sector.

**Qualifications and Role Requirements:**

At Peepul, we seek talented professionals passionate about driving educational transformation and making a positive impact. We are looking for individuals who possess the following qualifications and meet the role requirements:

* **Educational Background:**
  A relevant educational background in international development, statistics, education, public policy, economics, or a related field.
* **Work Experience:**
  We value both professional and personal experience. Candidates with 2-4 years of experience in the private/public sector with successful research management and monitoring/evaluation in the development sector. Prior experience in designing and implementing M&E frameworks, conducting impact evaluations, and using data to inform program design and decision-making.
* **Other Skills:**
  Excellent quantitative, qualitative, problem-solving, analytical, and statistical analysis skills (including advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience with analytical tools such as SPSS, Stata, R, Alteryx, or Python)
* **Language Proficiency:**
  English and Hindi

Apply via Peepul's careers portal using "Apply" button.

You will be required to submit:

* CV (1–2 pages) outlining relevant experience and qualifications.
* Cover Letter explaining your motivation to work with Peepul and alignment with the role.

For queries related to the hiring process, reach out to recruitment@peepulindia.org

title: Applied AI Architect
description:
**About The Team**
The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business”, shaping each customer's AI strategy and guiding their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.
  
  
You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.
  
  
You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.
  
  
This role can be based in Delhi, Mumbai, or Bangalore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre-sales prospects.
* Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.
* Lead discovery with executives and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes.
* Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.
* Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, securing confidence in both the solution and its path to production.
* Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans.
* Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.
* Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.
* Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.
* Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.
* Apply industry or digital-native expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.
* Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices.

**You Might Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.
* Have guided enterprise organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable business impact.
* Build credibility with senior technical and business leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers.
* Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy.
* Understand modern AI systems, frontier LLM models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, or enterprise AI workflows.
* Can prototype, explain technical tradeoffs, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript.
* Exercise sound judgment about when to go deep personally, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership.
* Have experience developing technical account plans, prioritizing complex customer portfolios, and connecting adoption to measurable outcomes.
* Bring meaningful expertise in a relevant industry or strong fluency with the needs of digital-native businesses.
* Communicate clearly and can turn ambiguity into a practical technical narrative, executive decision, or action plan.
* Work collaboratively across disciplines and care deeply about helping organizations deploy advanced AI responsibly.

**About OpenAI**
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
  
  
For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

title: Senior Product Data Scientist
description:
**About Amplify Health**

**Who We Are**

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain.

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.

Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies—with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems.

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health’s health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company’s technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards.

As an ISO27001 certified organization, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security

**Our Vision and Ambition**

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery.

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals’ lifestyle/ behavioural choices.

By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia’s strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools.

**The Position**

**Summary**

The Senior Product Scientist will serve as a recognized organisational expert in Generative AI, Agentic AI, NLP and healthcare AI systems. This role shapes the Data & AI technical strategy and architecture, leads complex and high-impact AI initiatives, and establishes reusable, responsible AI capabilities across products, markets and business functions.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional depth in NLP, LLMs, RAG and agentic systems with broad architectural, data, analytics, product and healthcare domain judgement. The candidate defines how reliable AI systems should be designed, evaluated, governed and scaled, while developing the technical community through mentorship, standards and thought leadership.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the full model lifecycle for assigned models within one product: data assessment, EDA, feature engineering, experimentation, validation, deployment, monitoring, recalibration and retirement.
* Build reusable, configurable models across ML, NLP and GenAI, deployable to any customer through configuration and pre-designed extension points, never customer-specific code.
* Develop and productionise GenAI/ LLM-based workflows where relevant, including prompting, retrieval, fine-tuning approaches and evaluation harnesses.
* Apply advanced methods appropriate to the problem: predictive modelling, forecasting, causal inference, survival analysis, uplift, optimisation, anomaly detection and NLP.
* Establish robust evaluation designs, including out-of-time and out-of-population validation, leakage controls, calibration, explainability, fairness, uncertainty and model-risk assessment.
* Produce the model documentation, implementation playbooks and evaluation evidence that ship with the release, so implementation teams can deploy without you.
* Provide independent validation of models built by other teams, never of models you built yourself.
* Partner with engineering on reusable features, model pipelines, scoring services and monitoring capabilities.
* Deliver ad-hoc analysis and insight, define and validate the product's metrics, and lead dashboards that track adoption and realised value across customers
* Champion approved AI-assisted development tools to accelerate design, analysis, testing and documentation, with appropriate governance over confidentiality, reproducibility and review.
* Mentor junior data scientists, conduct technical reviews and raise standards for analytical rigour, code quality and delivery discipline

**Candidate Profile**

**Required Qualifications**

* 6+ years developing and implementing end-to-end machine learning or AI solutions, with production deployments at scale.
* Deep expertise in statistics, machine learning, feature engineering, evaluation and interpretation, with demonstrated experience in several advanced methods.
* Hands-on experience with NLP and transformer-based models, and practical exposure to LLM workflows, fine-tuning, evaluation and RAG.
* Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, PySpark, Databricks, MLflow, PyTorch, Azure AI services and LLM APIs.
* Proven record of building reusable models or components that deploy across multiple customers or markets without rebuilds.
* Strong grounding in evaluation rigour: leakage controls, out-of-time validation, calibration, explainability, fairness and model risk.
* Experience leading complex technical workstreams and mentoring data scientists; 2+ years is highly desirable.
* Experience driving adoption of AI-powered development tools for design specs, model cards, experiment summaries and runbooks, with measurable productivity gains.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including explaining technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced matrix environment, managing stakeholder expectations, priorities and timelines

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in healthcare, health insurance, payer or provider analytics, population health, claims, care management, clinical operations or health data platforms.
* Experience with healthcare data standards, privacy requirements, regulated environments and responsible AI considerations.
* Hands-on experience with Azure, Databricks or equivalent cloud and data platforms.
* Working knowledge of MLOps and LLMOps, CI/CD for ML, feature stores, model registries and monitoring.
* Experience optimising systems for accuracy, latency, reliability, cost and maintainability.
* Exposure to multimodal AI, knowledge graphs, medical text analytics or clinical decision support.

**What Good Looks Like**

* Models you build deploy to a new customer through configuration, not a rebuild.
* Evaluation is rigorous enough that results survive contact with customer data.
* Documentation and playbooks are complete enough that customer implementation teams do not need you.
* High ownership mindset with a focus on outcomes, not just models.
* Raises the standard of those around you through review and mentorship.

**Join Us**

If you are passionate about leveraging data to drive healthier outcomes across Asia and thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment, we encourage you to apply.

Amplify Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**Position**
Data Scientist
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Data Scientist at Encardio, you will analyze complex time-series data from devices such as accelerometers, strain gauges, and tilt meters. Your responsibilities will span data preprocessing, feature engineering, machine learning model development, and integration with real-time systems.
  
  
You will collaborate closely with engineers and domain experts to translate physical behaviors into actionable insights. This role is ideal for someone with strong statistical skills, experience in time-series modeling, and a keen interest in understanding the real-world impact of models in civil and industrial monitoring.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Clean, preprocess, and denoise high-frequency time-series data from IoT devices
* Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) and identify anomalies and patterns in multi-sensor datasets
* Design and implement time-domain and frequency-domain feature extraction pipelines
* Build machine learning models for anomaly detection, event classification, and predictive maintenance

title: Staff Analyst
description:
The Central Sales Analytics team at MongoDB sits at the center of how we understand and improve the performance of our revenue engine. While this role is rooted in Sales Analytics, its scope is broader and spans key parts of the GTM organization. This team partners closely with Sales, Sales Operations, Strategy & Planning, FP&A, Compensation, GTM Tech, and other cross-functional stakeholders to drive data-informed decisions across pipeline, productivity, forecasting, product adoption, and overall business performance.
  
  
We are looking for a Sr/Staff Analyst who can operate as both a strategic thought partner and a hands-on builder. This person will lead high-impact analytics work, translate ambiguous business questions into clear analytical plans, and develop scalable data products that help leaders make better decisions faster. The right candidate combines strong business judgment with deep technical fluency in SQL and Python, and is comfortable influencing senior stakeholders while independently driving complex work from scoping through execution.
  
  
This role also sits at an important intersection of GTM, Product, and Technology. In select cases, this person will work with Product and Technical teams to connect GTM insights with product signals and customer behavior, especially across GTM Tech, Atlas Core, and Emerging Products. There is also a strong expectation that this person brings an AI-forward mindset, using leading AI technologies and platforms to accelerate analysis, improve workflows, and build scalable insight-generation capabilities.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  

* Partner with Sales, Sales Operations, Strategy & Planning, FP&A, Compensation, GTM Tech, and broader GTM stakeholders to identify high-value analytical opportunities and turn them into actionable insights
* Lead deep-dive analyses across pipeline health, funnel conversion, seller productivity, quota attainment, coverage and territory effectiveness, forecasting, and broader GTM performance trends
* Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses, clear recommendations, and scalable data solutions
* Connect GTM outcomes with product and customer signals to identify growth opportunities, improve prioritization, and deepen understanding of the customer journey
* Partner selectively with Product and Technical teams to inform decisions that sit at the intersection of commercial strategy, product behavior, and operational execution
* Collaborate with GTM Tech, Atlas Core, and Emerging Products to combine business context with technical and product signals in ways that improve insight generation and strategic alignment
* Build scalable dashboards, datasets, reporting layers, analytical frameworks, and self-service tools that raise the quality and speed of decision-making
* Use SQL and Python as core tools for data extraction, transformation, analysis, automation, modeling, and repeatable insight generation
* Apply leading AI technologies and platforms to improve analytical workflows, accelerate discovery, and develop scalable data and insight products that can be reused across teams
* Present findings to stakeholders across levels, including senior leaders, with a strong focus on clarity, business impact, and actionability
* Partner with Data Engineering, Data Architecture, IT, and adjacent analytics teams to improve the quality, usability, and scalability of sales and GTM data assets
* Strengthen data governance, metric consistency, and reporting reliability by identifying root causes of data issues and driving durable improvements
* Raise the analytical bar for the team by improving processes, sharing best practices, and mentoring other analysts where appropriate

What we're looking for
  
  

* 6+ years of experience in Sales Analytics, GTM Analytics, Revenue Analytics, Business Analytics, or a closely related field
* Strong fluency in both SQL and Python; both are core requirements for success in this role
* Proven ability to work with large, messy datasets and translate complex analyses into clear business insights and recommendations
* Strong background supporting go-to-market, sales, revenue, customer, or commercial organizations in a SaaS or high-growth technology environment
* Demonstrated ability to work across business and technical teams and influence decisions through data, structured thinking, and clear communication
* Experience building scalable analytics assets such as data models, dashboards, automated workflows, decision frameworks, or reusable insight products
* Ability to connect business questions to product usage, customer behavior, and operational signals in a way that drives action
* Strong foundation in data modeling, metric design, data quality, and data governance principles
* Ability to independently lead ambiguous, cross-functional projects from problem framing through delivery and stakeholder adoption
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior audiences with data
* Hands-on experience using modern AI technologies or platforms to enhance analysis, improve productivity, or build scalable analytical capabilities
* Strong ownership mindset with the judgment to know when to go deep, when to simplify, and how to drive impact across functions

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience working across both GTM analytics and product analytics contexts
* Familiarity with product telemetry, customer health signals, usage trends, or product-led growth motions
* Experience partnering with Product, Engineering, Data Engineering, or GTM Systems / GTM Tech teams
* Experience supporting Atlas Core, Emerging Products, or similarly technical product portfolios
* Track record of building internal analytical tools, automation, or data products that scale beyond a single stakeholder group
* Experience applying experimentation, forecasting, machine learning, or advanced statistical methods in business settings
* Experience with Tableau or similar BI tools
* Familiarity with Salesforce and other core GTM systems

Why this role matters
  
  
This role will help shape how MongoDB uses data to make better decisions across the revenue engine. The person in this seat will influence how we measure performance, identify growth opportunities, improve operational execution, and connect GTM outcomes more tightly to customer behavior, product adoption, and emerging opportunities across the business.
  
  
By combining strong business judgment, deep technical analytics capability, and an AI-forward approach, this analyst will help MongoDB move faster, make better decisions, and build scalable insight capabilities that benefit teams well beyond Sales Analytics.
  
  
**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

title: Commodity Research Analyst - Demand
description:
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  
The Commodity Research Analyst (Demand) will conduct complex trading analytics efforts focused on Grains and Oilseeds Markets with specific focus on the livestock and feed markets. In this role, you will analyse short- and long-term livestock growth trends, margins, inventory, supply and demand fundamentals, industry developments, and government policy changes, with a particular focus on the dairy and poultry sectors in India.
  
  
You will translate livestock market insights into feed-volume forecasts, assess industrialization in the feed sector as a driver of growth, and combine feed-formulation models with industry intelligence to develop dynamic, tradable demand forecasts. The role will support trading, risk management, and asset-utilization decisions across global and local markets.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Develop and execute models and tools to forecast prices, demand, relative value, and global market trends.
* Analyse short- and long-term livestock growth, margins, and inventory, with a focus on the dairy and poultry sectors.
* Translate livestock and feed-formulation insights into dynamic, tradable feed-volume and commodity-demand forecasts, considering feed-sector industrialization.
* Analyse demand, pricing, and supply fundamentals across Corn, wheat, oilseeds, DDGS, and other grain and oilseed by-products.
* Produce weekly supply-and-demand and price updates; assess India’s government policies, industry developments, capacity expansion, and competitive dynamics.
* Partner with traders, commercial teams, analysts, and stakeholders to develop market scenarios, provide actionable insights, support data and technology initiatives, and resolve issues independently.

**Qualifications**
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience, with a minimum of three years of relevant work experience.
* Knowledge of trading, risk management, economics, and commodity supply-and-demand fundamentals, including agricultural commodity markets.
* Strong analytical reasoning and collaboration skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information, derive accurate insights, and build consensus with global teams and local stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree with proficiency in modelling, coding, data science, and big data management, including experience developing supply-and-demand forecasts, price models, scenario analyses, or other trading analytics.
* Knowledge or experience in feed formulation, feed-sector industrialization, particularly in India.

title: Senior Associate - Model Risk Management
description:

Additionally, you will support model risk management activities while collaborating with your team and other stakeholders
  
  
We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. Our team is responsible for reviewing and approving Macquarie’s risk models across capital, credit provisioning and pricing. It provides assurance on the suitability of Macquarie's internally developed models by conducting a range of model validations whilst ensuring all models are integrated correctly in our trading and risk management systems

* Good understanding of financial markets and mathematical techniques for pricing derivatives;
* Experience in object-oriented programming on languages such as C++ and python;

title: Senior Analyst, Practice Operations
description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefining industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.

 

The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.

 

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

 

**Job Summary**

Bain’s Airlines, Logistics and Transport (ALT) sector is part of the Advanced Manufacturing & Services (AMS) Practice. The Operations Senior Analyst role sits at the intersection of client relationship management, knowledge management, and AI enablement. You will help sector leadership and account teams improve client engagement, strengthen commercial execution, and scale best practices and IP — and you will build and maintain a growing library of AI-powered tools, skills, and automations that case teams can pull off the shelf. Working closely with partners, knowledge management, and product teams globally, your mandate is to take routine analytical and administrative work off case teams’ plates so they can focus on higher-value activities.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

 

**Client and Account Support**

* Support the smooth operation of Bain’s CRM tool (“Cortex” on a Salesforce platform) for approximately 30 key accounts, ensuring data integrity and consistent usage.
* Monitor client engagement patterns and surface signals that indicate opportunities for timely partner outreach.

* Build and maintain recurring dashboards and reports (e.g., account status, activity, pipeline signals) to help client heads proactively manage relationships and identify growth opportunities.
* Design and maintain a centralized repository (on Bain approved platforms) for pitch materials, proposals, case examples, and templates; ensure content is searchable, appropriately tagged, and version-controlled for reuse.
* Partner with Knowledge Management to develop microsites using established frameworks, improving speed and consistency of content access for teams.
* Partner with other sector/practice PPK teams to cross-pollinate IP.
* Contribute to sector IP development by participating in the creation of new IP as opportunities arise.
* Support IP deployment and commercialization by assisting the Regional Sector Leaders with go-to-market planning (timing, channels, and enablement materials).
* Maintain and update sector affiliate and expert lists (in coordination with relevant internal teams) to improve access to expertise when needed.

**AI Enablement**

* Build and maintain a practice-level repository of reusable AI assets — including Claude skills (SKILL.md files), artifacts, prompts, and agent configurations — that case teams can pull off the shelf to accelerate recurring analytical and content tasks. Own the taxonomy, documentation, access, and version control of these assets, and drive adoption through onboarding materials and light coaching of case teams.
* Develop purpose-built AI tools that turn sector data sources into fast, case-ready outputs — for example, skills that analyze Cirium Diio schedule data or IATA MarketIS booking data to produce quick market sizing, competitive dynamics, route economics, or network-change analyses on demand for case teams.
* Set up and maintain recurring AI-driven insight generation pipelines that combine licensed data subscriptions (e.g., Cirium Diio, IATA MarketIS) with public and scraped sources to produce regular sector pulses, trend updates, and proprietary points of view the practice can push to partners and clients.
* Identify routine, repetitive tasks across the practice — administrative, reporting, research, or data-prep — and design AI automations, freeing up time for client-facing and judgment-heavy work. Deploy automations responsibly with appropriate confidentiality, data handling, and access controls.
* Catalogue and maintain the sector’s library of hosted proof-of-concept apps built for proposals and pitches — capturing what each app does, the client and proposal context it was built for, where it is hosted, its current status, and the internal owner — so the practice can quickly surface, demo, or repurpose prior POCs in new pitch situations. Coordinate with partners and product teams to retire stale apps and promote proven ones into reusable assets.

  

**Qualifications**

Required

* 2-5 years of professional experience, ideally in professional services, consulting, technology, or data-driven roles.
* Quantitative undergraduate degree (or equivalent analytical training).
* Hands-on familiarity with Claude and/or other leading GenAI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot). Comfortable designing effective prompts, applying LLMs to real work tasks such as document synthesis, content drafting, and data extraction, and critically evaluating outputs to improve quality. Genuine interest in going beyond day-to-day usage to author and share reusable AI assets — prompts, custom GPTs, Claude skills, and artifacts — that other people can pick up and run with.
* Light analytics and data skills, including advanced Excel (pivot tables, lookups, dynamic arrays, chart-building) and basic SQL or Python for querying, cleaning, and transforming data. Comfortable structuring datasets, performing exploratory analysis, and producing clear, insight-driven outputs for non-technical audiences.
* Ability to drive work end-to-end with limited direction; strong organization and attention to detail.
* Effective stakeholder management skills, including the ability to steer small working meetings and contribute thoughtfully with senior stakeholders.

Preferred

* Hands-on experience with Salesforce reporting and dashboarding, including building custom reports, configuring dashboards for different user personas, and working with report types and filters. Strong CRM and data-quality habits — including ownership of data hygiene routines, deduplication, consistent taxonomy and tagging, and proactive identification of gaps or inconsistencies that could affect downstream reporting.
* Experience with knowledge management tools such as SharePoint, Google Drive, or Confluence, including setting up structured content libraries, applying metadata and tagging schemas to aid discoverability, and managing access and permissions across user groups. Familiarity with basic content governance and versioning practices — including lifecycle management (draft, approved, archived), naming conventions, and periodic content review cycles to ensure materials remain current and reusable.
* Automation experience using tools such as Power Automate, Zapier, or n8n, Salesforce flows and process builders, or light scripting (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Apps Script) to connect systems and streamline repetitive tasks. A track record of shipping reusable AI assets that others have adopted is a strong plus, as is experience identifying high-friction processes and replacing them with automated solutions that demonstrably freed up time.

title: AI-Native Founder’s Office Intern
description:
Focus: Strategy | Product | Investments | Growth | Automation

Location: Gurgaon, in-office

Duration: 3–6 months, preference for 6-month commitment

Stipend: ₹10,000/month

Eligibility: Final-year students only

Opportunity: Potential full-time role after graduation

We are looking for an AI-native, high-agency generalist to work directly with the Founder across technology, product, investments, strategy and growth.

This is not a conventional internship with a fixed daily task list. You could be researching an investment opportunity in the morning, building an AI workflow in the afternoon and helping put together a product or GTM idea by evening.

What you will work on

• Use AI tools extensively for research, analysis, automation and execution

• Research startups, founders, sectors, technologies and investment opportunities

• Identify and continuously build a pipeline of relevant investment and deal leads

• Maintain trackers for companies, founders, investors, conversations and follow-ups

• Prepare quick company analyses, investment notes, market maps and competitive research

• Understand basic business models, financials, valuations and investment-banking concepts

• Research potential investors, strategic partners, customers and acquisition opportunities

• Support product thinking — features, user journeys, competitive products and new ideas

• Build quick websites, landing pages, prototypes and internal tools using AI/no-code tools

• Work comfortably with data, spreadsheets, dashboards and large amounts of information

• Experiment with AI agents and automation to eliminate repetitive Founder’s Office work

• Help with pre-sales — company research, meeting preparation, proposals and follow-ups

• Create presentations, briefs, website content and decision notes when required

• Track important developments across AI, startups, investments and technology

• Take unstructured information and convert it into something the Founder can make a decision on

Who should apply

You are a final-year student based in Gurgaon/Delhi NCR and can work from Gurgaon.

You should be genuinely AI-native. ChatGPT/Claude should feel like an everyday working environment, not something you occasionally use to write an email.

You don’t necessarily need to be a hardcore coder, but you should be technically comfortable enough to figure out how to build, automate or prototype something using AI tools.

You should have a genuine interest in at least a few of these areas: AI, product, startups, venture capital, investment banking, strategy or technology.

You should be good at research, but more importantly, know how to zero down from 100 pieces of information to the five that actually matter.

You should be comfortable jumping between technology and business. One problem may require understanding APIs and AI tools; another may require looking at a company’s financials or finding the right investor.

We value curiosity, speed and resourcefulness over perfect credentials.

If you don’t know something, your instinct should be to figure it out using AI, research, people and tools rather than waiting for someone to explain it.

Commitment

This is a 3–6 month in-office internship, with a strong preference for candidates who can commit for 6 months.

We are specifically looking at final-year students because the objective is to identify exceptional people who can potentially transition into a full-time Founder’s Office role after graduation.

* Please do not apply if you are looking for a remote internship, only a certificate, or a conventional internship with narrowly defined responsibilities.

title: Assistant Manager - Liquidity Platforms
description:
Join our team and you will have an opportunity to work in a dynamic and supportive work environment. Our Group Treasury team manages funding, capital, and liquidity position of Macquarie and develops internal liquidity frameworks, interprets regulatory requirements, and monitors compliance.
  
  
We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.
  
  
**What role will you play?**
In this role, you analyze functional requirements, design technical solutions, and support the implementation of regulatory and liquidity reporting processes. You will ensure compliance with Basel III norms and optimize data flows using platforms like Axiom, SQL, and Alteryx. If you are passionate about bridging business needs with technical execution to deliver impactful outcomes, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
**What You Offer**

* Experience as a Business Analyst for 3-8 years in a financial services industry, specializing in regulatory and liquidity reporting.
* Strong knowledge of Basel III regulations and liquidity risk metrics like LCR and NSFR.
* Strong proficiency in SQL, Axiom and Alteryx (Preferred)..
* Experience in preparing test cases, performing Production Validation Testing (PVT), and supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Comprehensive understanding of bank balance sheets and financial products, including assets and liabilities.

We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**What We Offer**
**Benefits**
At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include:
  
  

* 1 wellbeing leave day per year
* 26 weeks’ paid maternity leave or 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of paid transition leave upon return to work and 6 weeks’ paid leave for secondary caregivers
* Company-subsidised childcare services
* 2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching
* Benefits to support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing including comprehensive medical and life insurance cover, the option to join parental medical insurance plan and virtual medical consultations extended to family members
* Access to our Employee Assistance Program, a robust behavioural health network with counselling and coaching services
* Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription
* Hybrid and flexible working arrangements, dependent on role
* Reimbursement for work from home equipment

**About Financial Management, People and Engagement**
Financial Management, People and Engagement (FPE) provides a single interface for Macquarie’s businesses across key areas of people, strategy, communications and financial management. Comprising two pillars – Financial Management, and People and Engagement – it is responsible for managing the Group’s financial, tax and treasury activities and strategic priorities, fostering our culture through people and community engagement strategies, and engaging with stakeholders to protect and promote Macquarie’s reputation globally.

We are committed to providing an inclusive environment for all, where different experiences, skills and perspectives are valued and respected. Macquarie provides access to opportunities for all individuals regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, marital status, gender identity or any other characteristic or circumstance.

title: Senior Associate Technology L2_Python
description:

Publicis Sapient is looking for Python Developers to join our team of bright thinkers and enablers. You will use your problem-solving skills, craft, and creativity to design and develop infrastructure interfaces for complex business applications. You will build and orchestrate agentic, GenAI-powered workflows that transform how our clients operate – from data ingestion and enrichment to intelligent, LLM-driven automation. We are on a mission to transform the world, and you will be instrumental in shaping how we do it with your ideas, thoughts, and solutions.

* Build and orchestrate agentic workflows using LangChain and LangGraph to power scalable, production-ready GenAI solutions.
* Develop reusable components for data ingestion, transformation, enrichment, and validation that accelerate delivery across projects.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and traceability across agent workflows to support dependable, enterprise-grade AI applications.
* Implement performance monitoring with tools like LangSmith and apply tuning mechanisms to continuously improve agent accuracy and efficiency.
* Deploy and maintain Python-based GenAI services in production, leveraging Bitbucket, Git, and CI/CD tools for reliable releases.
* Architect secure API communication and access management, using JWT, OAuth, and RBAC, to safeguard sensitive client data.
* Apply NLP, LLM, and retrieval techniques, including vector stores and embeddings, to build context-aware, intelligent solutions for clients.

**Qualifications**

* Strong Python fundamentals (OOP, data structures, error handling) with hands-on experience using Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, or Dask.

* Proficiency in Python API frameworks (Flask/FastAPI), with experience using IDEs such as VSCode and PyCharm.
* Working knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases, time-series data, and data modeling and schema design.
* Basic integration experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch, plus exposure to vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Chroma) and embedding-based retrieval.
* Proficiency with AWS Cloud Services and production deployment practices, including Bitbucket, Git, and CI/CD tools.
* Strong understanding of security & access management – JWT, OAuth, RBAC – and secure API communication.

* Prior work on GenAI, CoPilot, or RAG-based systems.
* Familiarity with marketing data models and real-time customer journeys.
* Exposure to NLP, LLMs, and retrieval frameworks beyond the core requirements above.

description:
Title: Research Associate / Senior Research Associate (Weather Initiative)
  
  
Location: Delhi, India preferred. Candidates must have existing authorization to work in India; PxD is unable to sponsor visas for this role.
  
  
Salary: Salary will be competitive and commensurate with the candidate's skills, experience, and the local labor market in India
  
  
Position: Full-time
  
  
Application deadline: October 25, 2026, at 5 pm IST (applications may be reviewed as they are submitted)
  
  
**About The Role**
Precision Development (PxD) is looking for a Research Associate / Senior Research Associate to join our team. The successful candidate will work closely with PxD and affiliated researchers, contributing substantially to PxD's weather initiative in India — testing new ideas and measuring their impact. The role calls for someone who understands and appreciates how digital technology is adopted and scaled within government.
  
  
If you're passionate about working with government to scale evidence-based, technology-driven solutions, and committed to driving positive change in the agricultural sector, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
We're hiring for this role at either the Research Associate or Senior Research Associate level. The specific level will be determined based on the candidate's years of experience, demonstrated seniority, and scope of past responsibilities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
These will evolve as the role develops; key initial areas are outlined below.
  
  
Data & Systems
  
  

* Support implementation and performance tuning of dashboards visualizing weather and related data (R/Shiny, SQL)
* Develop and maintain data pipelines for ingesting, processing, and storing weather data (APIs, databases)
* Support streamlining and automation of weather data workflows for PxD's research teams
* Monitor data quality and flag anomalies or gaps in incoming weather data feeds
* Support and train local staff on SQL tasks related to weather data systems

Analysis & Development
  
  

* Prepare weather and related operational/research data for analysis
* Conduct data analysis or build predictive models/tools using weather data:

+ To improve existing PxD operations, systems, or services (e.g. advisory triggers, alert thresholds)
+ As part of research projects using weather data (e.g. correlating weather variables with program outcomes)

* Prototype and conduct feasibility analysis for new weather-data-based services (e.g. remote sensing–based advisory, forecast integration)
* Support technical troubleshooting and uptime of weather data systems (APIs, sensors, third-party data providers)

**What You’ll Bring**

* A Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in economics, agricultural economics, public policy, statistics, or a closely related field.
* Strong understanding of economics, econometrics, and familiarity with randomized evaluations.
* Excellent knowledge of Stata, R, Python, or similar software for data analysis.
* Demonstrated experience working on field research in economics in LMIC countries.
* Demonstrated experience in using SurveyCTO/ODK or a similar program for survey design.
* Understanding of research ethics for human subjects in the social sciences.
* Excellent organizational skills, detail-oriented, and ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
* Fluency in English. Demonstrated strong oral and written communication skills. Knowledge of any Indian language is a plus.
* Ability to work under time pressure and solve problems creatively.
* Willingness to travel to project sites and conduct fieldwork.

**About Precision Development (PxD)**
PxD is a rapidly scaling global nonprofit working with governments across Africa and Asia to close the last-mile gap in smallholder farming. We deliver evidence-based information and tools — from timely farming and weather guidance to climate-resilient inputs — that millions of farmers use to improve their lives. In the last 12 months alone, we reached over 60 million farmers at a cost of just $0.47 per farmer per year, with our flagship program in India delivering a benefit-cost ratio of 12:1–19:1.
  
  
Operating in Ethiopia, India, Indonesia, Kenya, Nigeria, and beyond, the majority of our team is based in our program countries, working directly alongside government partners and farming communities toward our goal of improving the lives of 100 million farmers by 2030.
  
  
**How To Apply**
To apply, please visit the PxD website and use the online application form to submit a CV, cover letter, and brief responses to the screening questions. Applications may be reviewed on a rolling basis. The final deadline to apply is 25 October 2026, 6 pm IST.
  
  
In line with our values, we evaluate candidates on merit alone, without regard to gender, gender identity, ethnicity, religion, disability, caste, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. We offer flexible working arrangements to support your wellbeing. Personal data provided is used for recruitment purposes only.
