title: AI Safety Reseracher
description:
**Designation:** 
 AI Safety Researcher (Niche Role)
 



  





**Educational Qualification** 



* B.Tech./B.E. or M.Tech./M.S./M.Sc. in Computer Science, Information Security, AI/ML, or a related quantitative discipline
 **(Must have)**
* Advanced degree (M.Tech./M.S./Ph.D.) with a thesis or published work in adversarial ML, AI security, LLM safety, or Responsible AI is highly desirable
* Certifications (Desirable): OSCP, GWAPT or CEH combined with demonstrable AI/ML security work; DeepLearning.AI or equivalent ML foundations; MLSecOps or LLM\-security specialist certifications where available
* Non\-traditional backgrounds with demonstrable adversarial ML research, published safety work, credible LLM red\-team disclosures, or CTF/red\-team achievements will be considered in lieu of formal qualification



  





**Experience** 



* 6\+ years total in ML, applied AI, security research, or a closely related discipline;
 **minimum 3 years specifically in adversarial ML, AI red teaming, LLM safety evaluation, or AI/ML security research**
* Demonstrable hands\-on LLM red\-teaming experience with documented prompt\-injection, jailbreak, indirect\-prompt\-injection or agentic\-tool\-misuse campaigns against production or production\-like systems
* Demonstrable adversarial ML work — evasion, model inversion, membership inference, model extraction, or data poisoning — against non\-toy classifiers, vision models, or NLP systems
* Prior experience delivering safety, red\-team, or Responsible AI work in government, BFSI, healthcare, or another regulated sector is a strong plus
* Prior experience advising or upskilling non\-specialist engineering, security, or compliance teams on AI\-specific security concerns is desirable



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Adversarial ML \& Model Security Testing** 



* Design and execute adversarial attack campaigns — evasion, model inversion, membership inference, model extraction, data poisoning — against pod deliverables including document intelligence, predictive\-analytics and fraud\-scoring models, and visual AI, face\-embedding and liveness models
* Develop and maintain a reusable adversarial ML attack library and test harness for repeatable pre\-production evaluation
* Produce adversarial\-robustness reports for each pod service with quantitative measures, reproducible attack notebooks, and prioritised mitigation guidance



**LLM, RAG \& Agentic AI Red Teaming** 



* Lead structured red\-team exercises against LLM, RAG and agentic AI deployments across the programme.
* Cover prompt injection, jailbreaks, indirect prompt injection via retrieved documents, data exfiltration, unsafe tool invocation, sandbox escape and policy\-boundary violations by agents
* Develop and maintain red\-team playbooks tailored to government AI use cases; publish anonymised playbooks and evaluation sets to AIKosh under standard metadata
* Advise pods on guardrail selection, output filtering, RAG source\-integrity controls, retrieval provenance, and agent policy design



**Hallucination, Calibration \& Responsible AI Evaluation** 



* Design and run hallucination measurement, groundedness checks, and calibration/uncertainty evaluation for RAG systems and generative outputs across teams
* Run bias and fairness audits using quantitative metrics — demographic parity, equalised odds, calibration, subgroup accuracy.
* Conduct explainability evaluation (SHAP, LIME, Captum) and lightweight privacy impact assessments on team deliverables
* Author the technical safety evaluation content in model cards, dataset sheets, bias/hallucination/safety evaluation reports, and Responsible AI evidence per the MeitY Responsible AI advisory and the IndiaAI Safe \& Trusted AI framework.
* **AI Security Architecture \& Threat Modelling**
* Own AI\-specific threat modelling end\-to\-end for all pod systems under development — STRIDE, MITRE ATT\&CK, MITRE ATLAS and OWASP Top 10 for LLMs — including data pipelines, retrieval sources, model artefacts, prompt paths, tool interfaces and output surfaces
* Review deployment configurations across IndiaAI Compute, on\-premise/sovereign GPU and CSP\-API paths for AI\-specific security risks; recommend controls and defensive patterns
* Contribute AI security and Responsible AI requirements to NeGD RFQs, RDRs and procurement documents; review empanelled\-agency proposals for AI security posture



**Cross\-Programme Advisory, Upskilling \& Governance Input** 



* Advise each team’s AI QA Engineer on safety and Responsible AI test design, sample selection, evaluation metrics and evidence capture
* Brief and upskill teams on AI\-specific security concerns and Responsible AI controls.



**Research, Publication \& Knowledge Transfer** 



* Track adversarial ML, LLM safety, agentic\-AI safety and Responsible AI research literature; translate relevant findings into team\-usable checks, controls and evaluation additions
* Maintain the programme’s open\-source AI safety testing toolkit; deposit reusable notebooks, evaluation harnesses and playbooks to OpenForge, and publish reusable evaluation sets and safety artefacts to AIKosh under standard metadata for reuse



**Technical Competencies** 



* **Programming \& ML Frameworks:** 
 Python (advanced); PyTorch or TensorFlow; Hugging Face Transformers; standard data\-science tooling (NumPy, pandas, scikit\-learn)
* **Adversarial ML:** 
 Adversarial Robustness Toolbox (ART), Foolbox, CleverHans or equivalent; ability to implement custom attacks and defences; knowledge of certified\-robustness techniques
* **LLM \& Agentic AI Red Teaming:** 
 Demonstrable production\-relevant experience with prompt injection, jailbreak, indirect\-prompt\-injection, data\-exfiltration, tool\-misuse, sandbox\-escape and multi\-turn manipulation; familiarity with LLM guardrail frameworks (NeMo Guardrails, Guardrails AI, Llama Guard) and open red\-team datasets
* **Hallucination, Calibration \& RAG Evaluation:** 
 RAGAS or equivalent; groundedness metrics, faithfulness scoring, retrieval quality metrics, calibration and uncertainty quantification; ability to build custom evaluation harnesses for RAG and generative pipelines
* **Threat Modelling \& AI Security Frameworks:** 
 STRIDE, MITRE ATT\&CK, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, OWASP ML Top 10; ability to translate threat models into control specifications and test cases
* **Explainability \& Fairness:** 
 SHAP, LIME, Captum for model explainability; Fairlearn and AI Fairness 360 for fairness metrics; ability to design subgroup\-fairness protocols for identity verification, fraud and predictive models
* **Privacy\-Enhancing Techniques:** 
 Working awareness of differential privacy, federated learning, PII redaction and anonymisation techniques; ability to run privacy impact assessments on model and data pipelines
* **Government Frameworks \& Standards:** 
 IndiaAI Safe \& Trusted AI framework, MeitY Responsible AI advisory, MeitY Security Policy and Guidelines, CERT\-In directions, DPDPA 2023
* **Communication \& Advisory:** 
 Ability to author clear technical safety reports for a mixed engineering, architecture and executive audience; ability to brief and upskill non\-AI\-security engineers and compliance colleagues; ability to represent the programme in cross\-ministerial working groups



**Minimum Evidence at Screening (one required)** 



* Peer\-reviewed or workshop\-published research on adversarial ML, AI security, LLM safety or Responsible AI
* Documented red\-team exercise with verifiable outcomes against a production or production\-like AI system
* Open\-source contribution to an adversarial ML, AI safety, LLM evaluation, or guardrail project with verifiable commit history
* Prior AI red\-teaming, safety, or Responsible AI assessment engagement for a government, BFSI, healthcare or regulated\-sector client, verifiable via reference or letter of confirmation

You will meet with clients every day: on the phone, in a videoconference, from the stage at a Gartner event, or face\-to\-face during a sales support visit. In every interaction, you will help clients overcome their challenges and perform better.
   

  

 As part of Gartner’s Emerging Market Dynamics Group, you will equip leaders in the semiconductor memory industry with indispensable insights, advice, and tools to achieve their mission\-critical priorities and build the successful organizations of tomorrow. You will own the authoritative quantitative view of the global DRAM, HBM and NAND Flash markets and convert supply, demand, pricing and technology signals into decision\-useful market intelligence.
   

  

**What You’ll do:**
* Develop and maintain global DRAM, HBM and NAND supply\-demand forecasts, including bit growth, wafer capacity, utilization, yields, inventories and pricing.
* Track supplier capacity, capex, technology transitions and competitive positioning across Samsung, SK hynix, Micron, Kioxia, SanDisk and emerging suppliers.
* Forecast market size, revenue, units/bits, ASPs and supplier market share by major memory segment.
* Quantify demand across AI/data center, enterprise storage, PCs, smartphones, automotive and other major applications.
* Track DRAM technology transitions including DDR5, LPDDR and HBM generations, capacity allocation and HBM production economics.
* Track NAND transitions including layer scaling, TLC/QLC mix, enterprise SSD adoption, client SSD and embedded/mobile applications.
* Analyze memory cycles, inventory corrections, pricing inflections and structural supply\-demand changes.
* Maintain quarterly market trackers, forecast models, source databases and scenario analysis.
* Provide evidence\-based written responses and support VP/market\-intelligence\-level client conversations.
* Partner with analysts covering AI accelerators, foundry, advanced packaging and storage to quantify cross\-market dependencies.
* Identify early indicators that could invalidate the current forecast and proactively revise assumptions and outlooks.
* Actively participate in appropriate Gartner global research communities for formal and in\-formal knowledge sharing sessions.


**Core Quantitative Coverage :**
 You are capable of modeling and forecasting:
   

  

* DRAM / HBM: wafer capacity and utilization, bit output and bit growth, die density and technology\-node transitions, HBM stacks, capacity and GB/device, DDR/LPDDR/HBM mix, supplier market share, contract and spot pricing, revenue and ASP, and AI\-server and accelerator\-driven memory demand.
* NAND Flash: wafer capacity and utilization, bits/wafer and layer transitions, TLC/QLC mix, bit supply and demand, supplier market share, pricing and revenue, enterprise/client SSD units and capacity, mobile/embedded NAND, and AI\-storage demand including RAG, KV\-cache and checkpointing use cases.
* Research Boundaries: This role owns the semiconductor memory\-market quantitative truth layer. It does not own broad AI accelerator strategy, semiconductor foundry strategy, advanced packaging market strategy, server/storage\-system architecture, or the general semiconductor equipment coverage. However, the analyst must quantify how developments in these adjacent markets affect memory demand, supply and economics.


**Job Requirements :**
**What You Will Need**
* Educational Qualification:
* BE/BTech from Grade A engineering colleges with specialization in Electronics, or Semiconductors, or software engineering.
* Graduate \+ MBA (Marketing or Ops) from leading A \& B\-schools is desirable.
* Work experience:
* 7\-10\+ years minimum experience in semiconductor memory, market intelligence, product planning, business planning, forecasting or industry research.
* Domain knowledge/Business Acumen:
* Deep expertise in DRAM and/or NAND Flash, with the ability to develop credible coverage across both.
* Strong understanding of memory manufacturing economics, technology migration, supplier capacity and pricing cycles.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain quantitative market models and forecasts.
* Experience with memory suppliers, semiconductor market\-research firms, OEMs/hyperscalers or relevant supply\-chain organizations preferred.
* Awareness of the major issues across the IT, technology, semiconductor and electronics industry affecting software technologies and competitive landscape, and an eagerness to learn more.
* MS Office Tools:
* Ability to design, develop and maintain large Excel models for market share analysis and forecasting, and strong working knowledge of other MS Office tools such as Word and Power Point for writing and presenting analysis.
* Project management skills:
* Ability to manage time, keep projects on schedule and resolve issues and deliver all client deliverables in a timely manner.
* Communication skills:
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex market data into clear implications.
* Written: A strong writing ability is mandatory. Writing efforts will require stating/staking positions, justifying those positions with facts and providing actionable analysis and recommendations.
* Oral: Skills to converse on telephone, face to face, and on\-stage, with the ability to explain complex concepts concisely.
* Problem Solving:
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to think creatively, independently, and efficiently to diagnose and contextualize issues, exhibit critical\-thinking and problem\-solving capabilities, including working on estimation problems and provide insightful and original analysis.
* Interpersonal skills:
* Ability to communicate, engage, and develop cordial professional relationships with analysts, key initiative leaders, team managers, and clients with a compelling and enthusiastic attitude that drives clients to action and guides them to success.
* Strong client presence and ability to relate to a variety of company and personality types is a must \- ability to represent Gartner research, methodology and strategies at multiple levels (Board, C\-Level, Business Unit and Operational) and multiple client organization types (End User Client, Investors, Technology and Service Providers, Resellers, Channel Partners).
* Ability to organize effectively, drive for results, collaborate productively, coach and develop colleagues where required – provide constructive feedback to peers as well as be receptive to feedback from peers.
* Complete ownership mindset, professional maturity and intellectual curiosity, ability to embrace change and act with integrity, and follow internal processes and policies, including, HR, IT and Finance.


**Who you are :**
 To thrive in this role, it helps if you are obsessed with your topic! Gartner analysts are correctly viewed as
 **THE** 
 experts. This means that:
   

  

* You know your technologies, markets, vendors, trends, management practices, etc., well and be able to see the forest and the trees.
* You are an excellent collaborator with the ability to quickly build rapport and gain client trust.
* You are a confident presenter with a high level of executive presence (prior experience with speaking engagements is a plus).
* You are an analytical thinker with the ability to process information quickly and make actionable recommendations.
* You are willing to challenge conventional norms and views.


**Who are we?**
 At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
   

  

 Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission\-critical priorities.
   

  

 Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in \~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
   

  

**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
 Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
   

  

 We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
   

  

 Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
   

  

 We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
   

  

**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
 At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
   

  

 It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
   

  

**What do we offer?**
 Gartner offers world\-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
   

  

 In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
   

  

 Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

 Are you passionate about turning data into actionable insights that transform planning performance and business outcomes?
   

  

 Be part of a
 **collaborative, innovative, and solution\-oriented** 
 team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.
   

  

 Where You'll Make a Difference
   

  

* Develop and enhance forecasting, predictive analytics, and decision\-support solutions that improve planning performance and business outcomes.
* Analyze demand patterns, seasonality, market trends, and key business drivers to generate actionable insights.
* Drive forecast accuracy improvements by identifying sources of bias and recommending process enhancements.
* Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, key performance indicators, and analytical tools that support data\-driven decision making.
* Partner with Demand Planning, Commercial, Supply Planning, Information Technology, and external stakeholders to translate business challenges into analytical solutions.
* Prepare, validate, and analyze large, complex datasets to support forecasting, scenario planning, and performance management activities.
* Develop, test, deploy, and maintain statistical and machine learning models that address business needs and improve planning capabilities.
* Support end\-to\-end project delivery, including discovery, design, development, testing, deployment, adoption, and knowledge transfer.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, analytical methodologies, and automation opportunities that can drive continuous improvement and long\-term business value.


 What Makes You the Right Fit
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Experience in Data Science, Advanced Analytics, Forecasting, Demand Planning, Supply Chain Analytics, or a related discipline.
* Proven experience delivering analytical solutions that generate measurable business value.
* Strong understanding of statistical analysis, forecasting methodologies, and predictive modeling techniques.
* Experience developing and implementing machine learning models in a business environment.
* Proficiency in Python and/or R for data analysis, modeling, and automation.
* Strong knowledge of Structured Query Language (SQL), data management, and data preparation practices.
* Experience using data visualization and reporting tools to communicate insights effectively.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to explain complex concepts to technical and non\-technical audiences.


 How Would You Stand Out?
   

  

* Experience supporting Sales and Operations Planning (S\&OP) or Integrated Business Planning processes.
* Knowledge of demand forecasting platforms, supply chain planning systems, or advanced analytics technologies.
* Demonstrated continuous improvement mindset with a passion for innovation, automation, and capability building.


 Why Choose Us?
   

  

* Opportunity to work on high\-impact global initiatives that shape planning and decision\-making capabilities.
* Exposure to cross\-functional teams and senior business stakeholders across multiple regions.
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment that values innovation and diverse perspectives.
* Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
* Access to advanced technologies, analytical tools, and digital transformation initiatives.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**Role:** 
 Senior Data Scientist
 



**Function:** 
 Data Science / Machine Learning
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Media Production, Broadcast Media, Online Media
 



  





**About Company** 




 One of India's largest private FM radio networks, reaching 40 million\+ listeners weekly. The company broadcasts across 49 cities, 1,000\+ towns, and 50,000 villages.
 



 It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu \& Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform extends the brand into curated lifestyle, music, and news content.
 



 The company operates at the intersection of legacy broadcast media and digital innovation, with a team of 740\.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 The company is building a next\-generation media super\-app that unifies video, audio, radio, micro\-drama, news, and commerce on a single digital platform. This is a senior individual contributor role responsible for driving the data science behind content discovery, personalization, ranking, and audience intelligence at scale. The right candidate takes full ownership of ML systems — from problem framing and experimentation through to production deployment and ongoing model performance.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Own the full ML lifecycle for recommendation, personalization, content ranking, and search — from problem definition and feature design through model training, evaluation, and production deployment.
* Develop and iterate on models using behavioural, engagement, and content metadata signals across video, audio, and commerce surfaces.
* Design and build feature pipelines and reusable feature sets for ML training and inference, collaborating with data engineering on upstream data quality and availability.
* Run structured experiments (A/B tests, interleaving) to measure model impact on engagement, retention, and discovery metrics; translate results into product decisions.
* Enable continuous model improvement by designing feedback loops that capture live user interactions for retraining and evaluation.
* Explore and apply AI techniques across use cases including semantic search, content classification, audience profiling, content moderation, and generative AI\-powered media experiences.
* Partner with product and engineering teams to translate business problems into well\-scoped ML solutions and communicate findings to non\-technical stakeholders.



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 7–12 years of hands\-on data science or applied ML experience, with a track record of shipping models into production on consumer\-scale platforms.
* Demonstrated end\-to\-end ownership of ML pipelines — from data preparation and feature engineering through model training, evaluation, and production deployment.
* Strong proficiency in Python for model development, experimentation, and data analysis.
* Deep experience building and evaluating models for recommendation, personalization, ranking, or search systems.
* Hands\-on experience with ML experimentation frameworks and A/B testing at scale.
* Experience working with large\-scale behavioural and event\-streaming datasets to derive features and training signals.
* Demonstrated ability to deploy ML models into production on AWS, GCP, or Azure, including monitoring model performance post\-launch.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Background in media, OTT, video, audio, music, social media, gaming, or news platforms.
* Exposure to Generative AI, LLMs, vector databases, or embedding\-based retrieval systems.
* Familiarity with feature stores and MLOps tooling for managing model and feature lifecycle.
* Experience with NLP, speech, or audio/video understanding models.



  





**What We Offer** 



* End\-to\-end IC ownership of ML models serving tens of millions of users across a greenfield media super\-app.
* Opportunity to work at the convergence of broadcast media and digital innovation, with direct influence on product direction.
* Collaborative environment with engineering, product, and analytics teams tackling high\-impact personalization and content intelligence problems.

title: Quantitative Researcher - Experienced Hires (India)
description:
Trexquant is a systematic hedge fund where we use thousands of statistical algorithms to trade equity, futures and other markets globally. Starting with many data sets, we develop large sets of features and use various machine learning methods to discover trading signals and effectively combine them into market\-neutral portfolios. We are looking for data scientists, physicists, engineers, economists and programmers to develop the next generation of machine learning strategies that can accurately predict the future movements of liquid financial assets. 
   





 As a Quantitative Researcher you will be involved in developing market\-neutral signals, parsing and analyzing large data sets and collaborating with the Data and Strategy Research team to build a diverse set of predictive models. While we are open to researchers in any asset class we are currently focusing on roles in equities, futures, commodities, and event driven research. 
   




****Responsibilities****
* Design, implement, and optimize various machine learning models aimed at predicting liquid assets using a wide set of financial data and a vast library of trading signals
* Parse and analyze large datasets to identify actionable alpha signals and develop strategies for systematic trading
* Investigate and implement state\-of\-the\-art academic research in the field of quantitative finance
* Continuously innovate and improve existing models by integrating new data sources and advanced techniques to boost performance and scalability
* Collaborate closely with a team of experienced quantitative researchers to conduct experiments, backtest hypotheses, and refine strategies through rigorous simulations and data analysis


**Requirements**
* BS/MS/PhD degree in any stem field
* 2\+ years in a systematic trading environment
* Passion for machine learning
* Fluent with programming languages like Python
* Strong problem\-solving skills
* Ability to work effectively both as an individual and a team player


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary plus bonus based on individual and company performance
* Collaborative, Casual, and friendly work environment
* Health insurance premiums fully covered for you and your dependents
* Pre\-tax commuter benefits
* Weekly company meals



 Trexquant is an Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Quantitative Trader
description:
**Company Description** 
 HFT Talent is a premier global staffing firm specializing in recruitment for high\-frequency trading (HFT), mid\-frequency trading (MFT), and hedge funds. The company leverages deep expertise across all critical roles within these fast\-paced and data\-driven environments, connecting top professionals with leading trading firms and funds worldwide. With a strong understanding of the unique demands of quantitative and algorithmic trading, HFT Talent tailors its recruitment strategies to match the speed, precision, and rigor of these markets. Its extensive global network and in\-depth industry knowledge enable HFT Talent to deliver strong career opportunities for roles such as quantitative researchers, algorithmic traders, quantitative developers, data scientists, and risk professionals.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Quantitative Trader role at HFT Talent is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Gurugram. In this role, the professional will design, implement, and manage quantitative trading strategies across various asset classes, focusing on market microstructure, execution quality, and risk\-adjusted returns. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include analyzing large datasets, developing models for price prediction and risk management, backtesting trading ideas, and optimizing strategies for latency, cost, and robustness. The Quantitative Trader will collaborate with researchers, developers, and risk teams to refine algorithms, monitor trading performance, and respond to changing market conditions in real time. The position involves continuous iteration, performance evaluation, and adherence to risk, compliance, and operational guidelines.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess skills in Trading and Market Making, with experience executing and managing systematic or algorithmic strategies in live markets.
* Candidates should possess skills in Trading Strategies and Quantitative Investing, including strategy design, backtesting, portfolio construction, and performance evaluation.
* Candidates should possess skills in Quantitative Analytics, such as statistical modeling, time\-series analysis, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Strong proficiency in programming languages commonly used in quantitative finance (e.g., Python, C\+\+, R, or similar) and comfort working with large datasets.
* Solid understanding of financial markets, instruments, market microstructure, and electronic trading platforms.
* Advanced degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, or Quantitative Finance, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in high\-frequency or systematic trading environments, with a strong focus on risk management and compliance, is highly beneficial.
* Ability to work in a collaborative, high\-pressure environment, with strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and clear communication skills.

title: Sr. Associate
description:
**Job Description**
 The Asia Group is now accepting applications for a Sr. Associate, Technology Policy to join our South Asia practice in New Delhi. This position will support the South Asia practice based across New Delhi, Mumbai, and Washington D.C. on The Asia Group’s portfolio of engagements for the AI Impact Summit scheduled in February in New Delhi. 
   

  

 Headquartered in Washington, D.C., The Asia Group (“TAG”) is a strategic and capital advisory firm that positions clients – ranging from Fortune 100 multinationals to innovative startups – for success in established and emerging markets across the Indo\-Pacific region. Our diverse team possesses decades of government and private sector experience with a work ethos that emphasizes teamwork, collegiality, creativity, entrepreneurialism, and mentorship. 
   

  

 Sr. Associate will work closely with the technology team and play key roles in supporting the firm’s research, analysis, and engagement with stakeholders. The ideal candidate will have substantive experience and expertise in the Indian technology and AI policy landscape. In addition, a successful candidate will have a strong command of the political, regulatory, and macroeconomic environments in India, demonstrating the ability to distill these trends into actionable insights. Excellent writing skills, the ability to communicate professionally with external stakeholders, and a genuine desire to learn are pre\-requisites.  
   

  

 All interested candidates must submit a cover letter, resume, and references via the application portal on our website. Due to the volume of applications received, responses from our recruiting team may be delayed. No phone calls or emails and whatsApp messages, please. 
   

  

**Job responsibilities**
* Support the South Asia team in servicing global clients through execution of high\-value added deliverables with a focus on emerging technologies, including AI, fintech, gaming, electronics, digital public infrastructure, and digital platforms
* Conduct meticulous industry and political research and analysis, and business due diligence
* Lead the drafting of high\-quality executive memos, reports, briefing materials, and other written products for external (client) and internal (TAG) consumers, often under short deadlines
* Actively participate in regular client engagements, including briefing sessions and workshops, alongside senior staff
* Track market, policy, and industry developments impacting client equities, particularly in the AI and broader tech policy landscape
* Represent the firm at relevant industry/policy events and forums by actively projecting the firm's expertise, relationships, and market leadership.
* Provide logistical and event support for client engagements in New Delhi
* Support stakeholder engagement and facilitate the management of executive visits
* Conduct policy research, develop advocacy strategies, create knowledge products, while supporting the senior team in managing diverse client engagements
* Build and nurture networks with policy stakeholders, key opinion leaders, civil society and media experts.
* Develop research and thought leadership products for TAG AI, showcasing insights and expertise on emerging trends and policy issues


**Job requirements**
* Master’s degree or equivalent academic/practice experience related to India/South Asia economic, industry, and policy issues
* 3\-6 years of prior work experience, preferably including in a client\-servicing industry or government experience
* Strong understanding of and interest in emerging technologies, including AI, fintech, and digital policy strategies
* Outstanding research, analytical, and writing skills
* Strong grasp of business strategy fundamentals, particularly in emerging markets
* Strong attention to detail and excels under tight deadlines
* Proficiency in Microsoft applications – demonstrated fluency in Microsoft Excel and other statistical languages
* Sector\-specific expertise in AI, tech and/or fintech in India
* Experience in data visualization and design a plus
* Genuine desire to learn, including through feedback from senior team members and peers
* Team player with eagerness for professional development
* Demonstrated familiarity with Indian market dynamics and/or private sector experience, including industry, consulting, or other sectors


  
   

 We value professionals who are proactive in exploring new ways to work smarter. Ideal candidates will be comfortable using artificial intelligence tools — or excited to learn how — to increase efficiency, enhance analysis or deliverables, and generate innovative solutions. Familiarity with generative AI platforms or a growth mindset toward emerging technologies is a plus.   
   

  

 Candidates must be eligible to work in India and are expected to work in\-person at the TAG New Delhi office five days per week. 
   

  

**Job Benefits**
 TAG provides competitive benefits with regular training opportunities available to its employees.

 This position is for a Senior Associate to be part of a fast\-growing Strategy\& practice within our Advisory Acceleration Centre.

* Strong knowledge in the principles and techniques of statistical analysis, interpretation, and clinical relevance.
* Knowledge of statistical analysis software SAS and R.

title: Senior Associate, Data loss protection analyst
description:

title: Global Brand Protection Analyst
description:
\[Please note this is a Direct Search led by Bacardi, Applications from agencies will not be accepted nor will fees be paid for unsolicited CVs.]
   

  

 The Global Brand Protection Analyst is responsible for tracing individual bottle lot codes across the global supply chain to identify the first commercial customer to whom the product was sold, determine the most probable root cause of deviations from the intended route\-to\-market strategy, and provide evidence\-based findings to the Global Director, Price to Trade \& Terms (P2TT), who will determine what corrective actions, if any, are necessary to reduce the risk of future occurrences.
   

  

 This role plays a critical part in enabling markets to independently execute their commercial strategies by identifying the source of unintended product flows that may undermine local pricing, route\-to\-market execution and brand equity. Through robust traceability, data analysis and reporting, the role provides the insights required to support effective governance and continuous improvement of the Global Brand Protection programme, helping protect Bacardi's commercial strategy, pricing integrity, margins and brand value.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Maintain and continuously enhance the Global Brand Protection Platform to improve data quality, governance, traceability efficiency and reporting capabilities.
* Ensure all markets consistently report incidents through the Global Brand Protection Platform in accordance with agreed governance standards.
* Reconstruct end\-to\-end product movements from manufacturing sites through warehouses, logistics networks and commercial transactions to identify the first commercial customer to whom the product was sold. This requires analysing material documents, Handling Units (HU), outbound deliveries, shipment records and customer transactions using SAP (MB51, HUMAT, VL03N), SAP BI and internal traceability platforms (e.g. Click/Reply).
* Identify the most probable root cause of each incident by correlating commercial pricing, customer allocation, logistics execution and route\-to\-market data. This includes reviewing Direct Market NSV, Distributor Resale Prices, Minimum Floors, customs status (under\-bond vs. duty paid) and commercial conditions to determine where products deviated from the intended customer strategy.
* Produce clear, evidence\-based investigation summaries highlighting traceability findings, probable root causes and supporting data for review by the Global Director, Price to Trade \& Terms.
* Support the preparation of regional and global dashboards by consolidating investigation outcomes, traceability KPIs, first customer identification rates, root cause trends, corrective actions and recurring commercial leakage patterns.
* Support the Global Director, Price to Trade \& Terms in identifying recurring risks, emerging trends and opportunities to strengthen the Global Brand Protection programme.
* Maintain and analyse Grants International Trader Price Lists (customer, product, volume, customs status, pricing and product characteristics) to identify recurring trading patterns, support investigations and improve first customer identification.


**Skills Required**
* SAP and traceability systems capability Strong working knowledge of SAP transactions including MB51, HUMAT, VL03N, SAP BI and internal traceability platforms such as Click/Reply.
* Analytical problem solving Ability to interpret data from multiple operational and commercial systems, identify trends, establish root causes and translate findings into actionable business insights.
* Commercial acumen Understanding of trade pricing, distributor resale pricing, Minimum Floors, NSV, customs status (under\-bond vs. duty paid) and route\-to\-market models.
* Supply chain traceability Understanding of manufacturing, warehousing, logistics and commercial fulfilment processes to accurately reconstruct product movements across the supply chain.
* Data accuracy and attention to detail Ability to validate information across multiple systems, reconcile inconsistencies and ensure investigations are supported by robust evidence.
* Governance and process discipline Ensuring incidents are reported consistently and investigation methodologies are applied in a standardised manner across markets.
* Dashboarding and KPI reporting Ability to prepare concise dashboards covering investigation outcomes, traceability performance, corrective actions and recurring trends.
* Stakeholder management Ability to work effectively with Supply Chain, Commercial, Market teams, Distributors and the Global Director, Price to Trade \& Terms.
* Clear written communication Ability to communicate investigation findings clearly, concisely and objectively to support informed decision\-making.
* Continuous improvement mindset Proactively identifying opportunities to improve traceability processes, investigation efficiency, reporting quality and platform performance.


 LEADERSHIP AGILITY
   

  

 At Bacardi we care deeply about finding brilliant talent who can bring the following personal attributes to help elevate our 3Fs: Fearless, Family, Founder culture to the next level.
   

  

* Belonging: You have a strong capacity to create a culture of ‘Belonging’, where people feel appreciated for who they are, what they do, and who they can become
* Self\-Awareness: You have high levels of self\-awareness, are reflective and know yourself well, understanding both your own strengths and weaknesses and your impact on others
* People Agility: You bring a deep ability to understand and relate to people and navigate through tough situations to harness and multiply collective performance
* Results Agility: You demonstrate consistent delivery of results in first\-time situations by inspiring teams, exhibiting a presence that builds confidence in yourself and others.
* Mental Agility: You can think critically to penetrate complex problems and expand the possibilities by making fresh connections. You think strategically whilst being execution focused and bring creativity to the challenges you’re presented with
* Change Agility: You have a deep natural curiosity, desire to experiment and ability to effectively deal with the heat of change. You have a growth and learning mindset: ready to test, stumble, learn and apply from experience


*Disclaimer: Bacardi seeks talent from all backgrounds to bring diversity of thought, agility and capability to our organization across the globe. We promote a working environment where all employees are treated and rewarded fairly. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination that adversely affects individuals or groups on the basis of national origin, race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, age, and any other legally protected aspect of a person’s identity.*
 U.S. applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws.
   

  

**Perks of Working for us**
 At Bacardi, we are committed to providing our Primos (employees) with a comprehensive Total Rewards package of compensation, benefits, incentives, allowances, well\-being, and much more to meet the needs of themselves and their families. It goes beyond just Cash! The total rewards program is based on pay for performance, whereby the incentive programs are linked to company and individual performance.
   

  

**Compensation, Paid Time Off \& Retirement:**
* Competitive Pay Package
* Competitive Holiday/Paid Time Off, plus additional days offered ( i.e., volunteer day, allowing you to give back to the community)
* Retirement/Pension Plan


 Health \& Wellbeing
   

  

* Medical, Critical Illness, and Life Insurance
* Employee Assistance Programs
* Best\-in\-class, family\-friendly, and inclusive leave policies


**Additional Benefits**
 The benefits /perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Bacardi, your work location, and are subject to change.
   

  

 Some benefits may be subject to an employee contribution.
   

  

 Some benefits may be fully or partially subsidized. Incentive plans are linked to the nature of your employment and can vary based on region, market, function or brand.

title: AI Automation Specialist
description:
CPA\-DMV.com is seeking an experienced AI \& Automation Specialist to design, develop, and implement intelligent automation solutions for business and IT support operations.
 



 The primary focus of this role will be to combine Artificial Intelligence, Robotic Process Automation
 



 (RPA), ticketing automation, and AI voice technology to automate Level 1 help desk functions and other repetitive business processes. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience building AI\-powered workflows, integrating systems through APIs, automating support tickets, developing conversational or voice AI agents, and creating reliable escalation processes when human assistance is required. This is a hands\-on implementation role for someone who can convert business requirements into working automation solutions.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 AI\-Powered Help Desk Automation
 



 ● Design and implement an intelligent help desk and ticket automation system.
 



 ● Automatically receive, categorize, prioritize, and route incoming support requests.
 



 ● Use AI to understand the user's issue and determine the appropriate response or action.
 



 ● Automate common Level 1 support requests and repetitive help desk activities.
 



 ● Create automatic responses for common support questions.
 



 ● Integrate AI with internal knowledge bases and support documentation.
 



 ● Automatically create, update, assign, and close tickets where appropriate.
 



 ● Develop escalation rules for issues requiring Level 2 support or human intervention.
 



 ● Ensure complete ticket history and documentation are maintained.
 



 AI Voice Agent Development
 



 ● Design and configure an AI\-powered voice agent for Level 1 help desk support.
 



 ● Enable the voice agent to answer incoming calls and interact naturally with users.
 



 ● Configure the voice agent to understand common technical and support questions.
 



 ● Provide automated responses and troubleshooting guidance for approved Level 1 issues.
 



 ● Create support tickets automatically based on voice conversations.
 



 ● Capture caller information, issue details, and conversation summaries.
 



 ● Integrate the AI voice agent with ticketing, CRM, communication, and internal systems.
 



 ● Configure intelligent call routing and escalation.
 



 ● Transfer complex, sensitive, or unresolved issues to human support staff.
 



 ● Ensure the human support representative receives the conversation summary and relevant
 



 information during escalation.
 



 Robotic Process Automation
 



 ● Identify repetitive manual processes that can be automated.
 



 ● Design and implement RPA workflows to reduce manual work.
 



 ● Combine RPA with AI to automate decision\-based workflows.
 



 ● Automate data entry, document processing, system updates, notifications, and task creation.
 



 ● Integrate automation across multiple applications and platforms.
 



 ● Monitor automated processes and resolve exceptions or failures.
 



 ● Continuously improve workflows based on performance and user feedback.
 



 AI Agent \& Workflow Development
 



 ● Develop AI agents capable of completing defined business and support tasks.
 



 ● Design prompts, workflows, decision logic, and guardrails.
 



 ● Integrate Large Language Models with business applications.
 



 ● Build knowledge\-base\-driven AI solutions.
 



 ● Implement Retrieval\-Augmented Generation where appropriate.
 



 ● Configure AI systems to provide accurate responses based on approved company information.
 



 ● Test and monitor AI outputs to reduce incorrect or unsupported responses.
 



 ● Create appropriate confidence thresholds and escalation rules.
 



 System Integration
 



 The specialist will be responsible for integrating AI and automation solutions with systems such as:
 



 ● Help desk and ticketing platforms
 



 ● CRM systems
 



 ● Microsoft 365
 



 ● Email systems
 



 ● Internal databases
 



 ● Cloud storage
 



 ● Document management systems
 



 ● VoIP and telephone systems
 



 ● Accounting and business applications
 



 ● Internal knowledge bases
 



 The candidate should have strong experience working with APIs, webhooks, databases, and third party integrations. Human Escalation \& Exception Handling
 



 A major requirement of this role is ensuring AI automation knows when human involvement is necessary.
 



 Responsibilities include:
 



 ● Define clear escalation rules.
 



 ● Identify issues that cannot be resolved automatically.
 



 ● Escalate complex requests to appropriate human staff.
 



 ● Ensure smooth transfer from AI to human support.
 



 ● Provide the human representative with a summary of the issue and previous interaction.
 



 ● Maintain the ability for employees to review and override automated decisions.
 



 ● Prevent AI from making decisions outside approved areas.
 



 Security \& Confidentiality
 



 Because CPA\-DMV.com handles confidential client and financial information, the candidate must:
 



 ● Follow strict information security and confidentiality standards.
 



 ● Protect customer and company data.
 



 ● Implement appropriate user permissions and role\-based access.
 



 ● Secure APIs, system credentials, and integrations.
 



  





 ● Maintain audit logs for automated activities.
 



 ● Ensure sensitive information is only processed through approved systems.
 



 ● Follow company data retention and privacy requirements.
 



 Documentation \& Training
 



 ● Create documentation for all AI and automation systems.
 



 ● Document workflows, integrations, APIs, escalation processes, and configurations.
 



 ● Develop standard operating procedures.
 



 ● Prepare troubleshooting and support documentation.
 



 ● Train employees on newly implemented AI and automation solutions.
 



 ● Maintain an internal knowledge base for support processes.
 



 Required Qualifications
 



 ● Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science,
 



 Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 



 ● Hands\-on experience with Artificial Intelligence and automation technologies.
 



 ● Experience implementing Robotic Process Automation.
 



 ● Experience working with Large Language Models and generative AI.
 



 ● Experience with AI agents or conversational AI solutions.
 



 ● Experience integrating applications using APIs and webhooks.
 



 ● Understanding of databases and system integrations.
 



 ● Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
 



 ● Ability to understand business processes and convert them into automated workflows.
 



 ● Strong written and verbal communication skills.
 



 Preferred Technical Skills
 



 Experience with one or more of the following is preferred:
 



 ● OpenAI API / Azure OpenAI
 



 ● Microsoft Azure AI
 



 ● Python
 



 ● JavaScript / TypeScript
 



 ● Microsoft Power Automate
 



 ● UiPath
 



 ● Automation Anywhere
 



 ● n8n
 



 ● Make
 



 ● Zapier
 



 ● Microsoft Power Platform
 



 ● Twilio
 



 ● Voice AI platforms
 



 ● Speech\-to\-Text technologies
 



 ● Text\-to\-Speech technologies
 



 ● REST APIs
 



 ● Webhooks
 



 ● SQL
 



 ● CRM integrations
 



 ● Help desk systems
 



 ● Vector databases
 



 ● RAG / Knowledge Base solutions
 



 ● Microsoft 365 integrations
 



 ● AWS / Azure / Google Cloud
 



 The candidate is not expected to have experience with every technology listed above. Initial Projects
 



 The selected candidate will initially focus on three major projects:
 



 1\. AI Help Desk Ticket Automation
 



 Create an AI\-powered help desk solution that can:
 



 ● Receive support requests
 



 ● Understand user issues
 



 ● Categorize tickets
 



 ● Determine priority
 



 ● Provide automated Level 1 responses
 



 ● Assign tickets to the appropriate department
 



 ● Escalate unresolved issues
 



 ● Maintain ticket history and documentation
 



 2\. AI Voice Agent for Level 1 Support
 



 Develop a voice\-based AI agent capable of:
 



 ● Answering incoming support calls
 



 ● Identifying the caller's issue
 



 ● Providing approved troubleshooting assistance
 



 ● Answering common questions
 



 ● Creating support tickets
 



 ● Summarizing conversations
 



 ● Escalating complex requests
 



 ● Transferring users to human support when necessary
 



 3\. RPA \+ AI Business Process Automation
 



 Identify repetitive internal processes and implement automation solutions combining RPA and AI to improve speed, accuracy, and operational efficiency.
 



 Ideal Candidate
 



 The ideal candidate is a hands\-on AI automation professional who can understand a business problem
 



 and independently design, build, integrate, test, and maintain a working solution.
 



 We are particularly interested in candidates who have previously developed:
 



 ● AI help desk systems
 



 ● Ticket automation
 



 ● AI voice agents
 



 ● RPA workflows
 



 ● AI\-powered business automation
 



 ● CRM or customer support integrations
 



 ● AI agents connected to company knowledge bases
 



 What Success Looks Like
 



  





 Success in this position will include:
 



 ● Reduced manual Level 1 help desk workload
 



 ● Faster response times
 



 ● Improved ticket routing and prioritization
 



 ● Successful automation of repetitive processes
 



 ● Reliable AI\-to\-human escalation
 



 ● Accurate call and ticket documentation
 



 ● Secure handling of confidential information
 



 ● Measurable improvements in operational efficience

title: AVP - Journey Excellence and Optimisation

This role is responsible for supporting the design and delivery of end\-to\-end customer and colleague journey transformations across Barclays UK (BUK) Business Banking front \& back\-office operations and will contribute significantly to shaping Target Operating Models (TOMs) and eliminating process debt.

**Tooling \& Visualization**

* Maintain a centralised journey register and ensure traceability to customer outcomes and control requirements.


**Transformation Delivery \& Governance**

* Support the delivery of transformation initiatives, including business case development, benefit tracking, and stakeholder reporting.
* Ensure alignment with BUK’s transformation governance, including floorwalk showcases.


**To be successful as a "** 
**Senior Analyst \- Customer Journey Mapping" you should have experience with:**

* Tooling: Expert level proficiency in Figma (UI/UX design), Blueworks Live (process mapping) and MS Power point (presentation and storytelling)
* Translate complex operational challenges into simplified, scalable, and digitally enabled journeys.
* Drive high\-impact process optimization engagements that enhance efficiency, customer experience, and risk management.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate into actionable insights.
* Strong problem\-solving skills to identify pain points in the customer journey.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across global and cross\-functional teams.

- Prior experience of working in / with:

* agile transformation environments
* Customer Experience / product teams
* Familiarity with Design thinking concepts.

 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role will be based out of Noida/Gurugram.

They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.

title: Manager - BCG Vantage
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a Manager – BCG Vantage on our Topic Activation path within BCG's Principal Investors and Private Equity (PIPE) Practice Area you will work in a growing global team, providing industry/functional expertise and insights whilst working together with case and proposal teams to provide knowledge assets, analysis and expert advisory. The team uses a variety of number of AI and advanced data analytics tools; and you will be expected to develop expertise on those. You’ll serve as a thought partner and content expert to case teams and topic/sector leaders, helping structure and solve complex issues.
   

  

 You will support commercialization efforts for the topic/sector, in conjunction with business leaders, through contributing analysis and insights to proposals, client workshops and marketing materials. Additionally, as a Manager – BCG Vantage, you will help build, own and enhance AI\-enabled products, tools and knowledge assets – taking them from problem definition through build, deployment on live cases, and adoption. You will work closely with case teams and business leaders to drive real usage and impact, while helping onboard, train and enable junior colleagues on your topic/sector and on new products.
   

  

 BCG’s PIPE Practice Area works with the world’s largest investment firms, serving six client asset classes: Private Equity, Hedge Funds, Infrastructure \& Real Estate Funds, Family Offices, Sovereign Wealth Funds and Pension Plans. Likewise, PIPE topics cut across not only these asset classes, but also across industries (e.g., Health Care, Consumer, Technology, etc.) and sub\-topics (e.g., Tech Capital, Private Credit, Environmental, Social and Governance, etc.)
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 3\+ years consulting experience in PIPE required; candidates with consulting experience preferred
* In lieu of consulting experience, 4\+ years minimum industry experience required; 6\-10\+ years of industry experience strongly preferred
* Bachelor's Degree required (advanced degree preferred)
* Fluency in English;
* Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills to interact with internal and external stakeholder while working in a global collaborative team environment
* Practical fluency with GenAI and modern development tools (e.g. APIs, custom GPTs / AI Skills, coding assistants such as Claude Code or Cursor, GitHub, cloud platforms) strongly preferred; comfort learning new tools as the landscape evolves
* Demonstrated experience managing product roadmaps, backlog prioritization, and cross\-functional stakeholder alignment, with comfort in data\-driven decision making and familiarity with agile/scrum delivery frameworks


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 As a Manager – BCG Vantage on our Topic Activation path, you will collaborate with global topic leads and colleagues across BCG to bring expertise and capabilities to the service of our internal and external clients.
   

  

 Our team is made up of a diverse pool of BCG Vantage positions that allow us to pursue exciting, innovative BCG Vantage careers.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

**YOU'RE GOOD AT**
* Solving complex client problems through relevant analytical approaches and customized solutions in one or more relevant PIPE topic areas
* Communicating with senior stakeholders, demonstrating the ability to engage your audience effectively
* Demonstrating rapid learning agility across emerging technologies and analytical assets to enhance analysis, develop products, and create scalable, repeatable research and knowledge frameworks
* Managing a portfolio of projects, with strong awareness of business priorities and commercial impact
* Owning the end\-to\-end lifecycle of AI\-enabled products and analytics assets – from problem definition and roadmap through prototyping, build, deployment on live cases, adoption tracking, and ongoing enhancement
* Training, coaching, and mentoring junior team members
* Working in an ever changing and complex environment, and comfortable with ambiguity and navigating a fast\-paced environment


**Additional Information**
 BCG Vantage is a powerhouse of expertise, seamlessly embedded within Practice Areas and markets to drive extraordinary impact. It equips BCG case teams and clients with cutting\-edge expertise, proprietary assets, actionable data, and transformative insights that empower our case teams and enable our clients to achieve their aspirations.
   

  

 With global experts across 20 Practices, covering more than 100 topics, sectors and offers, plus four focused geographic markets, BCG Vantage delivers unparalleled depth and breadth of insight \& expertise. BCG Vantage consists of three career paths, each playing a crucial role in delivering value to clients, case teams and practice teams.
   

  

***Client Focus (Embedded Expertise)***
* Integrates into client\-facing teams to deliver direct client impact through expertise, know\-how, and proprietary tools and assets


***Topic Activation (Sector Expertise with Proprietary Tool \& Data Solutions)***
* Combines deep domain insights with our know\-how and proprietary assets to address targeted challenges directly with clients and project teams; co\-creates insights on industry trends and functional topics, proprietary data and tools, and teams to codify IP that all enables BCG to deliver excellent business value with its clients


***Research (Practice Topic and Sector\-Aligned Research and Insights)***
* Delivers actionable research and insights tailored to the client project’s needs; works with qualitative and quantitative data, conducts research and provides synthesized results from sources including commercial data, public and open source, company and industry research, macro\-economic, commodities and trade data.

 Lead Data \& AI Platform Engineer
 



**Function:** 
 Data Engineering / AI/ML Platform

 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Media Production, Broadcast Media, Online Media
 



  





**About Company** 




 The company is one of India's largest private FM radio networks. It reaches over 40 million listeners weekly across 49 cities, 1,000\+ towns, and 50,000 villages.
 



 It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu \& Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform extends the brand into curated lifestyle, music, and news content.
 



 The company operates at the intersection of legacy broadcast media and digital innovation, with a team of 740\.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 The company is building a next\-generation media super\-app that unifies video, audio, radio, micro\-drama, news, and commerce on a single digital platform. This role owns the scalable data and ML infrastructure powering content discovery, personalised recommendations, and user engagement at scale. The engineer in this role bridges production data systems and AI/ML teams, moving models from experimentation into reliable, high\-throughput production environments.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Design and build scalable data architecture for a high\-volume consumer media platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving layers for user activity, content consumption, and commerce data.
* Build and maintain batch and real\-time streaming pipelines processing millions of user events and large volumes of multimedia metadata using technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Architect data lakes, warehouses, and analytical datasets supporting product analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases; enforce data quality, lineage, observability, and governance across all pipelines.
* Develop feature engineering pipelines and reusable feature stores for recommendation, personalisation, ranking, search, and content intelligence systems.
* Build training and inference pipelines connecting production data with ML models; enable continuous feedback loops for model retraining from live user interactions.
* Deploy ML/AI models into production on AWS, GCP, or Azure; containerise and orchestrate model workloads using Docker and Kubernetes; build APIs/services for consumer\-facing AI integration.
* Monitor model and pipeline performance — latency, scalability, reliability — and partner with AI/ML teams to operationalise models from experimentation to production.



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 7–9 years of hands\-on software or data engineering experience, with a track record of building and operating large\-scale data platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala for data and ML pipeline development.
* Production experience with distributed data processing and streaming technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud\-based data infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure, including data lakes, warehouses, and distributed storage.
* Demonstrated experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments, including batch and real\-time inference pipelines.
* Proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes for containerising and orchestrating model and pipeline workloads.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, distributed systems, and data modelling for both analytical and ML use cases.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience building data infrastructure for recommendation, personalisation, search, or content ranking systems.
* Exposure to feature stores, MLOps platforms, and ML training/inference workload management.
* Prior experience on high\-scale B2C or consumer internet platforms handling behavioural and event\-streaming data.
* Background in media, OTT, video, audio, music, social media, gaming, or news platforms.
* Exposure to Generative AI, embeddings, vector databases, or LLM\-based applications.



  





**What We Offer** 



* End\-to\-end ownership of data and AI platform infrastructure for a consumer product reaching tens of millions of users.
* Opportunity to work at the convergence of broadcast media and digital innovation on a greenfield super\-app build.
* Collaborative environment with AI/ML, product, and engineering teams working on high\-impact personalisation and content intelligence problems.

title: Product Insight Analyst – Toys & Games.
description:
**About Us** 





 Smartivity is India's leading STEM toy brand, founded in 2015 by IIT Delhi engineers. We make screen\-free wooden DIY kits for kids aged 3–14\. We have 130\+ products, 10M\+ kits sold, and 163\+ patents filed. We design and manufacture everything in\-house in Manesar.
 




  





**The Role** 





 Trends come and go. Great toy brands are built on bets that last. You'll help Smartivity decide where to play over the next 3–5 years: which categories to enter, which product platforms to build, and which shifts in how children learn and play we should get ahead of. Along the way, you'll build \*Smartivity's product discovery playbook\*, a repeatable, data\-backed way of spotting, testing, and prioritising opportunities that the whole team can use long after any single trend fades.
 




  





**What You'll Do** 





 \-
 
**Build the playbook** 

 : Create Smartivity's documented system for product discovery: the data sources we trust, the criteria an idea must meet, how we size and score opportunities, and how we learn from every launch. You'll refine it each quarter as our bets play out.
 





 \-
 
**Track structural shifts** 

 : Study the forces reshaping kids' play and learning: screen\-time concerns, NEP 2020 and the push for hands\-on STEM, changing family income and gifting habits, sustainability, and the growth of new markets.
 





 \-
 
**Build category theses** 

 : Develop evidence\-backed views on the categories and age bands Smartivity should own, enter, or avoid over the long term, with sizing, growth outlook, and competitive dynamics.
 





 \-
 
**Think in platforms** 

 : Identify product systems that can grow into families of products over years, rather than one\-off SKUs, and that build on our patents and manufacturing strengths.
 





 \-
 
**Separate signal from noise** 

 : Use search, marketplace, and social data to test whether a trend is a fad or an early sign of lasting change.
 





 \-
 
**Listen at scale** 

 : Analyse reviews, complaints, and our part\-replacement and returns data to find unmet needs that persist over time.
 





 \-
 
**Watch the frontier** 

 : Monitor global toy launches, patent filings, and research on child development to see where play is heading.
 





 \-
 
**Shape the roadmap** 

 : Feed a long\-term opportunity map and quarterly category deep\-dives into the product team's planning.
 




  





**Tools You'll Use** 





 \-
 
**Market and category data** 

 : Circana (NPD), Euromonitor, Statista, industry and investor reports
 





 \-
 
**Demand and trend signals:** 

 Google Trends, Amazon Brand Analytics, Jungle Scout, Keepa, Exploding Topics
 





 \-
 
**Competitive and IP landscape** 

 : Google Patents, Similarweb, Meta Ad Library
 





 \-
 
**Analysis** 

 : SQL, Google Sheets, LLM tools (Claude, ChatGPT)
 





 \-
 
**Visualisation:** 

 Looker Studio or Power BI
 




  





**What We're Looking For** 





 \- A graduate in engineering, economics, business, or another quantitative field, with 0–3 years in analytics, research, consulting, or a startup.
 





 \- Strong Excel/Sheets skills. Python or SQL is a big plus.
 





 \- Structured, long\-horizon thinking: you can build a thesis, test it with data, and change your mind when the evidence does.
 





 \- Product taste and genuine curiosity about how kids learn and play.
 





 \- The ability to turn research into a crisp, confident recommendation.
 





 \- Experience with any of the tools above is a plus. How you think matters more than what you've used.
 




  






 Why Join
 





 You'll help decide what a patent\-driven, in\-house\-manufacturing brand becomes over the next five years, and build the playbook it uses to get there.
 




  






 Interested candidates can share their CVs at sakshi@smartivity.in

**Grow a Career. Build a Future!**
 Be part of this company at the forefront of agriculture and construction, that passionately innovates to drive customer efficiency and success. And we know innovation can’t happen without collaboration. So, everything we do at CNH Industrial is about reaching new heights as one team, always delivering for the good of our customers.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
* Lead the risk management function for financial services in the AANZ region. The portfolio approximates $2 billion covering retail (including portfolios with partners), wholesale, and trade finance. The position provides specific risk support across all major markets (including Australia, India, and China) and business segments. The position will report to the Global Risk team and work closely with the regional credit, commercial lending and finance teams as well as the respective Country Managers in assessing, monitoring and managing risk. The position is additionally responsible for managing and supporting resources with modelling and analytics capability.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Perform portfolio risk analysis and maintain key risk metrics covering credit quality, delinquencies, losses, reserves, and cost of risk.
* Manage loss forecasting, reserve analyses, and CECL/US GAAP support, including budgeting and forecasting activities.
* Conduct country, regional, and macroeconomic risk assessments to identify emerging risks and opportunities.
* Develop, implement, and monitor credit risk scorecards (origination, behavioral, collections) and automated decision strategies using advanced analytics and AI/ML techniques.
* Lead the development, validation, and performance monitoring of risk models and decision tools across underwriting, collections, and portfolio management.
* Support digital transformation initiatives through automation, AI\-driven solutions, and enhancements to credit processes and systems.
* Deliver data\-driven insights and ad hoc analyses to support strategic business initiatives and risk mitigation efforts.
* Benchmark risk performance, policies, and practices against industry peers and market standards.
* Develop and maintain risk policies, governance frameworks, controls, and best practices across regions.
* Support new business initiatives, growth strategies, and product development through risk assessment and analytics.
* Promote knowledge sharing and consistency of risk methodologies across global teams.


**Experience Required**
 7\+ years of experience in credit risk management, portfolio analytics, and predictive modeling.
   

  

**Preferred**
* Experience in capital goods, equipment finance, or captive finance industry, with an understanding of dealer networks, distribution channels, and end\-customer financing dynamics.
* Knowledge of agricultural and construction equipment markets.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to influence decision\-making and drive alignment across a global, matrixed organization.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Postgraduate degree in quantitative discipline such as Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or Computer Science.
* Strong expertise in Azure Databricks, SAS, Python, and cloud\-based analytics platforms.
* Proven track record of developing, implementing, and monitoring predictive models, scorecards, AI/ML solutions, and data\-driven decision frameworks.
* Ability to translate complex analytical findings into actionable business insights and strategic recommendations.


**What We Offer**
 We offer dynamic career opportunities across an international landscape. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to delivering value for all our employees and fostering a culture of respect.

 At CNH, we understand that the best solutions come from the diverse experiences and skills of our people. Here, you will be empowered to grow your career, to follow your passion, and help build a better future. To support our employees, we offer regional comprehensive benefits, including:
   

  

* Flexible work arrangements
* Savings \& Retirement benefits
* Tuition reimbursement
* Parental leave
* Adoption assistance
* Fertility \& Family building support
* Employee Assistance Programs
* Charitable contribution matching and Volunteer Time Off
