title: Manager, Dashboards & Reporting, Financial and Future Planning
description:
Responsible for management, analysis and reporting of conference production financial and future planning data, including expense templates, roll ups, growth projections, financial dashboard, calendar dashboard, and attendee heatmap dashboard. The successful candidate will also provide analysis and actionable reports to aid senior leadership decision making as well as future venue sourcing \& capacity planning.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities:**
* Build, manage, and continuously improve 600\+ complex and cross\-linked templates, including multiple critical global roll\-ups across excel and Power BI that are used for managing expenses across the entire conferences business
* Project manage budget timelines to ensure templates are replicated in line with key planning milestones tied to larger financial commitments, ensuring we are driving decisions to maximize conference contribution.
* Maintain and improve Conference Production Financial Dashboards, Global Conferences Calendar Dashboard, and Conferences Attendee Heatmap Dashboard in Power BI. Data aggregation and cleaning, power queries, data modelling, Power BI visualization design, programming in DAX, and mapping to Smartsheet.
* Construct Financial Projections models to include Scenario Analysis and Growth Curve Analysis. Investigate current best practices for predictive data modelling, using Python or other programming language.
* Design and build from start to finish complex analytic models and tools to support global team, utilizing advanced Excel and VBA modelling skills.
* Support global team, building conference planning tools from scratch, including problem solving the most effective solutions and training team as required, enabling production team to efficiently analyze large amounts of data \& make crucial event planning decisions.
* Partner with stakeholders and other team members to identify data analytics requirements. Identify and implement most effective and efficient solution.
* Proactively identify opportunities to automate processes. Use advanced VBA programming, MS Power Automate to automate manual Excel processes to realize significant time savings and reduction in errors.
* Demonstrate the ability to rapidly evaluate, learn and implement modern automation technologies (Power Automate, Python, AI\-enabled workflows in line with Gartner AI governance policies, Power Automate and SharePoint integration) to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and user experience.
* Ability to execute at the highest level in fast\-paced environment with multiple and competing, high\-impact priorities. Independently drive results from start to finish.
* Leverage quantitative background in business, finance, and technology.
* Establish and maintain data governance standards across budgeting, conference planning, and operational reporting systems. Implement controls, validation checks, and audit mechanisms to ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity of business\-critical data.
* Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, process maps, solution architectures, and knowledge\-transfer materials to ensure scalability, continuity, and adoption of analytical tools.
* Maintain and enhance SharePoint sites supporting conference operations, including site structure, permissions, data management, document libraries, workflows, and user support. Implement improvements that drive collaboration, information accessibility, process efficiency, and governance across the teams.


**What we’re looking for:**
* Experience: 4\+ years of progressive business experience, preferably in strategy, consulting, or business operations role.
* Qualifications: Being extremely process driven with strong project management skills are essential.
* Exceptional problem\-solving capability: You have a proven track record of solving complex problems, thinking creatively, and using data to tell a story and drive change.
* Technical skills: You are highly proficient in Microsoft Excel, VBA development / debugging, Power BI. You can create and interpret complex Excel reports to track past, present, and future conference data and determine how to represent this in Power BI. Exposure to SQL, Python and Power Automate is strongly preferred.
* Detail oriented: You have a critical eye for details and can effectively analyze and summarize data.
* Fast\-paced: You operate with a sense of “urgency” and can excel in an execution\-focused environment.
* Drive / Self\-sufficiency: You have a demonstrated ability to own a problem and aggressively drive from problem statement to solution in a self\-sufficient capacity, even in a matrixed environment.
* Communication skills: You are an excellent and structured verbal and written communicator with effective presentation and platform skills.
* Strong core values: You demonstrate integrity, collaboration, a no\-limits mindset, objectivity, and consistent results using global best practices.
* Education: Bachelor's degree required

title: Assistant Manager, Business Insights
description:
**Join a Team That’s Passionate About Making Lives Better!**
 At Bill Gosling Outsourcing, we believe that success starts with an amazing team. We are a global leader in outsourcing solutions, we focus on making lives better, one connection at a time. We provide tailored solutions to businesses around the globe, specializing in customer care, sales, and financial services. We’re looking for enthusiastic, driven individuals to join our dynamic work environment where
 *fun meets results* 
 !
   

  

 Bill Gosling Outsourcing Corp.The Assistant Manager – Business Insights will assist in leading and managing projects aimed at improving business processes and systems. This role involves working closely with different departments to analyze current processes, identify areas for improvement, and develop and implement solutions that enhance efficiency, quality, and customer satisfaction.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Opportunity identification on the ground: Continuously scan the operations to surface improvement avenues, inefficiencies, and performance gaps, and maintain a prioritized pipeline of opportunities backed by data and operational evidence.
* Problem framing: Partner with the account team and functional owners to convert vague asks and observed pain points into sharp, scoped problem statements with clear business impact and decision needs.
* Diagnostics \& root\-cause analysis: Run structured deep dives using data analysis, process walkthroughs, floor observation, segmentation, and Lean Six Sigma methods to move from symptoms to underlying drivers.
* Analysis \& optimization: Build and maintain the analysis that drives decisions on the account — performance trends, driver analysis, and scenario comparisons — and translate findings into concrete optimization actions.
* Data \& analytical quality: Validate data availability, definitions, and reliability; reconcile conflicting sources; document assumptions and limitations; and assure the accuracy and reproducibility of analytical outputs.
* Solution enablement \& implementation support: Shape practical recommendations and support their implementation on the ground — coordinating owners, timelines, and dependencies so improvements are actually executed.
* Commercial \& account insight: Connect findings to account economics — productivity, cost\-to\-serve, SLA/KPI exposure, quality, and client\-impact implications.
* Technology \& process enablement: Identify where recurring problems can be addressed through dashboards, trackers, automation, or process redesign; define clear requirements and partner with development resources on delivery.
* Adoption \& impact tracking: Establish baselines, track adoption and action closure, and measure before/after business impact so improvements stick and benefits are evidenced.
* Reporting \& decision support: Translate analysis into concise, decision\-ready narratives and flags for account reviews and for the Assistant Manager / Manager, Business Insights.

description:

 We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.
   

  

**What role will you play?**

 Finance
   

  

 You will assist our global teams with financial management, regulatory reporting, and business advisory services, supporting Macquarie's growth and enabling the Operating Groups to achieve their objectives.
   

  

 Operations

 You will develop your knowledge and skills while working across data, platforms, projects, and transformation. You will learn to generate, analyse, and report data and will have the opportunity to apply your skills on the job.

You will have exposure to functional skills such as data operations, reporting and analytics, operations management and monitoring, internal audit, control assurance, or projects.

title: Research Engineer, AI
description:
**About Atlys**
 Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
   

  

 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
   

  

 Atlys is changing that.
   

  

 We're building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M\+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.
   

  

**The Role**
 We're looking for a
 **Research Engineer, AI** 
 to build the models and systems that make visa processing faster, more accurate and more reliable than ever before.
   

  

 You'll take ideas from research to production, testing new approaches across LLMs, agents and document intelligence, and shipping the ones that move real outcomes like approval rates, turnaround times and cost per application.
   

  

 This role is for someone with a strong engineering foundation who loves going deep on hard AI problems, and who gets as much satisfaction from a system that works in production as from a clever idea.
   

  

**The Job**
* Build AI systems that do real work by designing and shipping LLM\-powered agents that reliably complete complex, multi\-step tasks across external tools, APIs and web interfaces.
* Push the frontier of document intelligence by building pipelines that extract, verify and reason over information from unstructured documents and images with high accuracy at scale.
* Define how we measure AI quality by building evaluation frameworks, benchmarks and datasets that show how accurate, reliable and safe our models are across the long tail of real\-world cases, before and after they ship.
* Run experiments that change decisions by comparing models, prompting strategies, fine\-tuning approaches and routing logic to improve accuracy while reducing latency and cost.
* Own systems end to end by taking work from prototype to production, including data pipelines, inference infrastructure, monitoring and human\-in\-the\-loop fallbacks for when models aren’t confident.


**The Ideal Candidate**
**You'll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**
* Have 3\-6 years of software engineering experience, including meaningful work building and shipping ML or LLM\-based systems in production.
* Are exceptionally strong in Python and comfortable with the modern AI stack, such as PyTorch, Hugging Face, LLM APIs, vector databases and agent frameworks.
* Have hands\-on experience with LLMs in practice, including prompting, RAG, fine\-tuning, tool use and evals, and understand where each approach works and where it breaks.
* Bring a research mindset with a bias to ship: you form hypotheses, run clean experiments, read papers when they help, and turn results into systems people use.
* Have exposure to document AI, OCR, large\-scale data pipelines, or making inference fast and cost\-efficient at scale.


**What You Can Expect**
 Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
   

  

**Here's What You Can Expect**
* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning \& development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


 Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you'll probably thrive here. If it doesn't, it's better to know that upfront.
   

  

**Come build the intelligence layer for global travel**

title: Research Scientist, AI
description:
**About Atlys**
 Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
   

  

 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
   

  

 Atlys is changing that.
   

  

 We're building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M\+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.
   

  

**The Role**
 We're looking for a
 **Research Scientist, AI** 
 to invent the methods that make our AI systems more accurate, more reliable and more autonomous than anything available off the shelf.
   

  

 You'll work on the hardest open problems in our stack: agents that act reliably across unfamiliar government portals, models that reason over messy real\-world documents, and systems that know when they don't know. You'll set the research direction, run careful experiments and partner with our Research Engineers to turn breakthroughs into production gains in approval rates, turnaround times and cost per application.
   

  

 This role is for someone with deep research expertise who is energised by problems that don't have a paper to copy yet, and who measures success by real\-world impact, not just benchmark scores.
   

  

**The Job**
* Set and drive a research agenda on open problems in agentic AI, including how LLM\-powered agents plan, use tools, take actions and recover from errors over long, multi\-step tasks.
* Develop new methods for multimodal understanding and reasoning, so models can reliably extract, verify and reason over noisy, unstructured real\-world inputs across formats and languages.
* Design and run post\-training research, including fine\-tuning, preference optimisation and reinforcement learning, to push model capabilities beyond what general\-purpose frontier models offer.
* Research calibration, uncertainty estimation and self\-verification so AI systems know when to act autonomously and when to defer to a human.
* Build evaluations, benchmarks and synthetic data methods that give an honest picture of model quality, robustness and failure modes, especially on the long tail.
* Collaborate closely with research engineers to take ideas from prototype to production, and share findings through internal write\-ups and, where appropriate, publications.


**The Ideal Candidate**
**You'll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**
* Have a PhD or MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning or a related field, or equivalent research experience, plus 3\+ years of applied or academic research in ML, NLP or computer vision.
* Have a track record of original research, such as publications at top venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, CVPR), influential open\-source work, or research that clearly moved production metrics.
* Have deep hands\-on experience with LLMs beyond prompting, including fine\-tuning, RLHF/DPO or other post\-training methods, evaluation design, and a strong grasp of why models succeed or fail.
* Are strong in Python and PyTorch, and can run experiments yourself, from data curation and training runs to careful analysis.
* Bring rigour with a bias to impact: you ask sharp questions, design clean experiments, avoid fooling yourself, and care about whether the result changes what we build.

title: Lead: Unit Economics & NPV Strategy
description:
**Description**
 About The Company
   

  

 FairMoney is a pioneering mobile banking institution specializing in extending credit to emerging markets. Established in 2017, the company currently operates primarily within Nigeria, and it has secured nearly €50 million in funding from renowned global investors, including Tiger Global, DST, and Flourish Ventures.
   

  

 In alignment with its vision, FairMoney is actively constructing the foremost mobile banking platform and point\-of\-sale (POS) solution tailored for emerging markets. The journey began with the introduction of a digital microcredit application exclusively available on Android and iOS devices.
   

  

 Today, FairMoney has significantly expanded its range of services, encompassing a comprehensive suite of financial products, such as current accounts, savings accounts, debit cards, and state\-of\-the\-art POS solutions designed to meet the needs of both merchants and agents. FairMoney thrives on its diverse workforce, bringing together talent from over 27 nationalities.
   

  

 We operate at massive scale, move fast, and expect leaders to think in systems, not silos. Decisions are data\-driven, accountability is explicit, and impact matters.
   

  

 This role sits at the heart of how FairMoney decides
 **who to lend to, how much to lend, at what price, and why** 
 .
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are hiring a
 **Lead: Unit Economics \& NPV Strategy** 
 to own, improve, and operationalise FairMoney’s existing NPV and unit economics frameworks and ensure they become a core operating system for decision\-making, not just analytical artefacts.
   

  

 While FairMoney already has NPV models in place, they are not yet consistently embedded into credit decisions, pricing, experimentation, and growth trade\-offs. This role exists to close that gap.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be the single source of truth on
 **value creation vs value destruction** 
 , expected vs actual performance, and the economic impact of risk, pricing, and growth decisions.
   

  

 This is a senior, high\-ownership role for someone who pushes the bar, challenges assumptions, and thrives in a high\-growth, high\-pressure environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Own NPV \& Unit Economics: Own, audit, and improve NPV and unit economics models across lending products, ensuring consistent assumptions and decision\-ready outputs for pricing, credit cut\-offs, and capital allocation.
* Measure Expected vs Actual Performance: Build frameworks to measure performance across products, cohorts, credit policies, pricing strategies, and experiments, identifying key drivers of variance and feeding insights back into risk and pricing decisions.
* Drive Experimentation \& Value Attribution: Partner with Risk, Data Science, Product, and Growth to define NPV hypotheses, measure incremental economic value, and identify which initiatives should be scaled, improved, or stopped.
* Influence Business Decisions: Translate complex economic analysis into clear trade\-offs and provide credible insights to senior leadership, challenging models, policies, and decisions when the economics do not support them.
* Embed NPV in Decision\-Making: Integrate NPV thinking into credit policy reviews, risk governance, pricing and limit discussions, and planning cycles, while setting standards for transparency, documentation, and assumption discipline.
* Raise the Analytical Bar: Operate with high ownership and integrity, challenge analytical and execution standards, stay adaptable under pressure, and contribute to FairMoney’s mission of providing responsible access to credit.


**Requirements**
 Must\-Haves
   

  

* Strong experience in unit economics, NPV, LTV, or portfolio profitability (lending, fintech, banking, or adjacent sectors).
* Deep understanding of credit economics and how risk, pricing, tenure, and behaviour interact.
* Proven track record of measuring expected vs actual outcomes.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders using data and logic.
* High ownership mindset with bias toward action.


 Nice\-To\-Have
   

  

* Experience in high\-growth fintech or scale\-up environments.
* Exposure to experimentation frameworks (A/B testing, policy tests, pricing tests).
* Strong SQL / Python / analytics tooling capability.
* Experience working closely with Risk, Data Science, and Growth teams.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 By Month 3
   

  

* Existing NPV models are audited, rationalised, and standardised.
* A portfolio\-level NPV view exists across all major products.
* Leadership has clear visibility into where value is created or destroyed.
* Experiments are routinely evaluated on NPV uplift versus control.


 By Month 6
   

  

* NPV actively drives decisions on:
* Credit cut\-offs
* Pricing bands
* Growth investment trade\-offs
* Gaps between expected and actual performance are measured, explained, and shrinking.
* Risk, Data Science, and Growth teams operate using a shared economic language.
* Leadership trusts NPV outputs enough to make difficult, high\-impact decisions.


 Final Note
   

  

 This is not a passive analytics role.
   

  

 We are looking for someone who is comfortable challenging assumptions, pushing for clarity, and holding the line on economic truth — even when it is inconvenient.
   

  

 If you are motivated by scale, complexity, ownership, and impact, this role will stretch you and reward you.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Paid Time Off
* Training \& Development
* Flexible work structure


**Recruitment Process**
* A screening call with a member of the recruitment team.
* Technical interview with the hiring manager.
* Case study round.
* Panel session based on the case study.

title: Lead Engineer - Data & AI Platform
description:
**Role:** 
 Lead Data \& AI Platform Engineer
 



**Function:** 
 Data Engineering / AI/ML Platform
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Media Production, Broadcast Media, Online Media
 



  





**About Company** 




 The company is one of India's largest private FM radio networks. It reaches over 40 million listeners weekly across 49 cities, 1,000\+ towns, and 50,000 villages.
 



 It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu \& Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform extends the brand into curated lifestyle, music, and news content.
 



 The company operates at the intersection of legacy broadcast media and digital innovation, with a team of 740\.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 The company is building a next\-generation media super\-app that unifies video, audio, radio, micro\-drama, news, and commerce on a single digital platform. This role owns the scalable data and ML infrastructure powering content discovery, personalised recommendations, and user engagement at scale. The engineer in this role bridges production data systems and AI/ML teams, moving models from experimentation into reliable, high\-throughput production environments.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Design and build scalable data architecture for a high\-volume consumer media platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving layers for user activity, content consumption, and commerce data.
* Build and maintain batch and real\-time streaming pipelines processing millions of user events and large volumes of multimedia metadata using technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Architect data lakes, warehouses, and analytical datasets supporting product analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases; enforce data quality, lineage, observability, and governance across all pipelines.
* Develop feature engineering pipelines and reusable feature stores for recommendation, personalisation, ranking, search, and content intelligence systems.
* Build training and inference pipelines connecting production data with ML models; enable continuous feedback loops for model retraining from live user interactions.
* Deploy ML/AI models into production on AWS, GCP, or Azure; containerise and orchestrate model workloads using Docker and Kubernetes; build APIs/services for consumer\-facing AI integration.
* Monitor model and pipeline performance — latency, scalability, reliability — and partner with AI/ML teams to operationalise models from experimentation to production.



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 7–9 years of hands\-on software or data engineering experience, with a track record of building and operating large\-scale data platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala for data and ML pipeline development.
* Production experience with distributed data processing and streaming technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud\-based data infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure, including data lakes, warehouses, and distributed storage.
* Demonstrated experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments, including batch and real\-time inference pipelines.
* Proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes for containerising and orchestrating model and pipeline workloads.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, distributed systems, and data modelling for both analytical and ML use cases.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience building data infrastructure for recommendation, personalisation, search, or content ranking systems.
* Exposure to feature stores, MLOps platforms, and ML training/inference workload management.
* Prior experience on high\-scale B2C or consumer internet platforms handling behavioural and event\-streaming data.
* Background in media, OTT, video, audio, music, social media, gaming, or news platforms.
* Exposure to Generative AI, embeddings, vector databases, or LLM\-based applications.



  





**What We Offer** 



* End\-to\-end ownership of data and AI platform infrastructure for a consumer product reaching tens of millions of users.
* Opportunity to work at the convergence of broadcast media and digital innovation on a greenfield super\-app build.
* Collaborative environment with AI/ML, product, and engineering teams working on high\-impact personalisation and content intelligence problems.

 This role is perfect for someone who thrives at the intersection of data science, software development, and product operations. If you are excited by the idea of making a measurable impact and being a key player in a collaborative, innovative team, we want to hear from you!
   

  

**What You Will Bring**
 We are looking for candidates who are ready to make a difference from day one. You will bring:
   

  

* A relevant academic degree, such as a Master of Science (M.Sc.) in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Chemical or Process Engineering, Software Engineering, or a similar technical or quantitative discipline
* Strong Python development skills, with hands\-on experience in debugging, maintaining, and supporting operational solutions
* A track record in data science and supporting or operating production or customer\-facing systems
* The drive and confidence to take ownership of a complete codebase and see projects through to successful operation
* Experience troubleshooting and maintaining deployed analytical or digital solutions
* A structured, practical approach to solving operational challenges
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and with customers
* Curiosity and enthusiasm for learning about chemical and process engineering


 It will be an added advantage if you have any experience in :
   

  

* Data engineering and Extract, Transform, Load (ETL)
* Spark or Databricks
* Docker or Kubernetes
* SQL or NoSQL databases
* Dashboards or web\-based analytical tools
* Cloud platforms and DevOps practices
* Customer\-facing digital products or industrial systems


 We value ownership, accountability, and a hands\-on, solution\-oriented mindset. If you are ready to step up and help shape the future of digital operations, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

**Why Join Us**
 At Topsoe, you will join a vibrant, forward\-thinking environment where your ideas and expertise are valued. This is your chance to combine data science and Python development with real operational ownership, working on products that make a difference for customers around the world. You will collaborate with talented colleagues, learn from industry leaders, and have the freedom to innovate and grow. We offer continuous learning, professional development, and the satisfaction of seeing your work drive real\-world impact. Join us and be part of a team that is shaping the future of sustainable technology.
   

  

**Your New Team**
 You will become part of a close\-knit data science group of around six dedicated professionals who have built Clearview from the ground up. As we shift our focus to reliable operation, customer support, and ongoing product improvement, you will have the opportunity to work across data science, Python development, product operations, and customer collaboration. Your contributions will be valued, your voice will be heard, and your work will help ensure our solutions deliver stable, practical value in real\-world environments.
   

  

**How You Can Apply**
 If you would like to be part of a team of skilled and professional colleagues in an informal organization, please submit your documents in English.
   

  

 Application deadline: 22\-10\-2026\.
   

  

 You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application – just include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are applying. Please also avoid the use of photos in your CV. Both of these measures are to ensure a fair and unbiased process.
   

  

 We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.
   

  

 To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references.
   

  

 To headhunters: Thank you for your interest in our company. However, we would like to inform you that we have a dedicated internal team managing our recruitment process. We kindly request that you refrain from reaching out to us regarding potential candidates. Thank you for your understanding.
   

  

**About Us**
 Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition.

title: Senior Associate - Monitoring, Learning and Evaluation ( EAII Advisors )
description:
**This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India.**
**About EAII**
 EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence\-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi\-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long\-term wellbeing of children and families.
   

  

 For more information, read about our work here: About Evidence Action and EAII
   

  

**About Evidence Action**
 At Evidence Action, we deliver data\-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
   

  

 Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel\-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we're making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 11 countries, our team of 900\+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
   

  

* Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains.
* Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children.
* Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low\-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives.


 At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high\-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.
   

  

**The Role**
 You will be part of our Monitoring, Learning and Evaluation team supporting the successful design and rollout of monitoring initiatives for the India Safe Water programme. The programme is implementing In\-Line Chlorination (ILC) technology in partnership with the Government of India's Jal Jeevan Mission, targeting communities served by Single Village Scheme water systems; ILC delivers safe, chlorinated water at the source and has demonstrated strong potential for cost\-effectiveness and scale. The programme is currently operational in Andhra Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh, with the goal of reaching 17\.5 million people across multiple Indian states with safe drinking water.
   

  

 As the programme portfolio expands, you will contribute to exploring and implementing innovative, technology\-enabled ways of operating at scale. The MLE team plays a central role in generating evidence, ensuring data quality, and informing programme decisions; this role requires significant experience in evaluation, quantitative research, impact assessment, development programmes, and applied data analytics.
   

  

 The Senior Associate \- Monitoring, Learning and Evaluation will be based in New Delhi and reports to the Senior Manager \- Monitoring, Learning and Evaluation.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Monitoring Framework and Systems
   

  

* Support the MLE team in developing programme Theory of Change, Results Framework, Logframe, indicators and measurement protocols aligned with programme objectives
* Develop and institutionalise monitoring tools, reporting formats, data quality protocols and SOPs
* Establish systems for routine tracking of programme outputs, outcomes and key performance indicators
* Work closely with programme teams to ensure that monitoring systems generate actionable insights rather than only reporting numbers
* Support the design and implementation of the MLE framework for the India Safe Water programme


 Evaluation Design and Assessment
   

  

* Work with MLE team to Develop evaluation designs appropriate to programme objectives, including experimental/quasi\-experimental approaches where feasible
* Work with the MLE team to develop sampling strategies, sample size calculations, survey designs, questionnaires and data collection protocols
* Define appropriate evaluation indicators and outcome measures related to safe water access, water quality, behaviour change, service delivery and programme performance


 Data Management, Analysis and Interpretation
   

  

* Analysis of large and complex programme datasets using appropriate statistical and econometric methods
* Conduct descriptive, inferential and multivariate analysis, as appropriate
* Identify trends, patterns, correlations and anomalies in programme data and translate these into actionable programme insights
* Develop approaches for data triangulation across survey and monitoring datasets
* Establish standards for data cleaning, validation, documentation and reproducible analysis


 Data Visualisation and Dashboarding
   

  

* Develop and maintain management dashboards and data visualisation systems to track programme performance
* Translate complex datasets into intuitive visualisations that can be used by field teams for decision\-making
* Design dashboards covering key programme indicators, performance, implementation progress, outcome indicators and emerging risks


 Data Quality and Field Monitoring
   

  

* Work with the MLE team to Establish and implement a robust Data Quality Assurance (DQA) framework
* Develop protocols for data verification, back\-checks, audits and validation of field\-collected data
* Conduct periodic reviews of monitoring data to identify inconsistencies, reporting gaps and potential data quality issues
* Work with field and implementation teams to strengthen data collection processes and address data quality gaps
* Ensure that data collection tools and processes are aligned with evaluation and analytical requirements


 Programme Learning and Decision Support
   

  

* Develop regular analytical reports and management briefs highlighting programme performance, challenges, emerging trends and recommended actions
* Institutionalise learning loops between monitoring, evaluation and programme implementation


 Stakeholder Coordination
   

  

* Work closely with programme, operations, technical and field teams to integrate M\&E into programme implementation
* Manage relationships with external agencies, survey firms, evaluators and technology/data partners


**Requirements**
* 3\-5 years of relevant experience in MLE, evaluation, quantitative research, impact assessment, development programmes, or applied data analytics
* Master's degree in Economics, Statistics, Public Policy, or a related field
* Experience in WASH, safe water, public health, or rural development is desirable
* Strong understanding of evaluation methodologies and research design
* Demonstrated experience in designing impact and outcome evaluations
* Knowledge of sampling techniques, sample size determination, and survey methodology
* Advanced skills in data analysis and statistical modelling
* Strong hands\-on experience in data quality assurance, high\-frequency checks, data validation, data cleaning, and data management
* Excellent data visualisation and dashboarding skills
* Proficiency in Stata, SPSS, Power BI, and CAPI scripting. Experience with multiple analytical and data management tools is an advantage
* Ability to independently interpret quantitative findings and effectively communicate insights and implications to non\-technical stakeholders
* Strong report writing, documentation, and presentation skills
* Fluency in written and spoken English and Hindi


**Position Location** 
 : This role will be based in New Delhi, India.
   

  

 Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time.
   

  

**Benefits**
 EAII provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees worldwide. Benefits include:
   

  

* Comprehensive health insurance with IPD and OPD provisions,
* Life and Accidental insurance
* PF, ESIC and Gratuity as per statutory requirements
* Optional enrolment in the National Pension System (NPS) through our partner, HDFC Pension
* Optional Flexible Basket Plan, offering components such as meal allowance, fuel, top\-up health and term insurance, and telecommunications \& internet \- all forming part of the employee's CTC
* Mental and physical well\-being benefits
* Learning and Development benefit
* Generous leave
* Avenues for engagement and recognition


 Compensation: Competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and previous pay scale.
   

  

 All contracting arrangements will be made through EAII Advisors Private Limited. EAII is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment at EAII is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. EAII does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, caste, creed, colour, religion, gender, origin, disability, marital status, or any other basis protected by law.
   

  

 This role will be open for applications until September 25, 2026\. Please apply at your earliest convenience. We may close this search earlier than the specified date if we find the right fit. Due to the volume of applications received, we will only be able to contact shortlisted candidates.

title: AI Specialist Revenue Operations (India Remote)
description:
**Company Description**
  

 When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.
   

  

 Experience a remote\-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well\-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
   

  

 Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
   

  

  

**Job Description**
  

 The AI Specialist, Revenue Operations is responsible for building and running the AI workloads that support the global revenue organization. Revenue Operations is establishing an AI orchestration platform alongside a set of AI agents and automations that change how commercial teams work, and this role is the first dedicated build resource within it.
   

  

 The primary focus is twofold. The role develops automations and agent features against a defined specification, and it owns the operational work that keeps live AI systems healthy and measurably effective: evaluation, knowledge curation, monitoring and first\-line diagnosis. Technical direction and platform architecture are set by the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement \& AI Transformation.
   

  

 This role also assists in establishing the working practices that Revenue Operations will follow. The standards this role helps set around documentation, evaluation and production readiness will determine how quickly our AI platforms can scale, and how much of the technical work can be safely devolved over time.
   

  

**Core areas of impact include:**
* **Workload Development:** 
 Building AI agents, automations and integrations against a defined specification.
* **Quality Evaluation:** 
 Establishing and running the evaluation that evidences AI agent performance.
* **Knowledge Curation:** 
 Maintaining the knowledge bases and data that grounded AI agents depend on.
* **Operational Support:** 
 Monitoring live AI workloads and owning first\-line diagnosis of failures.
* **Production Readiness:** 
 Supporting the movement of AI workloads through technical and security review into production.


**Responsibilities:**
* **Workload Development:** 
 Builds automations and AI agent features against a written specification and within the platform's established patterns, including prompt development, retrieval and knowledge grounding.
* **Quality Evaluation:** 
 Authors and runs evaluation test cases for AI workloads, extends coverage as those workloads change, and produces the reporting that evidences whether agent performance is improving.
* **Knowledge Curation:** 
 Curates and maintains the knowledge bases, content and data that grounded AI agents depend on, and prepares and transforms data for agent consumption.
* **Workload Operations:** 
 Monitors live AI workloads, owns first\-line investigation of failures, resolves issues within scope, and escalates the remainder with a clear technical diagnosis.
* **Integration Development:** 
 Builds and maintains integrations with Revenue Operations systems through APIs and workflow orchestration tooling, with due attention to authentication, error handling and access control.
* **Production Readiness:** 
 Supports the movement of AI workloads into production by assembling technical documentation, completing security and access reviews, and preparing release and rollback notes.
* **Technical Documentation:** 
 Maintains accurate documentation for all AI workloads, and documents reusable patterns so that each successive build is faster to deliver than the last.
* **Platform Contribution:** 
 Contributes to the ongoing development of an AI orchestration platform under the technical direction of the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement \& AI Transformation.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** 
 Explains the behavior and limitations of AI workloads clearly to non\-technical colleagues across Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and the wider revenue organization.
* **Continuous Improvement:** 
 Gathers feedback from users of live AI workloads and applies it to improve agent quality and reliability.


  

  

**Qualifications**
  

**Proven Characteristics for Success**
* Demonstrated ability to build working software with AI tooling, evidenced by delivered work rather than formal training alone.
* Strong diagnostic instinct and the persistence to establish why a system behaved as it did.
* Comfortable working to a defined technical direction while taking full ownership of implementation.
* Surfaces ambiguity in a specification rather than proceeding on assumption.
* Data\-driven approach to quality, focused on measurement rather than assertion.
* Disciplined about documentation, with an understanding of why it matters to a small technical team.
* Highly organized with an action\-oriented mindset and strong written communication skills.


**Qualifications, Skills, and Knowledge / Experience**
**Essential**
* Hands\-on experience building with large language model APIs, including prompt engineering and retrieval or knowledge base systems. Self\-directed and personal project work is considered.
* Working knowledge of Python or JavaScript, sufficient to read, modify and extend an existing codebase confidently.
* Practical experience integrating with REST APIs, including authentication and handling failure conditions in systems outside the developer's control.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational data structures.
* Excellent written communication, particularly in documenting technical findings for a mixed audience.
* Legal eligibility for authorized employment within the India region.
* Fluent in verbal and written English.


**Preferred**
* Experience with a workflow automation or orchestration platform such as n8n, Make or Zapier.
* Technical exposure to a CRM or sales engagement platform, such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Experience in software testing, quality assurance or the evaluation of AI systems.
* Experience in technical support, troubleshooting or incident diagnosis.
* Experience with knowledge management, content curation or technical documentation.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS.
* Experience with conversational or voice AI platforms.
* Knowledge and experience working within the EdTech sector.


**Education**
* Educated to degree level in a technical discipline or equivalent demonstrable experience. Candidates with a portfolio of self\-taught, built work are encouraged to apply.


**Tii Elements**
* **Curiosity:** 
 Has a growth mindset and leads with questions vs. assumptions. Unleashes creativity and possibility by actively seeking new experiences, information, and knowledge; embraces challenge, takes risks, learns fast and welcomes change.
* **Resourcefulness:** 
 Possesses a mindset of abundance and redefines what's possible; creates and advances ways of achieving results in new or difficult situations either by appropriating additional resources, or by doing more with less.
* **Quality Focus:** 
 Setting high quality standards for our work and striving for continuous improvement and quality assurance so that our internal \& external customers get the best possible outcomes.
* **Self\-Awareness \& Impact:** 
 Shows awareness of the impacts of one's choices, words, decisions and actions on others and on the business. And aligns behaviors with intended outcomes.


  

  

**Additional Information**

title: Lead: Unit Economics & NPV Strategy
description:
About The Company
 



 FairMoney is a pioneering mobile banking institution specializing in extending credit to emerging markets. Established in 2017, the company currently operates primarily within Nigeria, and it has secured nearly €50 million in funding from renowned global investors, including Tiger Global, DST, and Flourish Ventures.
 



 In alignment with its vision, FairMoney is actively constructing the foremost mobile banking platform and point\-of\-sale (POS) solution tailored for emerging markets. The journey began with the introduction of a digital microcredit application exclusively available on Android and iOS devices.
 



 Today, FairMoney has significantly expanded its range of services, encompassing a comprehensive suite of financial products, such as current accounts, savings accounts, debit cards, and state\-of\-the\-art POS solutions designed to meet the needs of both merchants and agents. FairMoney thrives on its diverse workforce, bringing together talent from over 27 nationalities.
 



 We operate at massive scale, move fast, and expect leaders to think in systems, not silos. Decisions are data\-driven, accountability is explicit, and impact matters.
 



 This role sits at the heart of how FairMoney decides
 **who to lend to, how much to lend, at what price, and why** 
 .
 



 About The Role
 



 We are hiring a
 **Lead: Unit Economics \& NPV Strategy** 
 to own, improve, and operationalise FairMoney's existing NPV and unit economics frameworks and ensure they become a core operating system for decision\-making, not just analytical artefacts.
 



 While FairMoney already has NPV models in place, they are not yet consistently embedded into credit decisions, pricing, experimentation, and growth trade\-offs. This role exists to close that gap.
 



 The successful candidate will be the single source of truth on
 **value creation vs value destruction** 
 , expected vs actual performance, and the economic impact of risk, pricing, and growth decisions.
 



 This is a senior, high\-ownership role for someone who pushes the bar, challenges assumptions, and thrives in a high\-growth, high\-pressure environment.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* **Own NPV \& Unit Economics:** 
 Own, audit, and improve NPV and unit economics models across lending products, ensuring consistent assumptions and decision\-ready outputs for pricing, credit cut\-offs, and capital allocation
* **Measure Expected vs Actual Performance:** 
 Build frameworks to measure performance across products, cohorts, credit policies, pricing strategies, and experiments, identifying key drivers of variance and feeding insights back into risk and pricing decisions
* **Drive Experimentation \& Value Attribution:** 
 Partner with Risk, Data Science, Product, and Growth to define NPV hypotheses, measure incremental economic value, and identify which initiatives should be scaled, improved, or stopped
* **Influence Business Decisions:** 
 Translate complex economic analysis into clear trade\-offs and provide credible insights to senior leadership, challenging models, policies, and decisions when the economics do not support them
* **Embed NPV in Decision\-Making:** 
 Integrate NPV thinking into credit policy reviews, risk governance, pricing and limit discussions, and planning cycles, while setting standards for transparency, documentation, and assumption discipline
* **Raise the Analytical Bar:** 
 Operate with high ownership and integrity, challenge analytical and execution standards, stay adaptable under pressure, and contribute to FairMoney's mission of providing responsible access to credit


**Requirements**

 Must\-Haves
 


* Strong experience in unit economics, NPV, LTV, or portfolio profitability (lending, fintech, banking, or adjacent sectors)
* Deep understanding of credit economics and how risk, pricing, tenure, and behaviour interact
* Proven track record of measuring expected vs actual outcomes
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders using data and logic
* High ownership mindset with bias toward action



 Nice\-To\-Have
 


* Experience in high\-growth fintech or scale\-up environments
* Exposure to experimentation frameworks (A/B testing, policy tests, pricing tests)
* Strong SQL / Python / analytics tooling capability
* Experience working closely with Risk, Data Science, and Growth teams



 What Success Looks Like
 


**By Month 3**
* Existing NPV models are audited, rationalised, and standardised
* A portfolio\-level NPV view exists across all major products
* Leadership has clear visibility into where value is created or destroyed
* Experiments are routinely evaluated on NPV uplift versus control


**By Month 6**
* NPV actively drives decisions on:


* Credit cut\-offs
* Pricing bands
* Growth investment trade\-offs
* Gaps between expected and actual performance are measured, explained, and shrinking
* Risk, Data Science, and Growth teams operate using a shared economic language
* Leadership trusts NPV outputs enough to make difficult, high\-impact decisions



 Final Note
 



 This is not a passive analytics role.
 



 We are looking for someone who is comfortable challenging assumptions, pushing for clarity, and holding the line on economic truth — even when it is inconvenient.
 



 If you are motivated by scale, complexity, ownership, and impact, this role will stretch you and reward you.
   

  




**Benefits**
* Paid Time Off
* Training \& Development
* Flexible work structure



**Recruitment Process:** 



* A screening call with a member of the recruitment team
* Technical interview with the hiring manager
* Case study round
* Panel session based on the case study

description:
**Job Details** 




  





 Outlier helps the world's most innovative companies improve their AI models by providing human feedback. Are you an experienced Machine Learning / AI Expert who would like to lend your expertise to train AI models?
 



  





**About the opportunity:** 




  




* Outlier is looking for talented
 **Machine Learning and AI Experts** 
 to help train generative artificial intelligence models.
* This freelance opportunity is remote and hours are flexible, so you can work whenever is best for you.



  





**You may contribute your expertise by…** 




  




* **Review ML papers.** 
 Analyze research papers on ML, systems, and optimization to build challenge problems for agents that learn through recursive feedback.
* **Build evals.** 
 Write the automated graders and verifiers that score an agent’s attempt and set the rewards.
* **Catch reward hacking.** 
 Author LLM\-judged rubrics that distinguish a genuine solve from an agent gaming the metric or hard\-coding its way to a high score.
* **Test with frontier models.** 
 Run top models against your problem and check that stronger ones outperform weaker ones — and that performance climb across the recursive iterations.
* **Analyze the trajectories.** 
 Review what the model actually did across iterations, diagnose where it failed, and confirm gains come from the feedback loop, not luck.
* **Document it.** 
 Capture the problem design, why it’s hard, how each model performed, and what the failure modes reveal.



  





 Examples of desirable expertise:
 



 \- A completed PhD (degree awarded) in Computer Science, Machine Learning / Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics / Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Electrical or Computer Engineering, Physics, Computational Linguistics / NLP, Robotics, Operations Research, Computational Neuroscience, or Computational Biology / Bioinformatics, with 2\+ years of hands\-on Machine Learning / AI work after starting the PhD (industry roles, postdoc, research residency, ML internships, or ML research during the PhD all count)

title: Senior Associate- Business Growth
description:
**Senior Associate – Growth \& Marketing \| Native** 




  





**About the Role** 




 As a Senior Associate in the Native Growth \& Marketing team, you will own some of the biggest growth levers for Native—from identifying where growth will come from to building the plan, launching it, measuring the impact, and scaling what works.
 



 Native is building a new\-age consumer brand across categories such as Water Purifiers and Smart Door Locks. In this role, you will get the opportunity to work at the intersection of
 **business, marketing, product and consumer behavior** 
 , with a direct line of sight to revenue.
 



 You will be expected to think like a business owner. That means you won't just receive a campaign brief and execute it—you will help define
 **what problem we need to solve, what the right growth lever is, how we should solve it, and how we know it worked.** 




 You will work across the entire growth funnel—from product and pricing to discovery, conversion and retention—and take initiatives from
 **0 → 1 → scale** 
 .
 



 If you are looking for a role where you can take ownership early, see the direct impact of your work on the business, and learn how to build and scale a D2C brand, this is for you.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




 1\. Find the Next Growth Opportunity
 



 A big part of your role will be figuring out
 **where the next unlock is** 
 .
 



 You will:
 


* Deep dive into business and funnel data to identify opportunities and bottlenecks.
* Understand consumer behavior and speak to users to uncover what is driving—or preventing—conversion.
* Identify opportunities across product, assortment, pricing, offers, merchandising, channel experience and retention.
* Turn insights into clear hypotheses and action plans.
* Take ownership of solving the problem, not just reporting it.



 For example: Why are users dropping off? Why is one product converting better than another? Is the issue pricing, messaging, trust, discovery or the product experience? What should we test next?
 



  





 2\. Own GTM and Demand Generation End\-to\-End
 



 You will independently drive campaigns and growth initiatives from
 **strategy to execution to optimization** 
 .
 



 This includes:
 


* Identifying the objective and growth opportunity.
* Defining the target audience and proposition.
* Building the campaign and channel strategy.
* Planning budgets and expected outcomes.
* Working with internal teams to develop creatives and landing experiences.
* Setting up campaigns across platforms such as Meta, Google and YouTube.
* Managing campaigns on a day\-to\-day basis.
* Tracking performance and making optimization decisions.
* Scaling successful campaigns and shutting down what isn't working.



 You will not be limited to coordinating execution. You will have the opportunity to understand how paid growth actually works—from campaign planning and setup to performance management and scale.
 



  





 3\. Own Revenue Growth Across Key Levers
 



 You will work on the levers that directly impact Native's revenue.
 



 Product \& Offering
 


* Identify opportunities to improve assortment, bundling, product positioning and merchandising.
* Improve how products are discovered and presented across e\-commerce platforms.
* Work on reviews, ratings, content and other conversion levers.
* Identify gaps in the customer journey and drive improvements.



 Pricing \& Offers
 


* Analyze pricing and conversion trends to identify opportunities.
* Build and test offers across products, channels and campaigns.
* Understand the trade\-off between discounting, conversion and revenue.
* Continuously iterate to improve offer effectiveness.



 Channel Experience
 


* Improve how Native is experienced across app/storefronts, landing pages, paid channels and CRM.
* Work on propositions, messaging and creatives to improve CTR and CVR.
* Identify and solve friction points across the purchase journey.



  





 4\. Build and Scale the Full Customer Funnel
 



 Your ownership won't end once a campaign goes live.
 



 You will work across the full funnel:
 



**Discovery → Consideration → Conversion → Retention** 




 This includes:
 


* Building campaigns that drive awareness and discovery.
* Improving consideration through stronger propositions and product communication.
* Driving conversion through better offers, messaging and user experiences.
* Building lifecycle journeys across Push, WhatsApp and Email.
* Identifying high\-intent users and key drop\-offs.
* Designing interventions for cart abandoners, new users and repeat customers.



 The goal is simple:
 **continuously improve how users move through the funnel and drive measurable business growth.** 




  





 5\. Experiment, Learn and Scale
 



 You will have significant freedom to test ideas.
 



 We believe growth comes from running the right experiments—not waiting for the perfect answer.
 



 You will:
 


* Form hypotheses based on data and consumer insights.
* Design experiments across creatives, audiences, propositions, pricing, offers and funnels.
* Measure results and understand why something worked or didn't.
* Rapidly iterate and improve.
* Scale winning ideas into repeatable growth levers.



 We are looking for someone who enjoys asking,
 **"What happens if we try this?"** 
 —and then has the ownership to actually make it happen.
 



  





 6\. Run the Business, Not Just the Campaigns
 



 You will have direct visibility into business performance and will be expected to develop a strong understanding of the numbers behind growth.
 



 You will:
 


* Track metrics such as revenue, CAC, ROAS, CTR and CVR.
* Monitor daily and weekly business performance.
* Identify gaps, risks and opportunities before they become bigger problems.
* Build a strong understanding of the relationship between demand, inventory, pricing and growth.
* Work with Category and Operations teams to ensure growth plans are aligned with business realities.



 Over time, you should be able to look at the business, identify the biggest problem to solve, and drive the right intervention.
 



  





**What Will You Learn?** 




 This role is designed to give you
 **breadth of exposure and depth of ownership** 
 .
 



 You will learn how to:
 


* Build and scale a consumer/D2C brand.
* Think about growth as a business problem, not just a marketing problem.
* Run end\-to\-end GTM campaigns.
* Manage performance marketing hands\-on across major digital platforms.
* Use data and consumer insights to make decisions.
* Understand pricing, offers and conversion economics.
* Build lifecycle and retention journeys.
* Run experiments and make decisions based on results.
* Work across Product, Design, Analytics, Category and Operations.
* Take an idea from
 **0 → 1 → scale** 
 .



 Most importantly, you will develop the ability to
 **own a business problem end\-to\-end** 
 .
 



  





**Who Should Apply?** 




 We're looking for someone who wants more ownership than a typical marketing role offers.
 



 You will be a great fit if:
 


* You have 1–2 years of experience in growth, marketing, strategy, consulting, e\-commerce or a similar role.
* You want to own outcomes—not just tasks.
* You enjoy solving ambiguous problems and figuring things out from first principles.
* You are comfortable getting your hands dirty, whether that means analysing data, setting up a campaign or fixing an execution gap.
* You think in terms of business impact and enjoy understanding what drives revenue.
* You are analytical and comfortable using data to make decisions.
* You are highly detail\-oriented and don't let things fall through the cracks.
* You move fast, take initiative and have a strong
 **"get it done"**

title: Principal Manager, New Program Development (EAII Advisors)
description:
**This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India.**
**About EAII**
 EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence\-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi\-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long\-term wellbeing of children and families. For more information, read about our work here: About Evidence Action and EAII
   

  

**About Evidence Action**
 At Evidence Action, we deliver data\-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
   

  

 Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel\-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we're making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 9 countries, our team of 800\+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
   

  

* Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains.
* Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children.
* Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low\-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives.


 At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high\-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.
   

  

**The Role**
 Our Accelerator is the engine for new programs. It is a venture\-style, stage\-gated pipeline that finds the most promising health interventions and develops the strongest into programs ready to scale. Only about 2% of the interventions we evaluate make it through, and those that do have gone on to raise over $100 million. The New Program Development (NPD) team drives this work. We source and vet new ideas, dig into the evidence and cost\-effectiveness, build partnerships with researchers, governments, and implementers, and test concepts in the field to turn the best ideas into real programs.
   

  

 We are hiring a Principal Manager to lead the development of our next generation of health programs. You will own a set of early\-stage interventions and drive each one from a research insight to a program that is proven, fundable, and ready to scale, or to a clear and well\-reasoned decision to stop. You bring the rigor of an analyst who can interrogate evidence honestly and reason carefully under uncertainty. You also bring the drive of a builder who can source opportunities, cultivate partnerships, and turn ideas into programs that work in the real world. Together, those strengths let you find and build the interventions that deliver the most health impact for every dollar spent. You will join a close\-knit team that puts evidence first, thinks big, acts urgently, and is willing to challenge convention to reach more people. You will report to the India Country Lead with a dotted technical line to the Accelerator Director.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own a portfolio of pipeline interventions, end to end. Drive several promising candidate programs through the Accelerator's stage\-gate process, and decide what advances, what gets reshaped, and what exits our pipeline
* Interrogate the evidence with honesty. Assess each intervention's evidence base on the merits, including effect sizes and their quality, external validity, variability, negative and contradictory findings, and gaps.
* Model impact and cost\-effectiveness under uncertainty. Partner with the Cost\-Effectiveness team to build and pressure\-test CEAs, reasoning explicitly about assumptions, sensitivity, and uncertainty, and translating them into clear go/no\-go implications
* Design and run decision\-relevant learning in close collaboration with our MLE team. Scope and execute lean, rigorous field activities such as scoping, formative research, and pilots, to unblock decisions
* Build the case and align stakeholders. Craft compelling, evidence\-grounded investment cases. Bring researchers, implementers, governments, and donors along, anticipate objections, unblock barriers, and create momentum
* Collaborate across Evidence Action. Work hand in hand with our Growth team to build necessary resourcing and funding, relevant Program teams who bring the implementation muscle, and the Country Teams who cultivate and manage the policy and government partnerships in the places we work
* Be Evidence Action's face with partners. Independently lead conversations with study authors, implementing organizations, government officials, and funders, and use those relationships to source new ideas and partnerships
* Strengthen the Accelerator's methods, AI\-enabled workflows, and quality bar, and mentor analysts and interns on the workstreams you lead


**Requirements**
**Essential**
* You have a bachelors degree and 6 \- 10 years of experience in quant social science, program management, international development, or global health in a cross\-country setting
* You read primary research and study design critically, synthesize large and conflicting evidence bases, and form an honest view of what the evidence does and does not support
* You build or rigorously interpret cost\-effectiveness, epidemiological, or statistical models, and reason clearly about assumptions, sensitivity, and uncertainty
* You design lean learning activities that target the uncertainty actually blocking a decision, and you deliver them on a timeline
* You move things forward amid uncertainty, building, prototyping, and unblocking rather than waiting for perfect information
* You build trust and align both internal teams and external partners (researchers, implementers, government, and donors) across cultures and sectors toward a shared path
* You make complex technical findings clear and decision\-useful for non\-technical audiences, in writing and live
* You manage several workstreams at once, sequence sharply, and make defensible calls about where to spend scarce time
* You have experience working in an international setting and working with diverse teams
* You look for the reasons your favorite idea might be wrong, and welcome the same scrutiny of your own work


**Disclaimer:** 
 The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and that additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time.

title: UX Data Scientist
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 As a Senior Data Scientist on the Design team, you will play a pivotal role in transforming how some of the world's most critical infrastructure companies operate. The experiences you shape for both humans and agents will directly influence how complex projects are planned, deployed, and managed at scale.
   

  

 We are rethinking what excellent UX means in an agentic world. When the interface is a model, the quality of the experience is no longer carried primarily by pixels and flows — it is carried by behavior. What the agent retrieves, what it decides, what it says, when it refuses, and how reliably it does all of that across thousands of real situations. Those are measurement problems, experimentation problems, and evaluation problems. They are your problems.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who combines statistical rigor with a strong builder mentality — someone energized by ambiguity, fluent in model behavior, and obsessed with what "good" actually means and how to prove it. You will set the standard for how agent experiences are designed, instrumented, and held to a quality bar at Sitetracker — hands\-on, technically deep, and relentlessly connected to customer outcomes.
   

  

 You will be embedded in a scrum team — designing, measuring, and delivering alongside Engineering and Design on a day\-to\-day basis. You will own day\-to\-day decisions for your experience area, mentor others on rigor and method, and ship to production. For someone who wants to build, measure, and elevate the craft around them, this is the role.
   

  

 The Skills You'll Have
   

  

 Act with Agency
   

  

* Thrive in fast\-moving environments and deliver high\-impact outcomes at pace
* Independently identify ambiguous challenges and take ownership of driving them to resolution
* Champion new ideas, influence stakeholders, and rally support around strategic initiatives
* Identify workflows where AI tools and emerging technologies accelerate delivery, and make building the default way you work


 Measurement, Experimentation, and Evaluation
   

  

* Define what "good" means for an agentic experience and turn it into metrics, evals, and datasets that hold up under scrutiny
* Design and analyze experiments — A/B tests, holdouts, shadow runs — with correct sizing, clean reads, and honest conclusions
* Build offline and online evaluation systems for LLM behavior across correctness, grounding, safety, tone, and latency
* Apply statistical and ML fluency to real, messy production behavior — distinguishing signal from noise and root cause from symptom


 Agentic UX and Behavior Design
   

  

* Turn complex enterprise workflows into agent experiences people can actually use without training
* Design context architecture, decision paths, and communication patterns, and reason about how they shape behavior across the full input distribution
* Work directly with customers — running pilots, mining usage, and iterating based on how they actually behave, including customers with complex needs or in delicate situations
* Make tradeoff decisions across user needs, agent behavior, technical constraints, and business goals, and connect those decisions to commercial outcomes


 Competitive \& Market Awareness
   

  

* Maintain running awareness of the competitive landscape across multiple verticals
* Identify gaps and opportunities and produce analysis that connects to product and behavior decisions
* Track market trends, adjacent products, and emerging tools, connecting what's happening in the market to what Sitetracker should be doing
* Regularly contribute to competition and industry Slack channels with substantive observations


**Within 90 Days, You'll:**
* Collaborate regularly with product management, design, and engineering peers, and have met key stakeholders across the departments you work with
* Be on the phone with customers, learning their workflows, pain points, and how they use Sitetracker and Scout. Know the personas and subverticals
* Deliver work to your scrum team — pushing code, building instrumentation and evals, and demonstrating the builder standard
* Be able to confidently demo Sitetracker's core product in your area and give a solid cross\-product demo
* Stand up baseline evals and quality tracking for your area in Watch, and establish what you don't yet measure
* Begin mentoring others and providing substantive feedback in reviews


**Within 180 Days, You'll:**
* Lead the successful delivery of high\-impact agent experiences across complex enterprise workflows
* Own day\-to\-day decisions for your experience area independently, establishing leading indicators and making tradeoff decisions confidently
* Architect Scout graphs and design sophisticated AI interactions, owning a comprehensive eval suite and tracking quality over time
* Design and run experiments on real agent behavior, and run customer betas and previews independently — including with customers who have more complex needs or stronger opinions
* Actively mentor others and raise the bar through consistent, high\-quality reviews of evals, experiments, and agent designs
* Contribute meaningfully to shared evaluation infrastructure and establish higher standards for quality measurement in your domain


**Within 365 Days, You'll:**
* Point to product successes you have driven that have directly contributed to commercial outcomes
* Be recognized as an expert in your domain — people across the org come to you when they need to understand your experience area or how its quality is measured
* Ship code confidently to production, build the instrumentation and evals that keep quality honest, and operate as a true peer with engineering
* Be trusted with the most complex customer situations and maintain relationships with key customers that you built and maintain on your own
* Shape direction across multiple projects with well\-reasoned, evidence\-backed positions that influence the roadmap
* Set the pace for delivery in your domain and make others faster by reducing ambiguity early
