title: Senior Analyst - Supply Chain
description:
**Job Description \- Senior Analyst \- Supply Chain** 




  





**You should apply if you have:** 



* Prior D2C or e\-commerce background — you already understand the complexity of order\-to\-delivery systems, multi\-node fulfilment, and the operational quirks of a high\-velocity consumer business, so you're not learning the domain from scratch
* A sharp analytical mind with genuine curiosity about how logistics networks, warehouses, and support operations actually work end to end
* Strong quantitative comfort — you can model fulfilment and logistics allocation, inventory positioning, vendor performance, and RTO/COD risk with real rigour
* A builder's instinct — you don't stop at a dashboard; you want to prototype the algorithmic product (an allocation engine, a fraud score, a routing rule) that fixes the problem programmatically
* An AI\-first workflow — you use LLMs and vibe coding tools to build working prototypes, not just slides
* Comfort operating across multiple functions at once — warehouse, logistics, customer support, production, and procurement all draw on your intelligence layer
* High ownership through to closure — you don't stop at 'I shared the analysis'; you track whether the fix actually moved the metric
* Ownership\-driven attitude — you investigate problems no one assigned to you and push recommendations through to adoption



  





**You should not apply if you:** 



* Don't have prior D2C or e\-commerce exposure — this role assumes you already understand that operating environment; it isn't a place to learn it from zero
* Are looking to run day\-to\-day warehouse or logistics operations — this is an intelligence and analytics role that informs ops, not an ops role itself
* Need a long ramp time — we expect you to get conversant across WH, logistics, CS, production, and procurement context quickly
* Are uncomfortable holding several functions in your head at once and prioritizing across them
* See your job as ending at a report — here the goal is often a working algorithmic product, not just a recommendation
* Consider your job done once a dashboard ships — you need to keep watching it and flag when something breaks



  





**Skills Required:** 




  





**Must\-Have** 



* D2C / E\-commerce Background: hands\-on experience in a D2C, quick\-commerce, or high\-velocity consumer business — this is non\-negotiable, since it's what lets you understand the complexity of our systems from day one
* Supply Chain \& Logistics Analytics: reasoning about how orders should be allocated across fulfilment and logistics partners, and how a fulfilment network should evolve as the business scales
* COD \& RTO Risk Analysis: analysing order and delivery patterns to flag fraud and RTO risk
* Data Modelling \& SQL: comfortable querying and modelling on a warehouse (Redshift or similar) to build data cuts for multiple functions
* Algorithmic Product Thinking: able to scope and prototype rule\-based or lightweight algorithmic tools that automate a decision (allocation, routing, cancellation prediction) rather than just reporting on it
* Customer Support Ops Analytics: building scorecards for support quality/efficiency and identifying automation opportunities, including voice agent/IVR use cases
* Vendor Performance Analytics: analysing vendor\-level data (fill rate, quality, lead time, cost) to help procurement decide when to de\-risk away from a vendor or push for more utilization from one
* Structured Project \& Impact Tracking: taking a finding from problem statement and baseline through to a tracked project with a target KPI, and validating after the fact whether it actually moved the number
* Analytics Tools: Excel/Google Sheets for modelling and a BI tool (Metabase/Power BI) for reporting
* AI\-Assisted Building: using LLMs and vibe coding tools to prototype logistics and CS intelligence tools quickly



  





**Good to Have** 



* Python for scripting data pulls, automations, or lightweight algorithmic prototypes
* Prior exposure to COD/RTO fraud protection systems
* Familiarity with WMS/OMS platforms or courier aggregators
* Exposure to voice agent/IVR or CS automation platforms
* Basic optimization or linear\-programming concepts for allocation/inventory problems



  





**What will you do?** 




**Fulfilment \& Logistics Allocation Intelligence** 



* Build data\-driven logic for how orders should be allocated across fulfilment locations and courier partners
* Assess how the fulfilment network should evolve as order volumes and geographies grow, and where new locations would help
* This kind of business case — going from a raw operational question to a data\-backed algorithm that runs the decision — is representative of the business cases and product algorithms you'll own end to end in this role



**Inventory Optimization** 



* Build models to project stock requirements at the fulfilment\-location level across the network
* Minimize stockouts and overstock by improving how inventory is positioned across locations



**COD \& RTO Fraud Protection** 



* Analyse COD order patterns to identify at\-risk pin codes, customers, and order profiles
* Build and monitor fraud/risk scoring systems that flag orders before dispatch



**Vendor Intelligence for Procurement** 



* Analyse vendor\-level performance — fill rate, quality, lead time, cost — to give procurement a clear, data\-backed view of each vendor
* Help procurement decide when to de\-risk away from a vendor versus when to push for greater utilization from one



**Customer Support Intelligence** 



* Build scorecards for CS quality and efficiency across support channels
* Identify automation opportunities, including voice agents, and monitor cancellation drivers and reduction levers



**AI \& Algorithmic Products for Supply Chain** 



* Partner with product and engineering to scope and prototype algorithmic tools that automate fulfilment, routing, and cancellation\-related decisions
* Push prototypes from spreadsheet logic to production\-ready tools where the impact justifies it



**Own Supply Chain \& Ops Reporting** 



* Be the single go\-to person for all supply chain and operations reporting — fulfilment, logistics, warehouse, inventory, and CS metrics
* Build and maintain the dashboards and MIS that warehouse, logistics, CS, and production teams rely on day\-to\-day
* Make sure every function has one consistent, trusted source of truth for its numbers instead of everyone pulling their own



**Proactive Monitoring \& Early\-Warning** 



* Closely monitor supply chain and ops KPIs so you're the first to know when something breaks — a fulfilment delay, a courier SLA slip, a spike in cancellations or RTO
* Build early\-warning indicators that catch a problem before it snowballs into a stakeholder escalation
* Flag anomalies proactively and get the right team looking at it immediately, rather than waiting to be asked



**Track Projects Through to Impact** 



* For every recommendation you drive, define the baseline, target KPI, owner, and timeline upfront
* Follow through post\-implementation to confirm whether the change actually moved the metric, not just that it shipped
* Maintain visibility of open supply chain and ops projects — status, risk, and expected versus actual impact



**Cross\-Functional Data Cuts** 



* Act as the single source of intelligence for warehouse, logistics, CS, production, and procurement teams
* Give each function the right data cuts, dashboards, and recommendations to act on



**Reporting \& Stakeholder Communication** 



* Present supply chain health, fraud trends, vendor risk, and automation impact to founders and functional heads
* Translate complex operational data into clear, actionable narratives



  





**Work Experience:** 




 3–5 years of experience, with a D2C/e\-commerce background required
 



  





**Working days:** 




 Monday – Friday
 



  





**Location:** 




 Golf Course Ext. Road, Gurugram, Haryana (Work from Office)
 



  





**Perks:** 




 • Friendly atmosphere
 



 • High learning \& personal growth opportunity
 



 • Flexible timings
 



 • Diverse work environment
 



  





**Why Nutrabay:** 




 We believe in an open, intellectually honest culture where everyone is given the autonomy to contribute and do their life's best work. As part of the dynamic team at Nutrabay, you will have a chance to learn new things, solve new problems, build your competence, and be a part of an innovative marketing\-and\-tech startup that's revolutionising the health industry.
 



 Working with Nutrabay can be fun and a place of unique growth opportunities. Here you will learn how to maximise the potential of your available resources. You will get the opportunity to do work that helps you master a variety of transferable skills, or skills that are relevant across roles and departments. You will feel appreciated and valued for the work you deliver. We are creating a unique company culture that embodies respect and honesty, which will create more loyal employees than a company that simply shells out cash. We trust our employees and their voice and ask for their opinions on important business issues.
 



  





**About Nutrabay:** 




 Nutrabay is the largest health \& nutrition store in India. Our vision is to keep growing, have a sustainable business model, and continue to be the market leader in this segment by launching many innovative products. We are proud to have served over 1 million customers until now, and our family is constantly growing.
 



 We have built a complex and high\-converting eCommerce system, and our monthly traffic has grown to a million. We are looking to build a visionary and agile team to help fuel our growth and contribute to further advancing the continuously evolving product.
 



  





**Funding:** 




 We raised $5 million in a Series A funding.

* Stakeholder management ability — you can take a merchandizing recommendation to the product and design teams and defend it with evidence



**You should not apply if you:** 



* Are looking to run merchandising operations day\-to\-day (inventory, pricing, catalog ops) — this is an analysis and optimization role, not a merch\-ops role
* Need a long ramp time — we expect you to understand our D2C storefront and start proposing tests within weeks
* Treat a page redesign or a new widget as the finish line rather than the start of a measurement cycle
* Are uncomfortable making a judgment call on a page layout without a perfectly clean dataset behind it



  





**Skills Required:** 




**Must\-Have** 



* A/B Testing \& Experimentation Design: framing hypotheses, calculating sample size and test duration, and reading out results correctly
* Session Recording \& Behavioural Research: hands\-on use of Hotjar and/or Microsoft Clarity to watch and synthesize real user sessions into friction points
* Product/Funnel Analytics: using event\-based analytics tools to identify exactly where the funnel is leaking and quantify the opportunity
* Qualitative Research: running and synthesizing session recordings and user interviews into actionable findings
* Merchandizing \& Storefront Analytics: reasoning about widget placement, PDP structure, sale page architecture, and on\-site search/discovery
* Analytics Tools: GA4 (or similar) for on\-site behaviour, a BI tool (Metabase/Power BI) for reporting, and Excel/Sheets for modelling
* AI\-Assisted Building: using LLMs and vibe coding tools to prototype pages, synthesize research, and speed up analysis



**Good to Have** 



* Familiarity with event\-based product analytics platforms such as Mixpanel or Amplitude
* Basic familiarity with Figma or similar to mock up widget/page changes
* Prior experience with PDP or CRO optimization in a D2C or e\-commerce business
* Python for basic scripting on data pulls or test analysis



  





**What will you do?** 




**Own the D2C Storefront Real Estate** 



* Decide how every widget on the homepage, category, and PDP pages should be placed and sequenced
* Plan and prioritize sale and campaign page layouts across major sale events
* Continuously audit the storefront for underperforming or redundant real estate



**Run A/B Testing \& Experimentation** 



* Design and run structured A/B tests on landing pages, PDPs, widgets, and on\-site promotions
* Define success metrics, calculate sample size, and read out results with statistical rigour
* Build and maintain a prioritized backlog of testing hypotheses



**Drive Consumer Insights** 



* Watch and synthesize session recordings on Hotjar/Clarity to uncover on\-site friction points
* Run user interviews to go deeper on the 'why' behind observed behaviour
* Convert qualitative signals into testable hypotheses and merchandizing recommendations



**Diagnose Funnel Leakages** 



* Use product analytics tools to trace the funnel step by step and pinpoint where users drop off
* Quantify the size of each leakage and prioritize fixes by potential impact
* Partner with product on instrumentation gaps when the data needed isn't already tracked



**Plan On\-Site Promotions \& Campaigns** 



* Plan how sale pages, campaign pages, and promotional widgets should look and be sequenced across the site
* Coordinate timing and placement of on\-site promotions with the marketing calendar



**Optimize PDPs and On\-Site Search** 



* Identify PDP\-level improvements — content, trust signals, cross\-sell, review placement — and validate them with data
* Monitor on\-site search and discovery performance and recommend improvements to relevance and merchandizing rules



  





**Translate Insights into Merchandising Recommendations** 



* Convert findings into clear, prioritized recommendations for the merchandising operations team to execute
* You own the analysis and the recommendation — the merchandising team owns execution — so follow\-through and clarity matter



  





**Work Experience:** 




 2–4 years of experience
 



  





**Working days:** 




 Monday – Friday
 



  





**Location:** 




 Golf Course Ext. Road, Gurugram, Haryana (Work from Office)
 



  





**Perks:** 



* Friendly atmosphere
* High learning \& personal growth opportunity
* Flexible timings
* Diverse work environment



  





**Why Nutrabay:** 




 We believe in an open, intellectually honest culture where everyone is given the autonomy to contribute and do their life's best work. As part of the dynamic team at Nutrabay, you will have a chance to learn new things, solve new problems, build your competence, and be a part of an innovative marketing\-and\-tech startup that's revolutionising the health industry.
 



 Working with Nutrabay can be fun and a place of unique growth opportunities. Here you will learn how to maximise the potential of your available resources. You will get the opportunity to do work that helps you master a variety of transferable skills, or skills that are relevant across roles and departments. You will feel appreciated and valued for the work you deliver. We are creating a unique company culture that embodies respect and honesty, which will create more loyal employees than a company that simply shells out cash. We trust our employees and their voice and ask for their opinions on important business issues.
 



  





**About Nutrabay:** 




 Nutrabay is the largest health \& nutrition store in India. Our vision is to keep growing, have a sustainable business model, and continue to be the market leader in this segment by launching many innovative products. We are proud to have served over 1 million customers until now, and our family is constantly growing.
 



 We have built a complex and high\-converting eCommerce system, and our monthly traffic has grown to a million. We are looking to build a visionary and agile team to help fuel our growth and contribute to further advancing the continuously evolving product.
 



  





**Funding:** 




 We raised $5 million in a Series A funding.

title: Automotive Market Analyst, India & ASEAN
description:
**The Role:**

* Regional expertise. Good understanding of the Indian automotive market and the factors shaping vehicle demand. Exposure to one or more ASEAN markets is a strong advantage.
* Analytical capability. Confidence working with large datasets, checking data quality, identifying patterns and translating results into a coherent market story.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Listing: Supervising Associate \-**
**Job Listing Detail**
 At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help build a better working world.
   

  

**Domain Analyst**
**The opportunity**
 As a Domain Analyst at Supervising Associate rank at EY this role goes well beyond research delivery. You will specialize in key domain topics, contributing to EY's distinctive perspective on client issues to support commercial impact and business development. You will support specific programs within your area of expertise to drive the global or regional domain and specific accounts' growth ambitions. Working alongside the Domain Lead Analyst and/or Coordinating Analyst, you will deliver impactful analysis and insights for your domain and its activation with clients. Your role will involve providing analytical support and strategic advice on domain developments to EY leadership and sometimes clients, in your areas of specialism.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Develop an internal brand to become recognized within EY as a subject matter expert in specific topic areas.
* Engage with senior domain stakeholders to provide commercial perspectives on the issues, challenges, and opportunities facing the domain and prepare insightful analysis on the impact of those trends for EY and its clients.
* Regularly interact and present to internal EY stakeholders, participate in account meetings, and support domain leaders, solution leaders, and senior stakeholders in preparing for client meetings and events.
* Create commercial impact for EY by activating content with client servers across the EY network and proactively identifying opportunities for EY.
* Collaborate with domain stakeholders and EY colleagues across Insights and Clients and Industries to bring insights that support business development activities and service delivery to clients.
* Co\-create insights/PoV with EY SMEs with an audience\-first mindset and present them in a clear, compelling way.
* Proactively contribute your own ideas for insights for the domain, based on business priorities and an understanding of the domain's dynamics.
* Lead the creation of specific insights within areas of specialism by leveraging EY's proprietary knowledge and using data modelling and technology tools including AI while collaborating with Clients and Industries colleagues.
* Support the activation of specific external thought leadership across the EY network.
* Identify opportunities for cross\-domain collaboration and share insights with other Insights and Clients and Industries teams.
* Synthesize diverse perspectives and sources to develop compelling insights that drive results.
* Identify trends and translate them into key market\-facing initiatives for EY.
* Familiarize yourself with high\-quality sources of data in your domain and use both qualitative and quantitative research and analysis methodologies to generate insights.
* Understand the firm's go\-to\-market strategy and how Insights support exceptional client service.
* Continually build skills in research, analysis, data analytics, and visualization.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong presentation skills, with experience influencing internal decision\-makers.
* Demonstrate high usage of advanced technological tools available for research.
* Demonstrated experience in a fast\-paced, client\-driven environment.
* A self\-starter, able to bring new ideas for new insights to leadership.
* Collaborative and able to work effectively in a global, multi\-cultural environment.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills, capable of explaining complex concepts clearly and concisely.
* Ability to proactively build a network of internal and external contacts to shape insights.
* Proficient in managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* Adheres to key quality standards.


**What We Look For**
 University/Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience. Master's degree or postgraduate qualification preferred.
   

  

* 5\-7 years' experience in strategy, business analysis, industry research, management consulting, or business performance, advising organizations in the relevant domain.
* May require occasional travel, both domestic and international.
* Proficient in English, both written and verbal.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we'll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Analyst - Data & Insights(CP)
description:
**About Us**
 Bain \& Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change\-makers define the future. Across 61 offices in 39 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition, and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
   

  

 In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services, and Shared Services.
   

  

**Who You Will Work With**
 This position is based in BCN's Gurgaon office and is a vital part of the Data and Insights CoE’s CP EDA team. The EDA team plays a critical role in advancing Bain's expertise in the Consumer Products sector via building, maintaining, and advancing comprehensive Bain IP/ Solutions that capture key trends within the consumer space in a cyclic fashion. Additionally, we collaborate closely with CP Practice to identify opportunities to build and scale new products based off past cases within Bain.
   

  

 By staying ahead of industry trends and leveraging advanced data analytics, the EDA team supports Bain’s commitment to delivering top\-tier strategic guidance to its clients. Over time, we have developed seamless solutions and utilized powerful, dynamic visualizations and charts on various platforms (e.g., Tableau) to showcase our results and have been venturing towards Gen\-AI\-based tools to drive further value. Our working model features supporting key products carrying repeat value as well as short, dynamic engagements with Practice / case\-teams.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Understand client needs across multiple contexts/ geographies/ industries and screen realistic solutions based on sound reality checks to recommend actionable solutions
* Support the Manager/ Project Leader to drive the day\-to\-day tasks on conceptualizing research, explore innovative solutions and further client engagement for EDA
* Effectively understand the work plan and execute it (including industry research, preparing presentations, data analysis and other initiatives)
* Ensure zero\-defect analysis in own work stream ensuring key questions are answered in a timely manner
* Effectively structure communication of insights from own work stream. Deliver clear and professional presentations to the team

**About You**

* Working knowledge of Advanced Microsoft Excel, Alteryx, Tableau and PowerPoint is required
* Exposure to advanced data analytics tools such as Python, SQL, and Power BI would be a plus
* An understanding (or experience) of Consumer Products with an insight into data, metrics and trends covered within this space is a good to have
* Experience working with data sources such as Euromonitor, NielsonIQ, CapitalIQ etc. is a plus
* Exposure to Gen\-AI based tools and technologies would be helpful
* Bring a curious and creative mindset, open to new things and able to propose innovative ideas
* Working collaboratively and effectively in a group dynamic often virtual, proficient in agile ways of working


**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the \#1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

title: Program Officer – Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning
description:
**About Protsahan**
 Protsahan India Foundation is a center of excellence in innovation \& collaboration to eradicate Child Abuse so that all girls living in situations of vulnerability grow up empowered with access to education and healthcare in safe spaces, with greater freedom from all forms of abuse and violence. Girls and children who have experienced abuse or violence benefit from greater access to healing, care, support, gender justice, and other services needed to ensure physical, social and mental well\-being. Protsahan works cohesively to nurture girl champions from socially excluded backgrounds by bringing 21st\-century skills that endorse self\-learning and drive social and economic growth to enable an enriched and sustainable future for a young girl where she reaches her full potential.
   

  

 Additionally, Protsahan nurtures grassroots partnerships focused on Healing Childhood Trauma through comprehensive training, research, and advocacy initiatives. These efforts aim to fortify the child protection ecosystem and promote holistic well\-being for every child, particularly those in remote areas across India.
   

  

 To find out more about Protsahan visit
 **www.protsahan.co.in**
 The Program Officer – MEL will play a key role in translating field data and digital insights into clear, actionable evidence that strengthens program delivery across Protsahan’s work.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Program Officer – MEL will ensure that Protsahan’s program data is collected systematically and on a regular basis, maintained with high levels of accuracy, and regularly analysed to generate actionable insights for program improvement and organisational learning. The role will work closely with program teams to monitor implementation, identify gaps, track outcomes, and surface emerging trends. The Officer should be able to analyse and clearly represent both quantitative and qualitative data, translating complex findings into accessible insights, reports, and visualisations. The role will also involve working with diverse data sources including digital applications, social media platforms, and large datasets to identify patterns and strengthen evidence\-based decision\-making. Strong data analytics skills, including knowledge of BigQuery, SQL, dashboards, data extraction and management, and social and digital media trends, will be a significant advantage.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Monitoring Programs**
* Implement monitoring and evaluation plans, formats, tools, and reporting systems across Protsahan programs and partners.
* Ensure program data is collected systematically and regularly.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and up\-to\-date program data.
* Conduct regular field visits and data verification checks to confirm reported data reflects on\-ground program implementation.
* Work with field teams to strengthen their understanding and use of monitoring data that is accurate, complete, and meaningful.


**Data Management \& Analysis**
* Collect and analyse quantitative and qualitative primary and secondary data, including data generated through monitoring, assessments, and evaluations.
* Conduct regular data quality checks to identify gaps, inconsistencies, anomalies, and data collection issues.
* Identify patterns, trends, gaps, emerging issues, and insights from the data to inform program decisions.
* Use basic Excel skills for data management, analysis, and reporting, and have working knowledge of SQL for querying and analysing data in BigQuery.
* Support assessments, evaluation studies, and other evidence\-generation initiatives, including tool development, fieldwork, analysis, and documentation.


**Digital and AI\-enabled Learning**
* Collect and analyse data from diverse digital sources, including social media platforms, digital applications, and large datasets, to track and interpret trends, patterns, and engagement.
* Use digital data to generate insights and inform decision\-making.
* Maintain and improve AI\-enabled learning tools, such as chatbots or digital assistants, that reinforce training and support frontline staff with day\-to\-day protocol questions.
* Keep AI\-enabled content accurate, up to date, and aligned with program protocols and safeguarding requirements, with appropriate human oversight.


**Knowledge Management**
* Maintain and update curriculum, facilitator resources, and AI chatbot content.
* Maintain and update Protsahan’s repository of program evidence, lessons learned, and field knowledge.
* Contribute to periodic learning reviews.
* Support the development and quality assurance of MEL tools including data collection formats, indicators, and reporting templates ensuring they stay accurate and consistent as program insights evolve.


**Candidate Requirements**
* Research rigor. You follow protocol on consent, data handling, and methodology.
* On case data, girls’ personal information, and anything gathered during fieldwork or research.
* Adaptability and Learning Agility: Comfortable working in a dynamic grassroots environment where priorities, systems, and approaches may evolve based on field realities and organisational needs.
* Analytical and Critical Thinking: Able to look beyond numbers and reports, identify meaningful patterns, ask the right questions, and distinguish between surface\-level trends and genuine insights. Including AI literacy with judgment i.e., you can maintain a working chatbot, and you know exactly where automation stops and human judgment must take over especially in programs involving girls.
* Ownership and Resourcefulness: Willing to take initiative \& solve problems independently with limited supervision.
* Collaboration and Curiosity: Able to work respectfully with diverse teams, listen to field perspectives, question existing approaches constructively, and continuously learn from evidence and experience.


**Must\-haves**
* 4\-6 years of MERL work especially in the development sector.
* Working knowledge of AI chatbot tools and prompt design, applied in a program, training or operations context.
* A quantitative or analytics\-oriented coursework in college or done externally is required given the data extraction, BigQuery, and dashboarding expectations of this role.
* Strong written communication in both Hindi and English.
* Willingness to travel to field sites.


**Advantage if You Bring**
* Knowledge of child safeguarding protocols.
* Working knowledge of no\-code/low\-code chatbot or workflow\-builder platforms, and proficiency in digital data extraction and analysis tools (e.g., APIs, SQL, BigQuery).
* Experience with adolescent girls or communities affected by sexual and gender\-based violence, migration, or urban poverty.
* Published or contributed to research, evaluation, and monitoring reports/articles.


**Working Relationships**
* AD – MEL – Direct reporting – Reporting line for delivery priorities and program direction.
* CareVerse Team (Trainers, Facilitators, Psychologists). Close collaboration on content, delivery quality, and what frontline staff actually need.
* Manager – Ground Ops. Field visit scheduling, logistics, and ground\-truthing that curriculum and tools are usable onsite.


**Location** 
 Delhi (based at Protsahan Admin Office, with travel to Girl Empowerment Centers as required)

 Commensurate with experience

title: Manager Impact, India and Southeast Asia
company: The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet
description:
The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) works for a world where everyone has access to affordable, reliable, clean electricity and the means to use it to improve their lives. Our Alliance builds transformative public, private, philanthropic partnerships to end energy poverty and accelerate green economic opportunity. Founded in 2021 by The Rockefeller Foundation, IKEA Foundation, and Bezos Earth Fund, we design innovative projects/programs, unlock finance, strengthen institutions and transform markets, delivering progress anchored in deep community engagement. By uniting actors across the value chain, from households to heads of state, we go beyond individual projects to drive lasting systems change. With work in more than 30 countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, our Alliance aims to reach 1 billion people with clean electricity, prevent 4 billion tons of carbon emissions and create or improve 150 million jobs.
   

  

**Contract type: Fulltime, Open ended**
**Reports Directly To**
 Direct Reports:
   

  

**Matrix/Dual Reports**
 Chief Impact Officer
   

  

 None
   

  

 VP, India; MD, Grids of the Future
   

  

**Overview Of The Role**
 Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet’s goals are bold and audacious. We recognize that the path to a just energy transition worldwide will be complex, non\-linear, and filled with successes and opportunities, alongside failures and challenges. The Manager, Impact, India and Southeast Asia will support our effort to measure our contribution to impact through evaluations, monitoring and learning. Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) is embedded within our operating model, to ensure that we have an ear to the ground so we remain responsive and opportunistic, while generating insights that support continuous improvement.
   

  

 Stepping into a start\-up environment, the Manager, Impact, India and Southeast Asia will lead monitoring, evaluation and learning for the India and Southeast Asia portfolio, guided by the organization’s Impact framework. They will also lead impact measurement for the Grids of the Future pillar across all regions, and provide monitoring and analytics support across the global portfolio. They will be responsible for independently establishing the routine and long\-term work component of these workstreams, ensuring that they are efficiently managed and executed.
   

  

**Accountabilities** 
  

  

* 
+ Monitoring: Providing backend impact data quality assurance for all India and Southeast Asia transactions. Provide technical advice on target setting, indicators, theory of change mechanisms, causality links for the India and Southeast Asia portfolio. Onboard and train program teams on results monitoring sheets – ensuring compliance. **Title And Summary**
 Senior Technical Program Manager, Data Science
   

  

 Senior Technical Program Manager, Data Science
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Security Solutions Data Science organization is looking for an experienced Technical Program Manager with an understanding of data science who is eager to take on the responsibility of managing a wide variety of data science projects. The person in this role will join a team of leading edge data scientists who are not just building models, but are working to solve fraud related problems for our customers through AI as a foundation for new product offerings.
   

  

 Role
   

  

 The Technical Program Manager will interact with data scientists, product managers, engineers, and senior leaders across partner teams in the organization to deliver complex projects. You will define roadmap deliverables, develop execution plans, align dependencies, track progress, anticipate risks, provide escalation management, make sound trade\-off decisions, and translate technical expressions into business terminology. The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset. You are expected to be detail\-oriented, with a solid technical background and excellent problem\-solving skills.
   

  

 All staff at Mastercard are expected to demonstrate 'Mastercard Way' cultural values every day \- own it, simplify it, sense of urgency, thoughtful risk\-taking, unlock potential, and be inclusive – with a relentless focus on our customers.
   

  

 As a Senior Technical Program Manager for data science, you are expected to perform the following general responsibilities:
   

  

* Primary liaison between product and data science, managing day\-to\-day planning and execution of data science projects through the entire engagement process, from business understanding through model deployment and monitoring
* Looked to as first point of contact for your teams or business line/service and the single source of truth for status, providing the correct information and associated data about the state of the project to the right audience at the right time with the right focus
* Build strong partnerships with product and technology teams and align esnure alignment with data science efforts
* Translate technical approaches and outcomes into business language
* Understands the business strategy and design approaches within product, program, or domain with depth to be credible and influential with teams they work with
* Clearly articulate scope, timelines, dependencies, owners, actions, risks, and mitigations. Report progress to teams and senior leadership in regular cadence, potentially representing segments of or the entire program
* Work with data scientists and engineering teams to build/improve ways of working and identify and mitigate risks or issues that may impact the plan
* Conducts meaningful retrospectives, creates action plans to implement changes at the team level


**All About You**
 It is not expected that any single candidate would have expertise across all these areas.
   

  

* Experience with project management, operating autonomously across multiple teams, with demonstrated critical thinking, and thought leadership
* Demonstrated experience breaking down problems, organizing work, planning, and building
* Help product, data science and engineering teams make trade\-off decisions by considering all data including business goals, technical platform strategy, customer experience and maintainability. Identify blocking issues and manage their resolution
* Proven track record of data\-driven decision making and applying continuous improvement methodologies across teams
* Demonstrated experience building relationships, partnering with and influencing dependent teams while commanding the respect of the individuals you work with across the organization
* Excellent organization, interpersonal, administrative and problem solving skills
* Strong communication skills at all levels of the organization
* Capable of working independently but with a collaborative nature.
* Ability to navigate a matrix organization.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Staff OR Scientist
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative Principal Scientist – Operations Research \& Simulation to lead the development of advanced simulation platforms and optimization algorithms for complex, automated fulfillment environments. This role requires a deep understanding of operations research, optimization theory, and simulation modeling, with a strong focus on solving NP\-hard scheduling and orchestration challenges.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the design and development of advanced simulation and emulation platforms that accurately replicate complex fulfillment environments, including automation systems, human workflows, and software orchestration layers.
* Architect and implement robust optimization algorithms utilizing operations research techniques such as linear programming, dynamic programming, heuristics, and stochastic models.
* Develop and apply solutions for NP\-hard problems related to scheduling, resource allocation, and orchestration using constraint\-based and temporal planners, as well as commercial solvers (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX).
* Conduct in\-depth analysis of large\-scale performance data to identify inefficiencies, extract actionable insights, and recommend data\-driven improvements in throughput, accuracy, and system stability.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with software engineering, robotics, and operations teams to integrate simulation models and optimization algorithms into live production systems.
* Design and validate digital twins that offer predictive capabilities and support scenario planning and what\-if analysis for future deployments.
* Leverage expertise in simulation frameworks and tools (e.g., AnyLogic, FlexSim, Simio, or custom\-built environments in Python/C\+\+) to develop high\-fidelity models for continuous performance evaluation.
* Develop and maintain analytics solutions, data pipelines, and optimization engines using strong programming skills in Python, R, and SQL.
* Apply deep domain knowledge of automated warehouse operations, robotics orchestration, and human\-machine interaction to ensure simulation fidelity and real\-world applicability.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About The Position**
**About Coralogix**
 Coralogix is a full\-stack observability and security platform \- logs, metrics, traces, and SIEM analysed in\-stream at petabyte scale, stored in the customer's own data lake, and increasingly driven by our agentic AI layer (AI agent Olly, MCP server, CLI). Founded in 2015, headquartered in Boston, and backed by leading investors including Advent International, Brighton Park Capital, and Greenfield Partners with over $500M in funding.
   

  

 What sets Coralogix apart as a platform to build on is the combination of data depth and architectural openness. Because the platform's architecture makes full\-fidelity retention viable at scale, customers hold their complete operational and security picture in their own data lake \- no sampling, no gaps, no third party holding the keys. Every layer is then programmatic \- APIs, SDKs, and dev tools built for custom solutions \- creating an unusually rich and open foundation for the work ahead.ating requisitions 'from scratch'
   

  

**The role**
 Our most strategic customers need more than a platform. They need an engineer who deploys, customizes, and builds alongside them. Enterprise environments are complex \- multiple clouds, legacy infrastructure, custom deployments, multiple tools \- and what these customers need often extends well beyond what any platform delivers as standard.
   

  

 The Forward Deployed Engineer closes that gap. You are an engineer embedded in Tier\-1 accounts, working at the edge of what customers need next \- requirements that evolve continuously as enterprises scale, innovate, and push the boundaries of what observability and security can do for them. This is field\-deployed R\&D. It is not account management and it is not support.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Every engagement starts by getting to the real problem \- translating an ambiguous or evolving customer requirement into a concrete, scoped technical plan before a line of code is written. You build the new functionality that emerges from evolving customer requirements \- net\-new use cases with a clear path to other customers and/or back to the product, customisations that extend existing capabilities where out\-of\-the\-box configurations fall short, and critical features that unlock adoption or expansion with strategic accounts. You build in production\-grade code, not prototypes, working closely with both in\-house and customer observability and security teams \- you build, they define the logic \- ensuring domain validity in everything that ships. AI is central to both how you build and what you build: as a development accelerator and as the core ingredient in your solutions, with a particular focus on autonomous, multi\-step agentic AI workflows. Every engagement is engineered for repeatability, and you work closely with R\&D throughout \- feeding back field patterns and the solutions you have built \- so the best of what you ship is assessed, hardened, and absorbed into the platform. You are accountable for the outcomes in your accounts, not just the builds \- adoption, retention, and time\-to\-value are yours to move.
   

  

**How You Will Work**
 Own 2\-3 strategic accounts (a single account during intensive deployments), operating across the full stakeholder range within each \- from individual engineers and security analysts to CTOs and CISOs. Spend roughly 60\-70% of your time in deep customer engagement, on\-site and virtual, and the remainder on reusable playbooks and structured product feedback to R\&D. Partner with Account Executives and Account Managers, who own the commercial relationship. Exercise judgment on scope continuously \- deciding what matters now versus later, pushing back where needed, and knowing when something is ready to ship so the customer gets real value quickly. Your engagements are time\-bounded with clearly defined outcomes.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 8\+ years in software engineering writing production\-grade code. Prior security or observability experience is a big plus, not a requirement \- you will be paired with experts who provide the domain logic \- but you must ramp quickly into unfamiliar domains.
* A product\-minded engineer with experience designing and building software products end to end \- translating customer needs into product decisions, thinking in user experience and outcomes, and working fluently with modern AI development tools to build AI\-native solution
* Proven customer engagement experience across both technical and non\-technical audiences, including at C\-level \- able to build rapport quickly, explain complex concepts credibly, and navigate an enterprise organisation to get things done.
* Operates with founder\-level ownership: high urgency, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to define the problem as much as solve it.
* A genuine blend of engineering depth and strategic\-consulting instinct.
* Based in\-region, with significant on\-site time at customer sites.


**Strong plus:** 
 detection engineering or security\-operations background; hands\-on experience building agentic or LLM\-based systems in production, including familiarity with MCP; developer\-platform or SDK building; prior resident\-engineer, forward\-deployed, or strategic\-engineering experience at an observability, data\-infrastructure, or security vendor.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like**
 Replicable use cases delivered and subsequently absorbed into the product; improved time\-to\-value for new enterprise onboarding where you are deployed; stronger retention among your accounts versus baseline; and expansion revenue directly attributable to the capability you have built.
   

  

**How We Work**
 This is a new function \- a small, elite team with a founding mandate. We are entrepreneurial and high\-intensity, operating with unreasonable agency. If you want the deepest applied AI, observability and security engineering work available \- building real solutions for the most demanding enterprise environments, seeing your field\-proven patterns absorbed into a platform used by thousands of engineers globally \- this is where that happens. Think of it as your PhD in applied AI, observability and security: no academic benchmarks, only production.

title: Operational Innovations Senior Analyst
description:
**Locations** 
 : Gurgaon \| London
   

  

 Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 BCG’s internal functions are the foundation of how our firm operates— representing thousands of professionals and hundreds of millions in investment that enable BCG to deliver exceptional client impact at global scale. As the firm continues to grow and technology changes rapidly, our internal operations face an extraordinary opportunity: to continue to evolve to an even more scalable, technology\-enabled, global organization.
   

  

 Our Operational Innovations (OI) team is at the center of this transformation. We are trusted partners to our functions and firm leadership for driving this ambitious change agenda. We enable step\-change improvement in the effectiveness and efficiency of the firm by accelerating high\-priority initiatives sponsored by the Operations Leadership Team and/or our Operating Committee. From technology \& AI deployments to end\-to\-end process redesign, we partner with functional and geographic leaders to re\-architect how the firm operates — faster, smarter, and more connected than ever before.
   

  

 We don’t just manage change — we partner with the business to make it happen. Our team helps shape and accelerate BCG’s most strategic initiatives, providing hands\-on executional leadership and deep expertise in transformation, digital enablement, and change management. We enable functions to scale effectively, improve performance, and unlock new sources of value through data, automation, and forward\-thinking design.
   

  

**Key Activities And Responsibilities Include**
* In partnership with initiative owners and OI Project Managers, provide content support, research, expertise, analyses, or documentation to support project management and accelerate various functional or geographic improvement initiatives. Project emphasis to include operational improvement projects, and often the digital delivery of operational improvements, digital collaboration, and/or digital employee services.
* Support development of deliverables, ensuring highest potential for value delivery. Deliverables could include business improvement plans, process design, effective communication \& engagement plans, implementation plans or supporting analyses for any of these. Expectation that analysts can distil key insights from analyses to presentation formats
* Work with line owners and OI team members to identify potential investments and/or process improvements to accelerate BCG’s digital and operational development. Assist in defining end\-state processes and organizational models, as well as the path to achieve those end states.
* Work with Program Managers and Change Managers/Leads to support on the ground implementation of Change initiatives including enabling impacted users, embedding behavioral change and doing change impact analysis.
* Work with Program Managers and Change Managers/Leads translate project objectives and change needs into concrete employee communications, engagement actions and campaigns using a range of channels and media.
* Track project success and progress, working with project managers to ensure projects remain on course and objectives are realized on\-time and within budget parameters, and that projects deliver against stated objectives and KPIs.
* Support development of senior management reporting and broader communications, as required, in part by providing related analyses and supporting documentation


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* University degree or equivalent – ideally in a business related subject
* Experience working in a multi\-national or large scale environment
* Data Analysis – strong data analysis skills, able to communicate key insights effectively
* Curiosity and focus on continuous development, learning
* Creativity and openness to new approaches, digital tools, Agile methodologies
* Project and Program Management a plus


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 The OI Leadership Team and OI team members, especially project managers and change managers Internal Clients / stakeholders to develop communications to deliver project and stakeholder change objectives External Associates – our network of BCG approved contingent resources, when appropriate.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

**You’re Good At**
* Organizing and managing project details with a bias for getting to great output quickly – You are flexible and organized in your work and can be effective across a range of activities and stakeholders
* Working in a complex environment at pace – You are analytical and comfortable managing multiple deliverables with multiple inputs often with high impact, time sensitive requirements
* Data Analysis – Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of information and data to draw out insights and help shape project plans, business cases, etc.
* Stakeholder Engagement – You can hear what someone needs, translate it into your own words, and create it. You are politically and organizationally savvy and can navigate/influence complex matrix organizations
* Structuring and analyzing information. You can take an idea for organizing or analyzing data and turn it into a useful deliverable. Strong attention to detail
* Culture and collaboration – you care deeply about the experience and engagement of your colleagues and believe in the core tenets of BCG’s purpose statements
* Learning and adapting – you are an eager and consistent learner, are naturally curious, open to feedback and interested in continuous improvement


*At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*

title: Insights Analyst
description:
**Insights Analyst** 




**A US\-headquartered product company scaling its India insights team** 




**Location:** 
 Delhi, India — hybrid
 



**The Gap This Role Closes** 




 A US\-headquartered product company is scaling its India insights team and has partnered with Flexiple to hire an analyst who can do more than produce reports — someone who reads a pile of usage data, survey responses, and market research and comes back with an actual point of view on what the business should do next. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high\-performing teams and GCCs in India.
 



 The company already has data. What it is short of is someone willing to commit to a recommendation instead of handing back a chart and letting the room decide.
 



**What You'll Own** 



* Pull together product usage data, customer research, and competitive signals into a single, coherent view of what is happening and why
* Turn ambiguous questions from product and leadership into a research plan, and the research plan into a specific recommendation
* Present findings to stakeholders who will push back, and defend the recommendation on its merits, not just the data behind it



**How You'll Operate** 



* Partner with product, marketing, and strategy teams to understand what decision an analysis needs to unblock before you start it
* Build repeatable frameworks for the questions that come up quarter after quarter, instead of starting from zero each time
* Flag when the data does not support a clean answer, rather than forcing one



**What You Bring** 




 2 to 6 years in research, analytics, insights, or strategy, with a track record of turning data into a recommendation someone acted on — not just a deck someone read. Strong analytical instincts, comfort with ambiguity, and the writing skill to make a complex finding land in three sentences. Working knowledge of SQL, Excel or Sheets, and at least one BI tool.
 



**Nice to Have** 



* Experience at a product or SaaS company specifically, rather than pure market\-research or academic research
* Exposure to Python or R for deeper analysis
* A background in consulting, strategy, or a similarly recommendation\-driven role



**What You'll Gain** 



* A seat where your output is a decision, not a dashboard nobody reopens
* Remote\-friendly, pan\-India hiring with long\-term placement
* Direct visibility into how product and leadership actually use research



**How We Hire** 




 HR Screening → Case Study Assignment → Team Round → Culture Fit
 



 One application is considered for this role and any future matched openings, so there is no need to apply twice.

**The Team**
 Through continued growth comes more demand for business insights and data used to make objective decisions. To support this need and help maintain operational efficiency, A\&M has invested in growing its Business Intelligence Unit (BIU). The BIU creates and maintains scalable data pipelines, constructs analysis, delivers process improvement initiatives and builds visualization tools and applications. The unit is also focused on embedding AI into its own ways of working to drive efficiency, and on enabling the business to apply AI to the data assets the team provides. All with the goal of supporting the firm to realize operational efficiencies identified through analysis. The BIU operates across multiple geographies and practice areas, supporting decision\-making for senior stakeholders across the firm. The Insight Optimisation team is responsible for the ongoing health, evolution, and optimization of the firm's core reporting products. The team manages report consistency, user experience, backend data model improvements, documentation, troubleshooting, and enhancement requests. The team mission is to provide a seamless user experience to the business whilst reducing long\-term operational overhead through prioritising consistency, consolidation, and a focus on action\-driven insights.

 The Business Intelligence Unit is seeking a motivated Associate to join the Insight Optimisation team based in India. Reporting to the Manager of Insight Optimisation, the Associate will play a hands\-on role in maintaining and improving the firm's existing core reporting suite, supporting business users, and contributing to the transition to a new Snowflake data environment.

The successful candidate will spend their time building improvements to existing reports, investigating data issues, maintaining documentation, and working directly with business users to understand and deliver on their needs. * Review report usage statistics and user feedback to identify opportunities to improve formatting, usability, and consistency across the reporting suite.
* Implement improvements to existing reports and dashboards, applying user\-centred design principles to enhance the end\-user experience.
* Review dashboard refresh times and backend data models, identifying and applying efficiency improvements in how data is brought into the reporting layer.
* Maintain user guides, definition lists, and technical documentation as new tabs and data sources are added over time.
* Triage and troubleshoot queries received through the BIU inbox, systematically diagnosing whether issues sit at the reporting layer, database level, or source level.
* Escalate complex or cross\-layer issues appropriately and work collaboratively with the wider team to resolve them.
* Support the transition of existing reports to the new Snowflake environment, repointing reports and testing to ensure continuity of service for business users.
* Apply AI and generative AI tools to accelerate day\-to\-day delivery, and ongoing maintenance.
* Communicate clearly with business users on the status of their requests, expected timelines, and any technical constraints.
* Contribute to team\-wide initiatives to improve ways of working, share knowledge, and raise the collective technical standard of the team
* Keep up to date with the latest tools and techniques in BI, analytics, and AI, and apply them where they can add value


**Qualifications**
* 3\-5 years of relevant experience in business intelligence, analytics, or a data\-focused role.
* Strong report development experience, preferably Power BI, including visualisation, data modelling, and DAX.
* Strong SQL skills, including the ability to write, read, and optimise queries against relational databases.
* Understanding of data modelling concepts and how data flows through a modern analytics stack.
* Exposure to Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms is desirable; willingness to learn is essential.
* Awareness of current AI and generative AI tools, with an interest in applying them to analytics workflows and reporting products.
* Structured troubleshooting approach, with the ability to isolate problems across the analytics stack.
* Exposure to user\-centred design principles and an appreciation for the end\-user experience of analytics products.
* Familiarity with Python or another scripting language is a plus.
* Experience working in a globally distributed team or across time zones is desirable.
* Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in a relevant field, or equivalent professional work experience

title: Senior Associate, Clean Fuels Markets
description:
cKinetics is looking for an energetic Senior Associate who is passionate about clean fuel markets and the energy transition and is looking to lead projects and teams doing meaningful, cutting\-edge work.
 



  





 We work across compliance clean fuel markets, including California LCFS, Washington CFS, Oregon CFP, Canada CFR, and BC LCFS, as well as low\-carbon fuels such as Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), Renewable Diesel (RD), and Renewable Natural Gas (RNG). Through our market intelligence, analytical models, and data\-driven products, we help businesses, investors, and policymakers navigate the rapidly evolving global clean fuels and energy transition landscape.
 



  





 We are looking for individuals who thrive in an entrepreneurial environment, enjoy solving complex problems, and are eager to build new capabilities, take ownership, and contribute to the growth of both our products and the organization.
 



  





**Be on the cutting edge of researching the next generation of clean fuels.** 




  





**Role** 




 The role involves assessing and evaluating research elements to produce required outputs for client deliveries. Deliverables include creative presentations and narratives backed by market analysis, data insights, and modelling.
 



 The candidate will:
 


* Develop an understanding of the different drivers and constraints impacting specific markets within the clean fuels space.
* Manage end\-to\-end project delivery, including overseeing team members working on assigned projects.
* Guide team members in undertaking primary and secondary research and formulating appropriate solution frameworks.
* Support practice leadership in developing collateral such as white papers, intelligence briefs, and business proposals.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Sector and Industry Research** 



* Undertake analysis of global and regional clean fuel programs, with a specific focus on North America and the EU.
* Monitor legislative changes and market developments and assess their impact on respective clean fuel markets and programs.
* Lead conversations with clients, advisors, and external market participants globally and help solve client problems.
* Identify patterns and trends in data to draw conclusions, make inferences, and build spreadsheet\-based models.



**Project \& Time Management** 



* Plan and execute projects with team members, adhering to task completion timelines through self\-monitoring and coordination with Analysts to ensure high\-quality and timely delivery.
* Collaborate with project and internal teams, including Engagement Managers, Directors, and Partners, to develop cohesive solutions for client projects, problems, programs, and products.
* Own delivery of on\-demand consulting projects, ensuring timely and cost\-effective delivery with the requisite level of client satisfaction.



**Client Engagement** 



* Ensure client satisfaction through analytical, impactful, and world\-class written and oral presentations backed by data insights, trends, and patterns derived from structured and unstructured data analysis.
* Create customized client retention strategies through high\-engagement activities.



**Business Development Support** 



* Provide business development support by undertaking active pursuits with existing and potential cKinetics clients. This will include developing proposals, concept notes, and other collateral as needed to present cKinetics' capabilities.
* Develop innovative solutions and aim to generate new intellectual property in these markets through new product offerings, thematic topics, and emerging developments.



  





**About You** 




 The ideal candidate must have the desire to work in sustainability transition interventions and have the following mindset and skill sets:
 


* Proactive and independent, with a passion for sustainability.
* Flexible and creative mindset, with the ability to understand diverse markets and client organizations.
* Problem\-solver with a drive to take ownership.
* Strong analytical abilities and excellent presentation skills.
* Proficient in financial modelling, with experience developing spreadsheet\-based models. Experience with econometric modelling is a plus.
* Ability to work hands\-on and multitask in an energetic environment.
* Up to date with global events, with an interest in energy and environmental sciences.
* Passionate about presenting and discussing research findings with senior audiences and industry experts.



  





**You Must Have** 



* A Master's degree in engineering, an MBA, or a related degree.
* Demonstrated research, education, or work experience related to transportation, climate change, energy, or public policy.
* Experience as an author or co\-author of papers, technical or policy reports, white papers, or other forms of written communication.
* 4–7 years of relevant consulting experience in a related field, such as clean fuel programs, biofuels, oil \& gas, energy transition, sustainability and low\-carbon transition, or renewable energy.

title: Growth Manager-Ecommerce
description:
We’re looking for a
 **Growth Manager\-Ecommerce** 
 to own and scale our online business across D2C, marketplaces and quick\-commerce platforms with a primary focus on Amazon and Blinkit as key revenue\-driving channels.
 



  





 The ideal candidate understands that e\-commerce is not just about managing listings \- it’s about driving sales, improving visibility, increasing conversion, ensuring product availability and building profitable \& sustainable growth. You should be comfortable working with data, managing multiple platforms and identifying opportunities to grow the business.
 



  





 If you enjoy taking ownership, working fast and directly impacting online revenue and business growth, we’d love to hear from you.
 



  





**About Ayuvya** 




 Ayuvya is a modern Ayurveda and wellness brand built around trust, authenticity and innovation, combining traditional Ayurvedic wisdom with modern science and technology.
 



  





 We are building modern Indian wellness brands across D2C, marketplaces and quick commerce, with a strong focus on building scalable and profitable digital businesses.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Own and scale Amazon \& Blinkit as key revenue\-driving channels, while managing the broader D2C, marketplace and quick\-commerce business.
* Drive sales targets for the overall brand, hero products and key categories, while owning channel P\&L, margins, CAC and contribution.
* Own forecasting, budgeting, revenue planning and profitability across e\-commerce channels.
* Manage product listings, catalogue, assortment, pricing and promotions across platforms.
* Optimize product pages for SEO, visibility, conversion and platform merchandising.
* Plan and execute media, promotional and marketplace campaigns with the marketing team.
* Monitor competitors, pricing, keywords, rankings, reviews and category trends to identify growth opportunities.
* Track inventory, stock availability, orders, cancellations, returns and fulfilment in coordination with supply chain and operations.
* Analyze sales and platform data to track revenue, conversion, AOV, ROAS, margins and overall channel performance.
* Manage new product launches, SKU additions and platform onboarding.
* Manage marketplace, agency and vendor relationships and drive commercial negotiations.
* Coordinate with marketing, supply chain, operations, finance, CRM and distribution teams.
* Define long\-term channel strategy and growth roadmap and drive continuous experimentation and improvement.
* Prepare regular performance reports and share key insights and action plans with leadership.



  





**Requirements** 



* B.Tech or MBA in Sales \& Marketing / Business or a relevant field.
* 3–5 years of experience in e\-commerce, growth, marketplace management or key account management. Hands\-on experience with major marketplace or quick\-commerce platforms.
* Experience as a Category Manager with an online retailer, KAM for an E\-commerce channel with a leading brand or KAM in Modern Trade is a strong fit.
* Strong understanding of catalogue management, e\-commerce operations and platform dashboards.
* Good understanding of SEO, product pages and conversion optimization.
* Strong understanding of pricing, promotions, margins and marketplace profitability.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify the root cause of problems and make decisions with imperfect information.
* Strong negotiation and commercial skills with the ability to create win\-win outcomes.
* Strong solutioning ability with a creative and problem\-solving mindset.
* Strong customer orientation and interest in consumer internet and digital commerce.
* Detail\-oriented, organized and execution\-focused.
* Experience in D2C, FMCG, Wellness, Ayurveda, Beauty or Lifestyle is a plus.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* Someone who understands what drives online sales and can turn data into action.
* A self\-driven professional who takes ownership and continuously looks for ways to improve sales, visibility, conversion, availability and profitability.
* Someone who can balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution.
* Someone who is commercially sharp, data\-driven and comfortable solving ambiguous problems.
* Someone who enjoys working across platforms, teams and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.



  





**You’ll Be a Great Fit If** 



* You enjoy working with data, platforms and products.
* You can manage multiple platforms, stakeholders and priorities.
* You enjoy working in a fast\-paced, high\-ownership environment.
* You’re excited about D2C, marketplaces, quick commerce and the consumer internet space.
* You enjoy experimentation and see ambiguity as an opportunity rather than friction.



  





**This Role May Not Be the Right Fit If** 



* You see e\-commerce only as a listing/uploading job.
* You prefer following instructions rather than taking ownership.
* You’re uncomfortable with numbers, P\&L and performance metrics.
* You don’t enjoy working across multiple teams, platforms and external partners.
* You’re not comfortable working in an early\-stage startup environment with ambiguity and changing priorities.

**Location:** 
 Analytics Center / Office (Full\-Time, 100% In\-Office)
   

  

**Experience:** 
 4–8 Years
   

  

**Department:** 
 Advanced Analytics \& Operations Research
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a quantitative
 **Supply Chain Data Scientist** 
 to build the mathematical engines that power our predictive logistics, network optimization, and automated inventory management platforms. Working hand\-in\-hand with our data engineers, software architects, and client success leads at our central office, you will transform massive, multi\-enterprise logistics datasets into actionable, real\-time decision frameworks that help global enterprises minimize stock\-outs, reduce holding costs, and bulletproof their supply chains against disruption.

**1\. Demand Forecasting \& Predictive Modeling**
* Design, train, and deploy advanced machine learning models (gradient boosting, deep learning time\-series architectures, and probabilistic estimators) for multi\-horizon demand forecasting and SKU\-level volatility analysis.
* Build predictive models to anticipate supplier lead\-time fluctuations, customs clearance bottlenecks, and transportation carrier delays before they impact downstream production schedules.
* Continuously monitor model performance, analyze feature drift, and retrain pipelines using automated data feeds from enterprise ERP and WMS integrations.
* Operations Research \& Network Optimization
* Formulate and solve complex operations research (OR) optimization problems, including multi\-echelon inventory optimization, safety stock placement, and network footprint design.
* Develop mathematical algorithms for dynamic vehicle routing, last\-mile delivery scheduling, and freight consolidation using optimization solvers (e.g., Gurobi, PuLP, or SciPy optimization libraries).
* Build "digital twin" simulation models of physical supply chain networks to test demand shocks, supplier failures, and inventory rebalancing strategies virtually before production deployment.
* Productionizing Analytics \& Feature Engineering
* Collaborate closely with Data Engineers to design efficient feature stores and data transformation pipelines in Python and SQL that feed high\-frequency scoring engines.
* Translate experimental Jupyter notebook models into clean, modular, and containerized microservices ready for enterprise\-grade deployment.
* Optimize algorithmic query execution and vector/matrix calculations to ensure sub\-second response times for interactive user dashboards.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Client Workshops
* Engage in daily face\-to\-face whiteboarding and sprint planning sessions with software engineering squads to align model outputs with core product features.
* Partner with product managers and client\-facing teams to interpret analytical findings, validate assumptions against real\-world logistics constraints, and present optimization insights directly to enterprise clients during on\-site consultations.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 
  

  

* Work Mode: 100% On\-site commitment with daily physical attendance at our office and analytics center.
* Core Technical Stack:
+ Expert\-level Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit\-Learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow, Statsmodels).
+ Strong mastery of relational databases and complex SQL querying.
+ Experience with Operations Research solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, or SciPy optimization).
+ Familiarity with containerization tools (Docker) and version control (Git).

* Domain Expertise: Deep practical knowledge of core supply chain metrics and concepts (Fill Rate, Days Sales of Inventory, Inventory Turns, Bullwhip Effect, and multi\-echelon inventory routing).
* Education \& Background: Advanced degree (Master’s or Ph.D.) in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.


**Why Join Us On\-Site?**
 Collaborating side\-by\-side with domain experts and software teams in a physical office setting enables rapid mathematical whiteboarding, immediate feedback loops on model constraints, and direct participation in high\-stakes enterprise analytics implementations.

 Data Quality \& Systems

 Capability Building \& Ways of Working

 Help local teams understand and apply global tools in their day\-to\-day work.

 Qualifications:
